math-e1-geo1.title: Amagama ezimo namakhona
math-e1-geo1.concept: **Unxantathu** unezinhlangothi ezi-3, **isikwele/unxande** unezinhlangothi ezi-4. **Isiyingi** siyindilinga futhi asinamakhona.

math-e1-geo2.title: Ukwazi izimo ezine-3D
math-e1-geo2.concept: Isimo sebhokisi siyi-**cuboid**, isimo sensika eyindilinga siyi-**cylinder**, isimo sebhola siyi-**sphere**.

math-e1-l1.title: Ukubala
math-e1-l1.concept: Uma ubala izinto uzikhomba ngayinye, ungazi ukuthi zingaki. Uma ziphezulu kuka-10, kulula ukuzibala ngamaqembu a-5 noma a-10.

math-e1-l2.title: Ukwengeza nokukhipha
math-e1-l2.concept: **Ukwengeza (+)** ukuhlanganisa izinombolo ezimbili, futhi **ukukhipha (-)** ukususa inombolo encane kwenkulu.

math-e1-l3.title: Ukuqhathanisa osayizi bezinombolo
math-e1-l3.concept: Phakathi kwezinombolo ezimbili, enkulu ibonisa nge-**>**, encane nge-**<**. Uphawu luvuleka ohlangothini lwenombolo enkulu.

math-e1-l4.title: Izimo ezahlukene
math-e1-l4.concept: **Unxantathu** unezinhlangothi ezi-3, **isikwele/unxande** unezinhlangothi ezi-4. **Isiyingi** siyindilinga futhi asinamakhona.

math-e1-l5.title: Ubude newashi
math-e1-l5.concept: Ubude bulinganiswa nge-**cm**. Inkomba emfushane yewashi ikhomba 'amahora', inkomba ende ikhomba 'amaminithi'.
math-e1-l5.example: Inkomba emfushane 4, inkomba ende 12 → ihora lesi-4

math-e2-dat1.title: Ukuhlukanisa nokubonisa ngethebula negrafu
math-e2-dat1.concept: Uma uhlukanisa idatha ngokwezindlela, uyibale, futhi uyibonise ngethebula (**ithebula**) noma **igrafu**, ungayiqhathanisa ngokuhlola kanye.
math-e2-dat1.example: A abangu-3, B abangu-5, C abangu-2 → bonke abangu-10

math-e2-geo1.title: Unxantathu nesikwele
math-e2-geo1.concept: **Unxantathu** unezinhlangothi ezi-3 ezimile nokona okuyi-3, **isikwele/unxande** unezinhlangothi ezi-4 ezimile nokona okuyi-4. Noma izimo zihlukile, inani lezinhlangothi nelamakhona liyafana.

math-e2-geo2.title: Ubude nesikhathi
math-e2-geo2.concept: Uma ulinganisa u-0 wesimiso somthetho, uphawu olungakolunye uhlangothi lungubude. $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$. Phindaphinda inombolo ekhonjwa yinkomba ende yewashi ngo-5 uthole amaminithi.

math-e2-l1.title: Inani lendawo
math-e2-l1.concept: Enombolweni enezinhlamvu ezimbili, inombolo yesokunxele iyi-**indawo yamashumi**, kanti yesokudla iyi-**indawo yamawodwa**. Uma amashumi ayi-10 ehlangana, kuba ngu-100.

math-e2-l2.title: Ukwengeza nokukhipha izinombolo ezinezinhlamvu ezimbili
math-e2-l2.concept: Bala amawodwa nawodwa, amashumi nashumi. Uma isamba sedlula u-10, **thatha**, futhi uma ungakhiphi, **boleka**.

math-e2-l3.title: Ukuhlangana kokuqala nokuphindaphinda
math-e2-l3.concept: Ukwengeza inombolo efanayo izikhathi eziningi kungabhalwa kafushane nge-**ukuphindaphinda (×)**.

math-e2-l4.title: Ubude nesikhathi
math-e2-l4.concept: **1m = 100cm**. Ewashini, njalo uma inkomba ende idlula inombolo eyodwa, kudlula amaminithi ama-5.

math-e2-l5.title: Ukuthola iphethini
math-e2-l5.concept: Uma uthola **umthetho** wokukhula noma wokwehla kwezinombolo, ungazi inombolo elandelayo.

math-e3-ari1.title: Ukwengeza nokukhipha izinombolo ezinezinhlamvu ezintathu
math-e3-ari1.concept: Bala kusukela endaweni yamawodwa ngokulandelana. Uma isamba sedlula u-10, **thwala** endaweni ephezulu, futhi uma ungakhiphi, **boleka** endaweni ephezulu.

math-e3-geo1.title: Ingelo nengelo eqondile
math-e3-geo1.concept: Isimo esakhiwa yimisebe emibili eqala endaweni eyodwa sibizwa ngokuthi **ingelo**. Ingelo engu-$90^\circ$ iyi-**ingelo eqondile**, encane kunayo iyi-**ingelo ebukhali**, enkulu kunayo iyi-**ingelo ebanzi**.
math-e3-geo1.example: $30^\circ$ ingelo ebukhali · $90^\circ$ ingelo eqondile · $120^\circ$ ingelo ebanzi

math-e3-geo2.title: Irediyasi nobubanzi bendingilizi
math-e3-geo2.concept: Ubude obusuka esikhungweni sendingilizi buye endaweni eyodwa endingilizini bubizwa ngokuthi **irediyasi**, futhi ucezu olugudla isikhungo lubizwa ngokuthi **ububanzi**. Ububanzi bungamathuba amabili erediyasi.
math-e3-geo2.example: Irediyasi engu-5 cm → ububanzi obungu-10 cm

math-e3-l1.title: Ukuphindaphinda nokuhlukanisa
math-e3-l1.concept: Ukuphindaphinda kungukudlulisa inombolo efanayo kaningi, futhi **ukuhlukanisa** kungukwehlukanisa ngokulinganayo. Uma wazi ithebula lokuphindaphinda, ukuhlukanisa kuyaba lula.

math-e3-l2.title: Ukwazi ngezingxenyana
math-e3-l2.concept: Ingxenye yento ephelele eyahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo ikhonjiswa njengengxenyana. Inombolo engezansi iyi-**isihlukanisi** futhi engenhla iyi-**inombolo engaphezulu**.

math-e3-l5.title: Amathebula namagrafu
math-e3-l5.concept: Uma imiphumela yenhlolovo ihlelwa ethebuleni, kulula ukubona okukhulu kakhulu, okuncane kakhulu nesamba.

math-e4-dat1.title: Ukufunda igrafu yomugqa
math-e4-dat1.concept: **Igrafu yomugqa** ikhombisa amanani ashintsha ngesikhathi ngamaphoyinti nemigqa. Uma umugqa unyuka, kukhule; uma wehla, kwehlile.

math-e4-geo1.title: Usayizi wezingelo zesimo
math-e4-geo1.concept: Isamba sezingelo ezintathu zonxantathu singu-$180^\circ$, futhi isamba sezingelo ezine zesimo esinezinhlangothi ezine singu-$360^\circ$.

math-e4-geo2.title: Izimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine namapholigoni
math-e4-geo2.concept: Uma ipheya elilodwa lezinhlangothi eziphikisanayo lihambisana, kuyi-**trapezoid**; uma amapheya womabili ehambisana, kuyi-**parallelogram**; uma zonke izinhlangothi ezine zilingana, kuyi-**rhombus**. Ucezu oluhlanganisa amakhoneni angaseduze lubizwa ngokuthi **i-diagonal**.

math-e4-l1.title: Izinombolo ezinkulu
math-e4-l1.concept: Funda futhi ubhale izinombolo ezinkulu ngeyunithi yezinkulungwane eziyishumi (10000). Inombolo ngayinye endaweni ngayinye ikhombisa usayizi we-**place value**.

math-e4-l2.title: Ukuphindaphinda nokuhlukanisa izinombolo ezinkulu
math-e4-l2.concept: Hlukanisa inombolo ephindaphindwayo, uphindaphinde, bese ufaka. Ekuhlukaniseni, hlola ngokulinganisela isiphumo.

math-e4-l3.title: Ukufaka nokukhipha izingxenyana namadesimali
math-e4-l3.concept: Ezingxenyeni ezinesihlukanisi esifanayo, faka noma ukhiphe **izinombolo ezingaphezulu** kuphela. Emadesimali, bala uqondanise izindawo zephoyinti ledesimali.

math-e4-l4.title: Izingelo nezimo
math-e4-l4.concept: Isamba sezingelo ezintathu zonxantathu singu-**180°**, futhi isamba sezingelo ezine zesimo esinezinhlangothi ezine singu-**360°**.

math-e4-l5.title: Igrafu yebha nesilinganiso
math-e4-l5.concept: Funda idatha uthole isamba nomehluko. **Isilinganiso** yinani elitholakala ngokufaka konke bese ukuhlukanisa ngenani lezinto.

math-e5-dat1.title: Ukuthola isilinganiso
math-e5-dat1.concept: **Isilinganiso** yinani elitholakala ngokufaka yonke idatha bese ukuhlukanisa ngenani ledatha.

math-e5-dat2.title: Ithuba
math-e5-dat2.concept: **Ithuba** lokuthi into ithile yenzeke likhonjiswa yinombolo phakathi kuka-0 (akunakwenzeka) no-1 (kuqinisekile). Ithuba=(inani lamacala adingekayo)÷(inani lawo wonke amacala).
math-e5-dat2.example: Amabhola angu-3 e-A, angu-2 e-B → ithuba lokuthi yi-A $\frac{3}{5}=0.6$

math-e5-geo1.title: Umjikelezo nendawo
math-e5-geo1.concept: Unxande: indawo=ubude×ububanzi, unxantathu: isisekelo×ubude÷2, i-parallelogram: isisekelo×ubude, i-trapezoid: (uhlangothi olungaphezulu+uhlangothi olungaphansi)×ubude÷2, i-rhombus: i-diagonal×i-diagonal÷2.

math-e5-geo2.title: Ukufana nokulinganisa
math-e5-geo2.concept: Amafomu amabili afana ngesimo nosayizi futhi ahlangana ngokuphelele abizwa ngokuthi **afanayo (congruent)**. Ifomu elihlangana ngokuphelele uma lingeniwe ngomugqa owodwa liyi-**line-symmetric figure** futhi lowo mugqa yi-**eksisi yokulinganisa**.

math-e5-l1.title: Ukuqoqa nokuncisha izingxenyana ezinezihlukanisi ezihlukile
math-e5-l1.concept: Uma izihlukanisi zihlukile, qala ngokwenza **isihlukanisi esifanayo**. Kulula ukusebenzisa izinombolo ezincane kakhulu ezihlukaniswa yizo zombili njengesihlukanisi esivamile.

math-e5-l2.title: Ukuphindaphinda amadesimali
math-e5-l2.concept: Susa iphoyinti ledesimali bese uphindaphinda njengezinombolo ezipheleleyo, bese ubuyisela iphoyinti ledesimali ngokulingana nenani lezindawo zedesimali ezibandakanyiwe ekuphindaphindeni.

math-e5-l3.title: Izihlukanisi nokuphindwe
math-e5-l3.concept: **Isihlukanisi** inombolo eyahlukanisa enye ngokungashiyi insalela, **okuphindwe** kuyinombolo ephindwe izikhathi 1, 2, 3...

math-e5-l4.title: Indawo nevolumu
math-e5-l4.concept: Unxande ngu-**ubude × ububanzi**, unxantathu ngu-**isisekelo × ubude ÷ 2**, futhi ivolumu yebhokisi elinezinhlangothi ezinxande ngu-**ubude × ububanzi × ukuphakama**.

math-e5-l5.title: Isilinganiso nesilinganiso sepesenti
math-e5-l5.concept: **Isilinganiso** yinani elitholakala ngokuhlukanisa inani elithelelwayo ngenani eliyisisekelo. Uma uphindaphinda isilinganiso ngo-100, kuba yi-**iphesenti (%)**.

math-e6-ari1.title: Ukubala okuxubile kwezinombolo ezipheleleyo
math-e6-ari1.concept: Uma ukwengeza, ukuncisha, ukuphindaphinda nokuhlukanisa kuxubene, qala ngokubala okuphakathi **kwamabhulakethi**, bese **ukuphindaphinda nokuhlukanisa**, ekugcineni **ukwengeza nokuncisha** kusuka ngakwesobunxele.

math-e6-ari2.title: Ukuyisa phezulu, ukukhipha, nokulinganisa
math-e6-ari2.concept: **Ukuyisa phezulu** kwenyusa konke okungaphansi kwendawo oyifunayo, **ukukhipha** kulahla konke. **Ukulinganisa** kwenyusa uma indawo ngqo engezansi ingu-5 noma ngaphezulu, futhi kulahle uma ingu-4 noma ngaphansi.
math-e6-ari2.example: 3472 ngezigidi ezingu-100: ukuyisa phezulu 3500, ukukhipha 3400, ukulinganisa 3500

math-e6-dat1.title: Igrafu yebhande negrafu yesiyingi
math-e6-dat1.concept: **Igrafu yebhande** ne-**igrafu yesiyingi** kubheka okuphelele njengo-100% futhi kukhombisa isilinganiso sengxenye ngayinye. Inani lengxenye=okuphelele×isilinganiso.

math-e6-geo1.title: Umjikelezo nendawo yesiyingi
math-e6-geo1.concept: Umjikelezo wesiyingi=ububanzi×i-pi, indawo yesiyingi=irediyasi×irediyasi×i-pi. I-pi iyi-$3.14$ ngokulinganiselwa.

math-e6-geo2.title: I-cuboid ne-cube
math-e6-geo2.concept: Ivolumu=ubude×ububanzi×ukuphakama, indawo engaphezulu=(isamba sendawo yobuso obuthathu)×2. I-cuboid inobuso obu-6, imiphetho eyi-12 namakhoneni angu-8.

math-e6-l1.title: Ukuphindaphinda nokuhlukanisa izingxenyana namadesimali
math-e6-l1.concept: Ekuphindaphindeni izingxenyana, phindaphinda izinombolo ezingaphezulu ndawonye nezihlukanisi ndawonye. Ekuhlukaniseni izingxenyana, phindaphinda nge-**reciprocal**.

math-e6-l2.title: Izibalo zesilinganiso nokwabelana ngesilinganiso
math-e6-l2.concept: Esibalweni sesilinganiso, **umphumela wezinombolo zangaphakathi = umphumela wezinombolo zangaphandle**. Ukuhlukanisa okuphelele ngesilinganiso kuyi-**ukwabelana ngesilinganiso**.

math-e6-l3.title: Iphesenti
math-e6-l3.concept: **Iphesenti (%)** yisilinganiso uma inani eliyisisekelo libhekwa njengo-100. Uma uphindaphinda idesimali ngo-100, kuba yi-%.

math-e6-l4.title: Isiyingi nezibalo ezi-solid
math-e6-l4.concept: Umjikelezo wesiyingi ngu-**ububanzi × 3.14**, indawo yesiyingi ngu-**irediyasi × irediyasi × 3.14**.

math-e6-l5.title: Isilinganiso nokuhlela idatha
math-e6-l5.concept: **Isilinganiso** yisamba ÷ inani, **i-median** inombolo emaphakathi, **i-mode** inombolo evela kaningi kakhulu.

math-el-ai1.title: Idatha yombhalo nesithombe
math-el-ai1.concept: Idokhumenti imelwa i-vector yokuvama kwamagama, nesithombe imelwa imatrikisi yamanani e-pixel. Uma i-dot product ye-vector inkulu, amadokhumenti afana kakhulu.

math-el-ai2.title: Ukubikezela nokwenza kube ngcono
math-el-ai2.concept: Thuthukisa ukubikezela nge-slope yomugqa wokuthambekela, isilinganiso sezikwele zephutha (ukulahlekelwa), ne-gradient descent $x_{new}=x-\eta f'(x)$.

math-el-cul1.title: Izibalo ezobuciko nasempilweni
math-el-cul1.concept: Isilinganiso segolide cishe 1.618, inothi i-octave ephezulu linemvamisa ephindwe kabili, inani lezindlela zamachashazi e-Braille ayi-6 ngu-$2^6-1=63$, iningi yinombolo ephezulu kunengxenye yonke.

math-el-cul2.title: Izibalo emphakathini nasemvelweni
math-el-cul2.concept: Hlaziya izinkinga zomphakathi nezemvelo ngezibalo usebenzisa isilinganiso sedatha nezinga lokukhula. Izinga lokukhula=(inani elengeziwe)÷(inani lokuqala)×100.
math-el-cul2.example: Kusuka ku-40 kuya ku-50 → ukukhula kwama-25%

math-el-econ1.title: Inzalo, izinga lokushintshisa nentela
math-el-econ1.concept: Inzalo elula=inkokhelo yokuqala×izinga×isikhathi, inzalo ehlanganisiwe yinkokhelo yokuqala×(1+izinga)^isikhathi. Izinga lokushintshisa liyinani leyunithi eyodwa yemali yangaphandle, nentela yizinga eliphindwa ngentengo.
math-el-econ1.example: 10000 won, 10% ngonyaka inzalo ehlanganisiwe iminyaka emi-2 → 12100 won

math-el-econ2.title: Isidingo, ukuhlinzeka nokwenza kube ngcono
math-el-econ2.concept: Lapho amajika esidingo nokuhlinzeka ehlangana khona yilapho kukhona ukulingana. Ukwanda kakhulu kwemali engenayo R=pq ne-elasticity kutholakala ngemisebenzi nama-derivative.

math-el-job1.title: Ukuguqula amayunithi nezilinganiso
math-el-job1.concept: 1 m=100 cm, 1 kg=1000 g, ihora eli-1=imizuzu engu-60. Intengo yokudingiswa=intengo×(1−izinga lokudingiswa), uma kuxutshwa ngesilinganiso a:b, u-A uyi-$\frac{a}{a+b}$ yonke.

math-el-job2.title: Indawo, izindlela ezingenzeka nezinga lokukhula
math-el-job2.concept: Thola inani lezinto eziyimfuneko ngendawo, inani lamapheya angenzeka ngomthetho womphumela, nezinga lokukhula ngo-(inani elengeziwe)÷(inani lokuqala)×100.
math-el-job2.example: Amahembe angu-4, amabhulukwe angu-3 → izindlela ezingu-12

math-el-res1.title: Izindlela zocwaningo
math-el-res1.concept: Ucwaningo lomsebenzi wezibalo lwenziwa ngezindlela ezifana nocwaningo lwezincwadi, lwezibonelo, ukuhlola kwezibalo, nocwaningo lokuthuthukisa.
math-el-res1.example: Ukujikijela i-dice ngokwakho ukuthola umthetho → ukuhlola kwezibalo

math-el-res2.title: Inqubo yocwaningo nesimilo socwaningo
math-el-res2.concept: Ucwaningo lwenziwa ngokulandelana: ukukhetha isihloko → uhlelo → ukwenza → ukwethula → ukuzindla. Isimilo socwaningo ukudalula imithombo nokungashintshi imiphumela.
math-el-res2.example: Ngemva kokukhetha isihloko kuza uhlelo locwaningo

math-el-sta1.title: Izinkinga zezibalo ezibalwayo nesampula
math-el-sta1.concept: I-standard deviation yimpande yesikwele yesilinganiso sezikwele zokuphambuka (i-variance). Isampula ikhethwa ngokukhetha okungahleliwe, okuhlukanisiwe, kweqoqo, nokuhlelekile njalonjalo.

math-el-sta2.title: Ukulinganisa nokuhlola isakhiwo
math-el-sta2.concept: Umkhawulo weqiniso we-95% confidence interval ngu-$1.96\times\frac{σ}{\sqrt{n} }$. Uma inani eliphelele le-test statistic $z=\frac{\bar{x}-\mu}{σ/\sqrt{n} }$ likhulu kuno-1.96, i-null hypothesis iyenqatshwa ezingeni lokubaluleka elingu-5%.

math-h1-fnc1.title: Imisebenzi ehlanganisiwe nephambene
math-h1-fnc1.concept: Umsebenzi ohlanganisiwe $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$ ubalwa kuqala ngomsebenzi ongaphakathi. Umsebenzi ophambene yilowo lapho uma $f(x)=y$, $f^{-1}(y)=x$.

math-h1-geo1.title: Izibalo ezibonakalayo endaweni yokuxhumanisa
math-h1-geo1.concept: Ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$, iphoyinti eliphakathi yisilinganiso sezixhumanisi, i-slope ngu-$\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$.

math-h1-geo2.title: Isibalo sendingilizi
math-h1-geo2.concept: Isibalo sendingilizi enenkabazwe $(a, b)$ nerediyasi $r$ singu-$(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$. Ibanga phakathi kwephoyinti $(x_0,y_0)$ nomugqa $ax+by+c=0$ lingu-$\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$.

math-h1-l1.title: Ukuhlukanisa ama-polynomial ne-remainder theorem
math-h1-l1.concept: Insalela lapho $P(x)$ ihlukaniswa ngo-$x-a$ ingu-$P(a)$, futhi uma $P(a)=0$ khona $x-a$ ungumsebenzisi (isici).

math-h1-l2.title: Izinombolo eziyinkimbinkimbi nokuhlukanisa isibalo se-quadratic
math-h1-l2.concept: $i^2=-1$, futhi uma i-discriminant $D=b^2-4ac<0$, kunezimpande eziyinkimbinkimbi. Isibalo se-quadratic esinama-coefficient angempela sinezimpande eziyinkimbinkimbi ezivela ngamapheya e-conjugate.

math-h1-l3.title: Ukungalingani kwe-quadratic
math-h1-l3.concept: Funda isixazululo ngendawo yegrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic ne-eksisi ye-$x$. $(x-a)(x-b)<0$ iphakathi kwezimpande ezimbili, $>0$ iphandle kwazo.

math-h1-l4.title: Ama-permutation nama-combination
math-h1-l4.concept: Uma ukulandelana kubalulekile, i-permutation $_nP_r$; uma kungabalulekile, i-combination $_nC_r$. Kwethi 'okungenani oyedwa', susa isehlakalo esiphambene kwisamba sonke.

math-h1-l5.title: Izibalo zomugqa nendingilizi
math-h1-l5.concept: Ibanga phakathi kwephoyinti nomugqa $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$, indingilizi $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$, futhi umugqa othintayo uqondile ku-rediyasi.

math-h1-mat1.title: Incazelo yama-matrix nokusebenza kwawo
math-h1-mat1.concept: **I-matrix** ukuhlelwa kwezinombolo ngesimo sosikwele esinde. Ukwengeza, ukukhipha nokuphindaphinda ngenombolo yangempela kwenziwa ngezingxenye ezisendaweni efanayo, futhi ingxenye (i, j) yomveli $AB$ ithathwa ngokuphindaphinda ngokulandelana izingxenye zomugqa wesi-i ka-$A$ nekholomu yesi-j ka-$B$ bese zihlanganiswa.

math-h1-pol1.title: I-factorization nezibalo zezinga lesithathu nelesine
math-h1-pol1.concept: Izibalo zezinga lesithathu nelesine zixazululwa ngokwenza **i-factorization** usebenzisa ukuhlukanisa okuhlanganisiwe noma ukushintshanisa, bese uthola amanani enza isici ngasinye sibe ngu-0. Esicini se-quadratic hlola nge-discriminant ukuthi kunezimpande zangempela yini.

math-h1-set1.title: Amasethi nezitatimende
math-h1-set1.concept: $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$, futhi isethi enamalungu ayi-n inamasethi angaphansi angu-$2^n$. Ukuphikisana nesitatimende 'uma p khona q' kunobuqiniso obufanayo nesitatimende sokuqala, kodwa okuphambene kungase kungabi njalo.

math-h2-geo1.title: Unxantathu nemisebenzi ye-trigonometric
math-h2-geo1.concept: Umthetho we-sine $\frac{a}{\sin A}=2R$, umthetho we-cosine $c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos C$, indawo kanxantathu $\frac12ab\sin C$.

math-h2-geo2.title: Ama-radian nesigaba sesiyingi
math-h2-geo2.concept: $180^\circ=\pi$ radian. Kusigaba sesiyingi esinerediyasi $r$ nengeli eliphakathi $\theta$ (ama-radian), ubude bomphetho bungu-$r\theta$ nendawo ingu-$\frac12r^2\theta$.

math-h2-l1.title: Ama-exponent nama-logarithm
math-h2-l1.concept: $\log_a b=x \iff a^x=b$. Isamba sama-logarithm siyi-logarithm yomphumela, umehluko uyi-logarithm yokuhlukanisa. Ukukhula kwe-exponential kuboniswa nge-$a\cdot r^t$.

math-h2-l2.title: Imisebenzi ye-trigonometric
math-h2-l2.concept: $\pi$ radian $=180^\circ$. Uphawu lwe-$\sin,\ \cos,\ \tan$ luyahluka ku-quadrant ngayinye. $y=a\sin bx+c$ inenani eliphezulu $|a|+c$ nenkathi $\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$.

math-h2-l4.title: Umkhawulo nokuqhubeka komsebenzi
math-h2-l4.concept: Uhlobo lwe-$\frac00$ ulwenza i-factorization bese wenza lula, futhi ku-$x\to\infty$ hlukanisa ngethemu elinezinga eliphezulu kakhulu. Uma kuqhubeka, umkhawulo wesokunxele, owesokudla nenani lomsebenzi konke kuyalingana.

math-h2-l5.title: I-differentiation nokusetshenziswa kwayo
math-h2-l5.concept: $(x^n)'=nx^{n-1}$. $f'(a)$ ithambeka lomugqa othintayo, futhi ngophawu luka-$f'$ ungazi ukukhula, ukwehla namanani aphezulu nabaphansi. Isivinini yi-derivative yokuma.

math-h2-seq1.title: Isamba sokulandelana ne-∑
math-h2-seq1.concept: $\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k$ kusho $a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_n$. $\sum k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum c=cn$, $\sum(a_k+b_k)=\sum a_k+\sum b_k$.

math-h3-cal1.title: I-differentiation yemisebenzi ehlukahlukene
math-h3-cal1.concept: I-composite function iba-differentiated nge-(i-derivative yomsebenzi wangaphandle)×(i-derivative yomsebenzi wangaphakathi), nesilinganiso nge-$\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^2}$. $(e^x)'=e^x$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$, $(\sin x)'=\cos x$, $(\cos x)'=-\sin x$.

math-h3-cnt1.title: Ama-permutation nama-combination anokuphindaphinda ne-binomial theorem
math-h3-cnt1.concept: Inani le-**permutation enokuphindaphinda** (ukuhlela emgqeni kuvunyelwe ukuphindaphinda) liyisiphumo sokuphindaphinda inani lezinketho izikhathi ezilingana nenani lezindawo. I-permutation enezinto ezifanayo yi-factorial yonke ehlukaniswe nama-factorial ezinto ezifanayo, kanti **i-combination enokuphindaphinda** ingu-$_nH_r={}_{n+r-1}C_r$. Ku-$(x+1)^n$, i-coefficient ka-$x^k$ ingu-$_nC_k$.

math-h3-geo1.title: Amajika e-quadratic
math-h3-geo1.concept: Indawo yokugxila ye-parabola $y^2=4px$ ngu-$(p,0)$, ku-ellipse $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ $c^2=a^2-b^2$, futhi ku-hyperbola $c^2=a^2+b^2$.

math-h3-geo2.title: Ama-vector ephlani
math-h3-geo2.concept: Usayizi we-vector $(x,y)$ ungu-$\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$, i-dot product ingu-$x_1x_2+y_1y_2$, futhi uma ama-vector amabili eqondene, i-dot product ingu-0.

math-h3-l1.title: I-integral engahleliwe nehleliwe
math-h3-l1.concept: $\int x^n dx=\frac{x^{n+1} }{n+1}+C$, $\int_a^b f(x)dx=F(b)-F(a)$. Uma ushintshanisa imikhawulo ephezulu nephansi uphawu luyashintsha, futhi isikhawu singahlukaniswa.

math-h3-l2.title: Ukusetshenziswa kwe-integral ehleliwe
math-h3-l2.concept: Indawo ithola ngokuhlanganisa $|f(x)|$. Hlukanisa ingxenye yegrafu engaphansi kwe-eksisi ye-$x$, futhi phakathi kwamajika amabili hlanganisa (okuphezulu)−(okuphansi). I-integral yesivinini ibanga eligcwalisiwe.

math-h3-l3.title: Uchungechunge lwe-geometric
math-h3-l3.concept: Uma $|r|<1$, $\sum ar^{n-1}=\frac{a}{1-r}$ iyahlangana, futhi uma $|r|\ge 1$ iyahlukana. Isetshenziswa kumadesimali aphindaphindwayo nasekunyakazeni okuphindaphindwayo.

math-h3-l4.title: Ithuba elinemibandela nokuzimela
math-h3-l4.concept: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$. Uma kuzimele, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, futhi ukuzama okuzimele kungu-$_nC_k\,p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$.

math-h3-l5.title: I-binomial distribution ne-normal distribution
math-h3-l5.concept: Isilinganiso se-$B(n,p)$ ngu-$np$, i-variance ngu-$np(1-p)$. I-normal distribution ijwayelaniswa ngo-$Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$, futhi ilinganisile ngokwesilinganiso.

math-h3-pro1.title: Umthetho wokwengeza wamathuba nesehlakalo esiphikisayo
math-h3-pro1.concept: $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Ithuba lesehlakalo esiphikisayo ngu-$P(A^c)=1-P(A)$.

math-l1.title: Ukuthola inani lesisho
math-l1.concept: Ukufaka inombolo esikhundleni sohlamvu kubizwa ngokuthi **ukufaka esikhundleni**. Umphumela wokubala ngemva kokufaka esikhundleni ngu-**inani lesisho**. Uma ufaka izinombolo ezingaphansi kwezero, sebenzisa amabhulakethi ukuncishisa amaphutha.

math-l2.title: Izakhiwo zokulingana
math-l2.concept: Isibalo sinjengesikali. Uma wengeza noma uncisha inombolo efanayo ezinhlangothini zombili, noma uphindaphinda noma uhlukanisa (ngenombolo engeyona u-0), isikali sihlala silinganisiwe.
math-l2.example: Uma uncisha u-$5$ ezinhlangothini zombili ze-$x+5=9$, $x=4$.

math-l3.title: Ukuxazulula izibalo zomugqa
math-l3.concept: **Hambisa** amathemu aqukethe u-$x$ ohlangothini olulodwa nezinombolo ohlangothini olwehlukile. Uma uhambisa, uphawu luyashintsha. Ekugcineni hlukanisa ngenombolo ethi-$x$ ukuze uqede!

math-l4.title: Ukuxazulula izinkinga ngezibalo
math-l4.concept: Izinkinga zamazwi ziyaxazululwa ngalolu hlelo: **beka into oyifunayo njengo-$x$** → uguqulele umusho ube yisibalo → uxazulule → uhlole ukuthi impendulo ifanela izimo.
math-l4.example: Uma wengeza $2$ ku-$3$ izikhathi zenombolo ethile kuba $14$ → $3x+2=14$ → $x=4$

math-m1-crd1.title: Indiza yokuxhumanisa
math-m1-crd1.concept: Indawo yephoyinti ibonisa nge-(x-coordinate, y-coordinate). Ngokuya ngezimpawu, kunqunywa ama-quadrant 1 kuya ku-4, futhi ekukhonjisweni ngokuya ku-eksisi ka-x, uphawu lwe-y-coordinate luyashintsha.

math-m1-fac1.title: I-prime factorization, GCD ne-LCM
math-m1-fac1.concept: Ukubonisa inombolo yemvelo njengomphumela wama-prime numbers kuyi-**prime factorization**. Isihlukanisi esivamile esikhulu kakhulu yi-**GCD**, futhi okuphindwe okuvamile okuncane kakhulu yi-**LCM**.

math-m1-geo1.title: Izakhiwo zama-engeli nama-polygon
math-m1-geo1.concept: Ama-vertical angles ayalingana, futhi emigqeni ehambisanayo ama-corresponding angles nama-alternate angles ayalingana. Isamba sama-engeli angaphakathi e-$n$-gon ngu-$180^\circ\times(n-2)$.

math-m1-geo2.title: Isigaba sesiyingi nokulinganisa ama-solid
math-m1-geo2.concept: Ubude be-arc $=2\pi r\times\frac{a}{360}$, indawo yesigaba $=\pi r^2\times\frac{a}{360}$, ivolumu ye-sphere $=\frac43\pi r^3$, ivolumu ye-cone $=\frac13\pi r^2h$.

math-m1-neg1.title: Ukubala izinombolo ezipheleleyo nezilinganisiwe
math-m1-neg1.concept: Uma wengeza izinombolo ezimbili ezinophawu olufanayo, wengeza amanani aphelele; uma izimpawu zihlukile, thatha umehluko wamanani aphelele bese ufaka uphawu lwenombolo enkulu. Ekuphindaphindeni nasekuhlukaniseni, uma izimpawu zifanayo kuba +, uma zihlukile kuba -.

math-m1-prp1.title: Ukulingana ngokuqondile nokuphambene
math-m1-prp1.concept: **Ukulingana ngokuqondile** kunefomu elingu-y=ax, **ukulingana okuphambene** kunefomu elingu-$y=\frac{a}{x}$. Ekulinganeni ngokuqondile, y÷x iyahlala; ekulinganeni okuphambene, x×y iyahlala.
math-m1-prp1.example: Ukulingana ngokuqondile lapho x=2, y=6: y=3x

math-m1-sta1.title: Amanani amelela nokuvama okuhlobene
math-m1-sta1.concept: **I-median** ivelu emaphakathi uma kuhlelwe ngosayizi, **i-mode** ivelu evela kakhulu kunawo wonke. **Ukuvama okuhlobene**=(ukuvama)÷(ukuvama okuphelele).

math-m2-geo1.title: Izimpawu zonxantathu nezikwele
math-m2-geo1.concept: Ama-engeli amabili esisekelo kanxantathu onohlangothi olulinganayo ayafana. Kunxantathu onohlangothi olufanayo ku-parallelogram, isamba sama-engeli amabili alandelanayo singu-$180^\circ$, futhi ucezu oluxhuma amaphoyinti aphakathi ezinhlangothini ezimbili zikanxantathu lungu-$\frac12$ lohlangothi olusele.

math-m2-geo2.title: Ukufana ne-theorem kaPythagoras
math-m2-geo2.concept: Izimo ezifanayo zinesilinganiso esifanayo sezinhlangothi ezihambisanayo, futhi isilinganiso sezindawo siyisikwele sesilinganiso sokufana. Kunxantathu olungile, $a^2+b^2=c^2$.

math-m2-l1.title: Imithetho ye-exponent nama-polynomial
math-m2-l1.concept: Uma kuphindaphindwa izisekelo ezifanayo, engeza ama-exponent, futhi amandla amandla ayaphindaphindwa ama-exponent. Nge-polynomial, qoqa amatemu anohlamvu olufanayo bese ubala.

math-m2-l2.title: Izibalo ze-linear ezifanayo
math-m2-l2.concept: Susa uhlamvu olulodwa ezibalweni ezimbili ukuze uthole isixazululo. Khetha indlela yokungeza nokususa noma yokufaka esikhundleni ngokuya ngesimo.

math-m2-l3.title: Ukungalingani kwe-linear
math-m2-l3.concept: Kuxazululwa ngokufana nezakhiwo zokulingana, kodwa uma uphindaphinda noma uhlukanisa ngenombolo engenayo, isiqondiso sophawu lokungalingani siyashintsha.

math-m2-l4.title: Imisebenzi ye-linear namagrafu
math-m2-l4.concept: Ku-$y=ax+b$, $a$ yi-slope, $b$ yi-$y$ intercept. Imigqa ehambisanayo inama-slope afanayo.

math-m2-l5.title: Inani lezimo nethuba
math-m2-l5.concept: Ithuba ngu-(inani lezimo ezenzekayo)÷(inani lezimo zonke). Imicimbi ezimele eyenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa iyaphindaphindwa, futhi 'okungenani' kusebenzisa umcimbi ophikisanayo.

math-m2-lfn1.title: Imisebenzi ye-linear nezibalo ze-linear
math-m2-lfn1.concept: Emsebenzini we-linear y=ax+b, a yi-slope, b yi-y intercept. Iphoyinti lapho amagrafu amabili ehlangana khona liyisixazululo sezibalo ezimbili ezihlangene.

math-m2-rec1.title: Amadesimali aphindaphindwayo
math-m2-rec1.concept: Idesimali eliphindaphinda inombolo efanayo njalo ngemva kwephoyinti ledesimali libizwa ngokuthi **idesimali eliphindaphindwayo**, futhi ingxenye ephindaphindwayo ibizwa ngokuthi **inkathi ephindaphindwayo**. Uma isihlukanisi sengxenyana engenakwehliswa singu-2 noma u-5 kuphela, idesimali liyaphela.

math-m3-geo1.title: Izilinganiso ze-trigonometric
math-m3-geo1.concept: Kunxantathu olungile, $\sin A$ ngu-(ubude)÷(i-hypotenuse), $\cos A$ ngu-(isisekelo)÷(i-hypotenuse), $\tan A$ ngu-(ubude)÷(isisekelo).

math-m3-geo2.title: Izimpawu zosiyingi
math-m3-geo2.concept: I-engeli esigombeni senhlanganisela eyodwa iyingxenye engu-$\frac12$ ye-engeli esembindini. I-tangent ime ngqo kurediyasi, futhi kusikwele esilotshwe ngaphakathi kosiyingi, isamba sama-engeli aphambene singu-$180^\circ$.

math-m3-l1.title: Impande yesikwele nezinombolo zangempela
math-m3-l1.concept: $\sqrt{a}$ yinombolo engeyona engaphansi kwezero ethi uma yenziwa isikwele ibe ngu-$a$. Isikwele esingaphakathi kwempande sikhishelwa ngaphandle, futhi impande esihlukanisini iyenziwa ibe nengqondo (rationalize).

math-m3-l2.title: Ama-formula okuphindaphinda nokwenza ama-factor
math-m3-l2.concept: $(a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2$, $(a+b)(a-b)=a^2-b^2$. Ukwenza ama-factor kusebenzisa ama-formula okuphindaphinda ngokuphambene.

math-m3-l3.title: Izibalo ze-quadratic
math-m3-l3.concept: Xazulula ngokwenza isimo se-$AB=0$ ngokwenza ama-factor. I-discriminant $D=b^2-4ac$ ikutshela inani lezimpande, futhi ungasebenzisa nobudlelwano bezimpande nama-coefficient.

math-m3-l4.title: Imisebenzi ye-quadratic namagrafu
math-m3-l4.concept: I-vertex ye-$y=a(x-p)^2+q$ ngu-$(p,\ q)$, futhi uphawu lwe-$a$ luncoma isiqondiso sokuvuleka. Ungathola i-vertex ngokuyiguqula ibe yisikwele esiphelele.

math-m3-l5.title: Izilinganiso ze-trigonometry
math-m3-l5.concept: Kunxantathu onekhoneni elilungile, $\sin A=\frac{\text{obuphambene} }{\text{i-hypotenuse} }$, $\cos A=\frac{\text{obumelene} }{\text{i-hypotenuse} }$, $\tan A=\frac{\text{obuphambene} }{\text{obumelene} }$.

math-m3-sta1.title: I-variance ne-standard deviation
math-m3-sta1.concept: **Ukwehluka**=(inani)−(isilinganiso). **I-variance** isilinganiso sezikwele zokwehluka, futhi **i-standard deviation** impande eyisikwele evumayo ye-variance. Uma inani likhulu, idatha ihlakazeke kakhulu isuka esilinganisweni.

Amanani ka-x enza isici ngasinye sibe ngu-0 yizimpande.
quadRoot.explanation: Ku-${fact}$, izimpande ziyi-{roots}, ngakho impande enkulu ngu-{ans}.

radDeg.prompt: Uma $\theta=\dfrac{{num}}{{d}}$ (ama-radian) ibhalwa ngamadigri (°), ingu-digri emangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)

Faka u-180° esikhundleni sika-$\pi$.

Ungashintsha nengxenyana ukuze isihlukanisi sibe ngu-100.

rectArea.prompt: Indawo yonxande onobubanzi obungu-{w}cm nobude obungu-{h}cm ingu-cm² emangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)

Phindaphinda ubude bezinhlangothi ezimbili.

Ungawuthola nge-(ububanzi+ubude)×2.

Bhala umphumela wokuhlukanisa njengedesimali.

Faka u-a esikhundleni sika-x bese ubala.

repComb.prompt: Zingaki izindlela zokukhetha izinto ezingu-{r} ezinhlotsheni ezihlukene ezingu-{n}, kuvunyelwe ukuphinda?

Isikhundla ngasinye singathola izinto ezingu-{n}.

hints: Yihlukanise ibe yizici ngohlobo lomphumela we-(isisho somugqa). Ungathola nempande eyodwa kuqala ngendlela yokuhlanganisa.

rootMax.explanation: Ngoba {fact}, izimpande zangempela ziyi-{roots}, futhi enkulu kakhulu ngu-{ans}.

rootSum.prompt: Siyini isamba sazo zonke izimpande zangempela ze-equation {eq}?
hints: Yihlukanise ibe yizici ngohlobo lomphumela we-(isisho somugqa). Ungathola nempande eyodwa kuqala ngendlela yokuhlanganisa.
Amanani ka-x lapho isici ngasinye siba ngu-0 angezimpande ze-equation.
rootSum.explanation: Ngoba {fact}, izimpande zangempela ziyi-{roots}, futhi isamba sazo ngu-{ans}.

hints: Ukuze ubhale ngeyunithi ye-{u}, bheka izikhundla ezingaphansi kwe-{u}.
Ukuyisondeza phezulu kunyusa, ukuyisondeza phansi kulahla, futhi ekuyilinganiseni uma ngu-5 noma ngaphezulu kuyanyuka.

hints: Thola umehluko phakathi kwezinombolo ezimbili eziseduze.
Zikhula noma zehla ngenani elifanayo.

setCount.prompt: Uma $n(A)={na}$, $n(B)={nb}$, $n(A\cap B)={nab}$, liyini inani lika-$n(A\cup B)$?
hints: $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$.
Faka amanani anikeziwe ngokulandelana bese ubala.
∑ kusho ukufaka k kusukela ku-1 ngokulandelana bese uzengeza zonke.
Ungasebenzisa nezakhiwo ezifana no-$\sum k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum c=cn$.

simpleInterest.prompt: Uma kufakwa inani eliyisisekelo elingu-{p} won ngenzalo elula ye-{r}% ngonyaka ngeminyaka engu-{n}, inzalo isiyonke ingu-won emangaki? (won)
hints: Inzalo elula = inani eliyisisekelo×izinga×isikhathi.
I-{r}% iyi-{rr}.

slope2.prompt: Uyini umthambeka womugqa odlula emaphoyinti amabili $({x1},\,{y1})$, $({x2},\,{y2})$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Umthambeka ngu-(ukwanda kuka-y)÷(ukwanda kuka-x).
Hlukanisa umehluko wama-y ngomehluko wama-x ephoyintini ngalinye.
Ku-$y=ax+b$, u-a ungumthambeka.
Funda i-coefficient ka-x.
Engeza noma ususe inombolo efanayo ezinhlangothini zombili ukuze ushiye kuphela itemu lika-x ohlangothini olulodwa.
Hlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngenombolo engaphambi kuka-x.
$\sqrt{a}\times\sqrt{b}=\sqrt{ab}$.
Hlola ukuthi umphumela wokuphindaphinda uyisikwele esiphelele yini.
Thola inombolo eyiphozithivu esikwele sayo singu-{n}.
Khumbula ithebula lokuphindaphinda.

stdev.prompt: Iyini i-standard deviation yedatha {list}? (I-standard deviation yesibalo sabantu sonke)
hints: Qala uthole isilinganiso.
Impande yesikwele yesilinganiso sezikwele zokuphambuka (i-variance) i-standard deviation.
stdev.explanation: Ngoba isilinganiso ngu-{mean} ne-variance ngu-{var}, i-standard deviation ngu-{ans}.

hints: Susa ngokulandelana kusukela esikhundleni seyunithi.
Uma ungakwazi ukususa, landa esikhundleni esiphezulu.

subsetCount.prompt: Isethi enezinto ezingu-{n} inamasethi angaphansi angaki sizonke?
hints: Inani lamasethi angaphansi esethi enezinto ezingu-n ngu-$2^n$.
Cabanga ngokunquma ukuthi into ngayinye iyafakwa noma cha.

taxTotal.prompt: Umkhiqizo ongu-{p} won uma wengezwa intela yenani elingeziwe engu-{t}%, inani okufanele likhokhwe lingu-won emangaki? (won)
hints: Intela ngu-intengo×{t}%.
Engeza intela entengweni.

tensDigit.prompt: Siyini isifanekiso sendawo yeshumi ku-${n}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Yinombolo yesibili kusukela kwesokudla.
Thola inombolo eseduze kwesokunxele kweyunithi.
Cabanga ngethebula lokuphindaphinda noma ngamaqoqo.
Izinombolo ezinkulu zihlukanise ngezikhundla, uphindaphinde, bese wengeza.

triThird.prompt: Amakhoneni amabili kunxantathu angu-{a}° no-{b}°. Ikhoneni elisele lingamadigri amangaki? (digri)
hints: Isamba samakhoneni amathathu kunxantathu singu-180°.
Susa amakhoneni amabili aziwayo ku-180.
Qala uthole isilinganiso, bese uthola ukuphambuka kwedatha ngayinye.
Isilinganiso sezikwele zokuphambuka yi-variance.
variance.explanation: Isilinganiso ngu-{mean}, isamba sezikwele zokuphambuka ngu-{sq}, ngakho i-variance ngu-{sq}÷{n}={ans}.

hints: Yenza isikwele ingxenye ngayinye, wengeze, bese uthola impande yesikwele.

vertexSum.prompt: Uma izixhumanisi zencopho ye-quadratic function $y={expr}$ ziyi-$(p,\ q)$, inani le-$p+q$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ngefomu elithi $y=a(x-p)^2+q$, incopho ngu-$(p,\ q)$.
Qaphela izimpawu ezingaphakathi kwamabulaketi.
I-x-intercept yinani le-x lapho y=0.
Xazulula $0=ax+b$.
I-y-intercept yinani le-y lapho x=0.
Ku-$y=ax+b$ ngu-b.

ai_bayesSpam.prompt: Phakathi kwama-imeyili amukelwe, ${s}\%$ yi-spam. Ku-${p}\%$ yama-imeyili e-spam kunegama elithile, futhi ku-${q}\%$ yama-imeyili angeyona i-spam nakho kunalelo gama. Uma kukhethwa i-imeyili eyodwa enalelo gama, ithuba lokuthi ibe yi-spam liyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Cabanga ukuthi kunama-imeyili angu-$100$ (noma angu-$10000$) bese ubala inani lesimo ngasinye.
Kuyi-(inani lama-spam anegama) ÷ (inani lonke lama-imeyili anegama).
ai_bayesSpam.explanation: Phakathi kwama-imeyili angu-$10000$, i-spam ingu-${s2}$ futhi kuyo ayi-${a}$ anegama, futhi phakathi kwama-imeyili angu-${h2}$ angeyona i-spam, ayi-${b}$ anegama. Ngakho ithuba lingu-$\frac{{a}}{{a}+{b}}$ futhi ngengxenyana engaguquki yi-${fr}$.

ai_convolve.prompt: Faka isihlungi $K={ker}$ esithombeni $I={img}$ usishintsha ikhelisi elilodwa ngesikhathi. Kuyo yonke indawo, phindaphinda izingxenye ezihlangana nesihlungi bese uzihlanganisa. Isamba sazo zonke izingxenye ze-matrix (i-feature map) eqoqwe kulawo manani siyini? Izindawo lapho isihlungi sikhishelwa ngaphandle kwesithombe azisetshenziswa, futhi azigcwaliswa ngo-0. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Beka isihlungi ekhoneni eliphezulu kwesokunxele lesithombe, uphindaphinde izingxenye ezihlangene bese uzihlanganisa; leli yinani lokuqala le-feature map.
Shintsha isihlungi ngekhelisi elilodwa ngakwesokudla nangaphansi bese uphinda ukubala okufanayo.
ai_convolve.explanation: I-feature map ngu-${out}$, futhi isamba sazo zonke izingxenye ngu-${ans}$.

ai_cosine.prompt: Kumadokhumenti amabili A, B, ama-frequency vector abhala inani lokuvela kwamagama kudikishinari ngokulandelana kwawo yi-$\vec{a}={va}$, $\vec{b}={vb}$. Inani le-cosine similarity $\dfrac{\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|}$ yamadokhumenti womabili liyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthole i-dot product $\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}$ ngokuphindaphinda izingxenye bese uzihlanganisa.
Ubude bama-vector amabili $|\vec{a}|$, $|\vec{b}|$ buyimpande yesikwele yesamba sezikwele zezingxenye ngayinye. Zombili ziyizinombolo zemvelo.

ai_flipTranspose.prompt: Ukukhanya kwesithombe esingu-$3\times4$ kumelelwa yi-matrix $A={mat}$. Vumela i-matrix yesithombe esiphendulwe ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla ngokuguqula ukulandelana kwezingxenye emgqeni ngamunye ibe yi-$B$, futhi i-transpose ye-$B$ ibe yi-$C$. Yiyiphi ingxenye yomugqa {i} wekholomu {j} ye-$C$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala wenze i-$B$ ngokubhala umugqa ngamunye we-$A$ ubuyela emuva.
I-transpose iyi-matrix lapho imigqa namakholomu kushintshiwe, ngakho i-$C$ iyi-matrix engu-$4\times3$.

ai_gradMse.prompt: Ngemodeli $\hat{y}=wx$, kuqagelwa amaphoyinti {pts}. I-loss function iyi-$L(w)=\dfrac{1}{n}\sum(wx_i-y_i)^2$ ($n$ yinani lamaphoyinti). Ku-$w_0={w0}$, inani le-$w_1=w_0-\eta L'(w_0)$ ngemuva kokusebenzisa i-gradient descent kanye ngesilinganiso sokufunda $\eta={eta}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: $L'(w)=\dfrac{2}{n}\sum x_i(wx_i-y_i)$.
Faka $w=w_0$ uthole ukuthambeka $L'(w_0)$ kuqala.

ai_gradStep.prompt: Uma i-loss function iyi-$L(w)={lw}$, sifuna ukwehlisa leli nani nge-gradient descent. $w_{n+1}=w_n-\eta L'(w_n)$, isilinganiso sokufunda $\eta={eta}$, inani lokuqala $w_0={w0}$, inani le-$w_{{t}}$ ngemuva kokubuyekeza izikhathi ezingu-{t} liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uthole i-$L'(w)$.
Bala ngokulandelana $w_1$, $w_2$, ... kusukela ku-$w_0$.

ai_jaccard.prompt: Amagama esichazamazwi anikezwe izinombolo kusukela ku-$1$ kuya ku-$12$. Isethi yezinombolo zamagama avela kudokhumenti A ngu-$A=\{{sa}\}$, nedokhumenti B ngu-$B=\{{sb}\}$. Inani le-Jaccard similarity $\dfrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A\cup B)}$ yamadokhumenti amabili liyini? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: $A\cap B$ yisethi yezinombolo zamagama avela kumadokhumenti womabili.
$n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$.
ai_jaccard.explanation: $n(A\cap B)={ni}$, $n(A\cup B)={nu}$, ngakho $\frac{{ni}}{{nu}}$, futhi lapho le ngxenyana ibhalwa ngendlela elula kakhulu, ngu-${fr}$.

ai_jaccardRev.prompt: Kudokhumenti A kuvela amagama ahlukene angu-${na}$, kudokhumenti B angu-${nb}$. Uma amasethi amagama amadokhumenti amabili engu-$A$, $B$, i-Jaccard similarity $\dfrac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A\cup B)}$ ingu-$\dfrac{{jp}}{{jq}}$. Mangaki amagama ahlukene avela kumadokhumenti womabili? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma inani lamagama ajwayelekile ngu-$x$, $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-x$.
Xazulula $\dfrac{x}{{na}+{nb}-x}=\dfrac{{jp}}{{jq}}$ njenge-equation ka-$x$.

ai_mseLoss.prompt: Ngamaphoyinti {pts}, inani le-mean squared error (MSE) $\dfrac{1}{n}\sum(y_i-\hat{y}_i)^2$ ye-linear model $\hat{y}={model}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uthole iphutha $y_i-\hat{y}_i$ ephoyintini ngalinye.
Yenza isikwele samaphutha, uwengeze wonke, bese uhlukanisa ngenani lamaphoyinti $n={np}$.
ai_mseLoss.explanation: Amaphutha angu-${res}$ futhi isamba sezikwele singu-${sq}$, ngakho i-MSE ngu-$\frac{{tot}}{{np}}={ans}$.

ai_pixelBright.prompt: Ukukhanya kwe-pixel (0~255) yesithombe esimnyama nesimhlophe kuboniswe ngo-matrix $A={mat}$. Ukukhanyisa isithombe, ukukhanya $p$ kwawo wonke ama-pixel kushintshwa kube ngu-$\min(255,\ {a}p+{b})$. (Amanani adlula ku-255 aba ngu-255.) Isamba sazo zonke izingxenye ze-matrix yesithombe esishintshile siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bala inani le-${a}p+{b}$ engxenyeni ngayinye $p$ kuqala, futhi uma likhulu kuno-255, lishintshele ku-255.
Ngemuva kokubhala yonke i-matrix entsha, engeza zonke izingxenye.
ai_pixelBright.explanation: I-matrix entsha ngu-$B={res}$, futhi isamba sazo zonke izingxenye ngu-${ans}$.

hints: Thola isilinganiso sika-$x$ $\bar{x}$ nesilinganiso sika-$y$ $\bar{y}$. Umugqa wokuthambekela udlula ephoyintini $(\bar{x},\bar{y})$.
I-slope $a=\dfrac{\sum(x_i-\bar{x})(y_i-\bar{y})}{\sum(x_i-\bar{x})^2}$.

alg_arithFirstExceeds.prompt: Isamba kusukela ebinzaneni lokuqala kuya ebinzaneni lesi-$n$ lochungechunge lwe-arithmetic olunebinzana lokuqala ${a}$ nomehluko ovamile ${d}$ siyi-$S_n$. Uma $S_n>{N}$, linini inani elincane kakhulu lenombolo yemvelo $n$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bhala $S_n=\frac{n(2a+(n-1)d)}{2}$ njenge-quadratic ka-$n$.
Xazulula ukungalingani kwe-quadratic noma ufake $n=1,2,3,\dots$ ngokulandelana uthole lapho kudlula khona okokuqala.
alg_arithFirstExceeds.explanation: $S_n=\frac{n(2\times{ab}+(n-1)\times{d})}{2}$, futhi lapho $n=1,2,\dots,{m1}$, $S_n$ yonke ingu-${N}$ noma ngaphansi (inani elikhulu kakhulu ${s1}$), futhi $S_{{ans}}={s2}>{N}$, ngakho $n$ efunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

alg_arithGeoMix.prompt: Izinombolo ezintathu $x$, $y$, $z$ zakha i-arithmetic sequence ngalokhu kulandelana enomehluko ovamile ophozithivu futhi $x+y+z={S}$. Ngakho izinombolo ezintathu $x$, $y$, $z+{k}$ zakha i-geometric sequence ngalokhu kulandelana. Umehluko ovamile uyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma umehluko ovamile ungu-$d$, $x=y-d$, $z=y+d$ futhi $3y=S$.
Faka esimeni se-geometric sequence $y^{2}=x(z+k)$ ukuze wakhe i-quadratic equation ngo-$d$.
alg_arithGeoMix.explanation: $y=\frac{{S}}{3}={y}$ futhi $x={y}-d$, $z={y}+d$, ngakho ${y}^{2}=({y}-d)({y}+d+{k})$, okungukuthi $d^{2}+{k}d-{yk}=0$. Ngoba umehluko ovamile uphozithivu, $d={ans}$.

alg_arithSumMax.prompt: Ku-arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$, uma $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, inani eliphezulu lesamba $S_n$ sethemu lokuqala kuya kwelesi-$n$ liyini? ($n$ iyinombolo yemvelo) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bheka uphawu lomehluko ovamile; isamba sikhula kuphela uma amathemu ephozithivu.
Ngemva kokuthola ithemu lokuqala nomehluko ovamile, bala isamba kuze kube ngaphambi kwethemu lokuqala elingu-$0$ noma elingaphansi.
alg_arithSumMax.explanation: Ithemu lokuqala ngu-${a1}$, umehluko ovamile ngu-${d}$, ngakho $a_n>0$ uma $n\le{nm}$ futhi $a_{{nm1}}\le0$. Ngakho inani eliphezulu ngu-$S_{{nm}}=\frac{{nm}(2\times{a1}+({nm}-1)\times({d}))}{2}={ans}$.

alg_arithTwoTerms.prompt: Ku-arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$, uma $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, inani le-$a_{{r}}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Thola umehluko ovamile $d$ ngo-$a_q-a_p=(q-p)d$.
$a_r=a_p+(r-p)d$.

alg_arithTwoTermsQ.prompt: Ku-arithmetic sequence $\{a_n\}$, uma $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, inani le-$a_{{r}}$ liyini? (Ungabhala njengedesimali noma njengengxenyana efana no-3/4)
hints: Thola umehluko ovamile $d$ ngo-$a_q-a_p=(q-p)d$.
$a_r=a_p+(r-p)d$.

alg_circumradius.prompt: Kunxantathu ABC, uma $\overline{B C}={side}$ futhi ${cond}$, ubude be-radius yesiyingi esiphuma kunxantathu ABC buyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa umthetho we-sine $\frac{a}{\sin A}=2R$ ($a=\overline{B C}$).
Uma inani le-cosine linikeziwe, qala uthole u-$\sin A$ usebenzisa ukuthi $\sin A>0$.

alg_collatz.prompt: I-sequence $\{a_n\}$ ichazwa ngo-$a_1={s}$, uma $a_n$ iyinombolo ephindwayo, $a_{n+1}=\frac{a_{n}}{2}$, uma $a_n$ iyinombolo engaphindwayo, $a_{n+1}={odd}$. Inani elincane kakhulu lenombolo yemvelo $n$ elenza $a_n=1$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bala amathemu kusuka ku-$a_1$ ngokulandelana, usebenzisa isisho esifanele izinombolo ezinjwayo nezingaphindwayo.
Bala inombolo yethemu lapho u-$1$ avela khona okokuqala.
alg_collatz.explanation: Uma ubala amathemu ngokulandelana, ${work}$, ngakho u-$1$ uvela okokuqala ethemini lesi-${ans}$.

alg_cosLawSide.prompt: Kunxantathu ABC, uma $\overline{B C}={a}$, $\overline{C A}={b}$ futhi ${cond}$, ubude be-$\overline{A B}$ buyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Sebenzisa umthetho we-cosine $c^{2}=a^{2}+b^{2}-2ab\cos C$.
$\cos60^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\cos120^\circ=-\frac{1}{2}$, futhi ubude buphozithivu.

alg_coterminal.prompt: Phakathi kwama-engeli anohlangothi lokugcina olufanayo ne-engeli enobukhulu ${theta}$, iyiphi i-engeli engu-$0^\circ$ noma ngaphezulu futhi engaphansi kuka-$360^\circ$ ngamadigri? (Bhala inombolo yamadigri kuphela)
hints: Ama-engeli anohlangothi lokugcina olufanayo ahluka ngo-$360^\circ\times n$ (noma $2n\pi$).
Uma inikezwe ngama-radian, qala uyiguqule ibe ngamadigri ($\pi=180^\circ$).

alg_digitsPow.prompt: Uma ${given}$, thola inani lamadijithi ka-${N}$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma inombolo ephelele ephozithivu $M$ inamadijithi angu-$k$, $k-1\le\log M<k$.
Bala i-common logarithm ka-${N}$ usebenzisa inani elinikeziwe.
alg_digitsPow.explanation: $\log({N})={lg}$ futhi ingxenye ephelele ngu-${ip}$, ngakho iyinombolo enamadijithi angu-${ans}$.

alg_expEquation.prompt: Isamba sazo zonke izimpande zangempela ze-equation ${eq}$ siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma amabinzana anesibalo esifanayo enziwa ngu-$t$, ayi-quadratic equation lapho $t>0$.
Ngemuva kokuthola amanani ka-$t$, buyisela ngayinye ibe inani lika-$x$.

alg_expFuncParams.prompt: Ngomsebenzi $f(x)=a\cdot b^{x}$ ($a\ne0$, $b>0$, $b\ne1$), uma $f({p})={u}$, $f({q})={v}$, linini inani le-$f({r})$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ku-$\frac{f(q)}{f(p)}=b^{q-p}$, qala uthole u-$b$.
Njengoba $b>0$, u-$b$ unqunywa ngokukodwa, bese uthola u-$a$.

alg_expFuncParamsQ.prompt: Ngomsebenzi $f(x)=a\cdot b^{x}$ ($a\ne0$, $b>0$, $b\ne1$), uma $f({p})={u}$, $f({q})={v}$, linini inani le-$f({r})$? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Ku-$\frac{f(q)}{f(p)}=b^{q-p}$, qala uthole u-$b$.
Njengoba $b>0$, u-$b$ unqunywa ngokukodwa, bese uthola u-$a$.

alg_expInequality.prompt: Phakathi kwezixazululo zokungalingani ${ineq}$, zingaki izinombolo ezigcwele $x$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Yenza izisekelo zifane bese uqhathanisa izibalo. Uma isisekelo sikhulu kuno-$1$, uhlangothi lophawu lokungalingani alushintshi.
Xazulula ukungalingani kwe-quadratic kwezibalo bese ubala izixazululo ezigcwele.
alg_expInequality.explanation: Ngokubonisa konke njengamandla anesisekelo ${b}$, ukungalingani kwezibalo ngu-${work}$, futhi izimpande ezimbili zale quadratic ngu-${rts}$, ngakho izinombolo ezigcwele $x$ eziyanelisa ngu-${xs}$ futhi zingu-${ans}$ sezonke.

alg_expMaxMin.prompt: Uma ububanzi buka-$x$ bungu-${s}\le x\le {t}$, linini inani elikhulu kunawo wonke lomsebenzi ${f}$? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthole inani elikhulu nelincane lesibalo $g(x)$ (i-vertex ye-quadratic namaphoyinti okugcina).
Uma isisekelo sikhulu kuno-$1$, lapho $g$ inkulu, inani lomsebenzi we-exponential likhulu; uma sincane kuno-$1$, lapho $g$ incane, inani likhulu.

alg_expShiftA.prompt: Iphoyinti elilodwa kugrafu yomsebenzi ${f}$ ngu-$({p}, {q})$. Linini inani lenombolo ephozithivu $a$ ($a\ne1$)? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Uma ufaka ama-coordinate ephoyinti esishweni, kusala amandla owodwa ka-$a$.
Njengoba $a>0$ futhi isibalo asiyona u-$0$, u-$a$ unqunywa ngokukodwa.

alg_expSum.prompt: Ngenombolo yangempela $x$, uma ${given}$, linini inani le-${ask}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Vumela $t=$ (ibinzana lokuqala lesisho esinikeziwe), khona-ke ibinzana lesibili ngu-$\frac{1}{t}$.
Yenza isikwele noma ikhyubhu lesisho esinikeziwe bese uxhumanisa nesisho esifunwayo.
alg_expSum.explanation: Ngokuvumela u-$t$ abe ibinzana lokuqala lesisho esinikeziwe nokusebenzisa ifomula yokuphindaphinda, ${work}$.

alg_geoSumRatio.prompt: Vumela isamba kusukela ebinzaneni lokuqala kuya ebinzaneni lesi-$n$ lochungechunge lwe-geometric $\{a_n\}$ sibe ngu-$S_n$. Uma $S_{{n1}}={u}$, $S_{{n2}}={v}$, linini inani le-$S_{{n3}}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukwehlukana kwezamba okufana no-$S_{2m}=S_m+r^{m}S_m$: isamba sengxenye yangemuva siyisamba sengxenye yangaphambili siphindaphindwe ngo-$r^{m}$.
Uma uthola inani lika-$r^{{n1}}$ kuqala, awudingi u-$r$ uqobo.

alg_geoTwoTerms.prompt: Ochungechungeni lwe-geometric $\{a_n\}$ olunesilinganiso esivamile esihle, uma $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, linini inani le-$a_{{r}}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Isiphumo sokuhlukanisa (ibinzana langemuva) ÷ (ibinzana langaphambili) yi-$r$ ephakanyiswe ngamandla ahlukile amanani ezinombolo.
Isimo sokuthi isilinganiso esivamile sihle senza u-$r$ anqunywe ngokwehlukile.

alg_geoTwoTermsQ.prompt: Ochungechungeni lwe-geometric $\{a_n\}$ olunesilinganiso esivamile esihle, uma $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, linini inani le-$a_{{r}}$? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Isiphumo sokuhlukanisa (ibinzana langemuva) ÷ (ibinzana langaphambili) yi-$r$ ephakanyiswe ngamandla ahlukile amanani ezinombolo.
Isimo sokuthi isilinganiso esivamile sihle senza u-$r$ anqunywe ngokwehlukile.

alg_growthYears.prompt: Ubeka imali ebhange ngesilinganiso sonyaka se-compound esingu-${rate}\%$ lapho inzalo yengezwa kusisekelo unyaka ngamunye. Thola ngenombolo ephelele ukuthi ngemuva kweminyaka emingaki isamba sesisekelo nenzalo siba okokuqala ${k}$ izikhathi noma ngaphezulu kwesisekelo. Amanani e-common logarithm anikeziwe: ${given}$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ngemuva kweminyaka engu-$n$, isamba sesisekelo nenzalo siyi-$(1+\frac{r}{100})^{n}$ izikhathi zesisekelo.
Ngokuthatha i-common logarithm ezinhlangothini zombili, $n\log(1+\frac{r}{100})\ge\log k$.
alg_growthYears.explanation: Ngokuthatha i-common logarithm ezinhlangothini zombili ze-$({one})^{n}\ge {k}$, $n\ge\frac{{lk}}{{l1}}={q}$, ngakho inombolo yemvelo encane kakhulu $n$ ngu-${ans}$.

alg_inverseGraph.prompt: Iphoyinti elilodwa kugrafu ye-inverse function yomsebenzi ${f}$ ngu-$({p}, {q})$. Linini inani lenombolo ephozithivu $a$ ($a\ne1$)? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Uma igrafu ye-inverse function iphuma ngephoyinti $(p, q)$, igrafu yomsebenzi wokuqala iphuma ngephoyinti $(q, p)$.
Faka leli phoyinti emsebenzini wokuqala uthole isisho sika-$a$.
alg_inverseGraph.explanation: Njengoba iphoyinti kugrafu ye-inverse function ngu-$({p},{q})$, iphoyinti kugrafu yomsebenzi wokuqala ngu-$({q},{p})$. ${work}$.

alg_inversePoints.prompt: Amaphoyinti amabili kugrafu ye-inverse function yomsebenzi $f(x)=a^{x}+b$ ($a>1$, $b$ yinombolo ephelele) ngu-$({p1}, {q1})$ no-$({p2}, {q2})$. Linini inani le-$a+b$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma igrafu ye-inverse function iphuma ngephoyinti $(p, q)$, igrafu ka-$f$ iphuma ngephoyinti $(q, p)$.
Faka amaphoyinti amabili ku-$f$ wenze ama-equation amabili, bese uwakhipha ukuze u-$b$ asuswe, uthole i-equation ka-$a$. Khetha isixazululo lapho $a>1$.
alg_inversePoints.explanation: Amaphoyinti amabili kugrafu ka-$f$ ngu-$({q1},{p1})$, $({q2},{p2})$. ${work}$, ngakho $a+b={ans}$.

hints: Uma usebenzisa ifomula yokushintsha isisekelo $\log_{a}b=\frac{\log_{c}b}{\log_{c}a}$, ama-logarithm aseduze ayanciphisa.
Ngemuva kokunciphisa umkhiqizo wonke ube yi-logarithm eyodwa, bonisa i-argument ngefomu lamandla.

alg_logChainQ.prompt: Thola inani lalokhu. ${expr}$ (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Uma usebenzisa ifomula yokushintsha isisekelo $\log_{a}b=\frac{\log_{c}b}{\log_{c}a}$, ama-logarithm aseduze ayanciphisa.
Ngemuva kokunciphisa umkhiqizo wonke ube yi-logarithm eyodwa, bonisa i-argument ngefomu lamandla.

alg_logDomain.prompt: Zingaki izinombolo ze-integer $x$ ezisendaweni ye-domain yomsebenzi ${f}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Izinga le-argument ye-logarithm kumele libe yi-positive, futhi okungaphakathi kwempande yesikwele kumele kube ngu-$0$ noma ngaphezulu.
Xazulula ama-inequality uthole ububanzi be-$x$ bese ubala ama-integer angaphakathi.

alg_logEquation.prompt: Inani lesixazululo sangempela $x$ sesibalo ${eq}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uhlole isimo se-argument ${dom}$.
Hlanganisa isamba se-logarithm sibe i-logarithm eyodwa bese wakha isibalo se-quadratic ku-argument.
alg_logEquation.explanation: Ngesimo se-argument, ${dom}$. ${work}$, futhi kulokhu okuhlangabezana nesimo se-argument ngu-$x={ans}$.

alg_logExpress.prompt: Uma $\log_{2}3=a$, $\log_{2}5=b$, bhala inani le-$\log_{2}{N}$ ngefomu elingu-$xa+yb+z$ ($x, y, z$ ziyizinombolo ze-rational). Inani le-$x+y+z$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Izinga lama-argument ${N}$ lingama-prime factor angu-$2, 3, 5$ kuphela. Zama ukulibhala njengamandla.
Sebenzisa $\log_{2}(MN)=\log_{2}M+\log_{2}N$, $\log_{2}M^{k}=k\log_{2}M$, futhi usebenzise ukuthi $\log_{2}2=1$.

alg_logExpressQ.prompt: Uma $\log_{2}3=a$, $\log_{2}5=b$, bhala inani le-$\log_{2}{N}$ ngefomu elingu-$xa+yb+z$ ($x, y, z$ ziyizinombolo ze-rational). Inani le-$x+y+z$ liyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Izinga lama-argument ${N}$ lingama-prime factor angu-$2, 3, 5$ kuphela. Zama ukulibhala njengamandla.
Sebenzisa $\log_{2}(MN)=\log_{2}M+\log_{2}N$, $\log_{2}M^{k}=k\log_{2}M$, futhi usebenzise ukuthi $\log_{2}2=1$.

alg_logInequality.prompt: Phakathi kwezixazululo ze-inequality ${ineq}$, zingaki izinombolo ze-integer $x$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uhlole isimo se-argument (i-argument kumele ibe yi-positive).
Uma isisekelo singaphansi kuka-$1$, isiqondiso se-inequality siyashintsha lapho ususa i-logarithm.

alg_obtuseCount.prompt: Zingaki izinombolo zemvelo $x$ ezenza kube khona unxantathu we-obtuse onezinhlangothi ezinobude ${a}$, ${b}$, $x$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuze kube unxantathu, uhlangothi olude kakhulu kumele lube lufushane kunesamba sezinye ezimbili.

Ukuze ube we-obtuse, isikwele sohlangothi olude kakhulu kumele sibe sikhulu kunesamba sezikwele zezinye ezimbili. Hlukanisa izimo lapho $x$ iwuhlangothi olude kakhulu nalapho uhlangothi olungu-${b}$ luwuhlangothi olude kakhulu.

alg_rationalExp.prompt: Thola inani elilandelayo. ${expr}$ (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Zama ukubhala isisekelo njengamandla enombolo ethile.
Sebenzisa umthetho wezichazi $(a^{m})^{n}=a^{m\times n}$ njenge-$(c^{q})^{\frac{p}{q}}=c^{p}$, bese uguqula isichazi esingu-negative nge-$a^{-n}=\frac{1}{a^{n}}$.

alg_realRootCount.prompt: Ngenombolo ye-integer $n$ engu-$2$ noma ngaphezulu, vumela inani lezinombolo zangempela $x$ ezanelisa $x^{n}=A$ libe yi-$f(n)$. Uma $A={rad}$, inani le-$f(2)+f(3)+\cdots+f({N})$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Cabanga ngezimo lapho i-$n$ iyinombolo ephindwayo nalapho ingaphindwa.
Ngokuya ngophawu lwe-$A$, ku-$n$ ephindwayo $f(n)=2$ noma $0$, futhi ku-$n$ engaphindwa $f(n)=1$.
alg_realRootCount.explanation: Uma i-$A$ iyi-positive, ku-$n$ ephindwayo $f(n)=2$, ku-$n$ engaphindwa $f(n)=1$, futhi uma i-$A$ iyi-negative, ku-$n$ ephindwayo $f(n)=0$, ku-$n$ engaphindwa $f(n)=1$. Uma ubala inani le-$n$ ephindwayo nengaphindwa, ${work}$.

alg_recAffine.prompt: Uma ukulandelana $\{a_n\}$ kuchazwa ngokuthi $a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}={rule}$ ($n\ge1$), inani lika-$a_{{k}}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Thola amanani ka-$a_2$, $a_3$, $\dots$ ngokulandelana.
Bhala izinombolo zamatemu namanani ethebuleni, usebenzise umthetho esinyathelweni ngasinye kuze kufike ku-$a_{{k}}$. Uma kuvela izingxenyana, zenze zibe lula.

alg_recAffineQ.prompt: Uma ukulandelana $\{a_n\}$ kuchazwa ngokuthi $a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}={rule}$ ($n\ge1$), inani lika-$a_{{k}}$ liyini? (Ungalibhala njengedesimali noma njengengxenyana okufana no-3/4)
hints: Thola amanani ka-$a_2$, $a_3$, $\dots$ ngokulandelana.
Bhala izinombolo zamatemu namanani ethebuleni, usebenzise umthetho esinyathelweni ngasinye kuze kufike ku-$a_{{k}}$. Uma kuvela izingxenyana, zenze zibe lula.

alg_recParam.prompt: Ukulandelana $\{a_n\}$ kuchazwa ngokuthi $a_1={s}$, $a_{n+1}=pa_n+{q}$ ($n\ge1$, $p$ iyinombolo enhle), futhi $a_3={t}$. Inani lika-$p$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Veza u-$a_2$ no-$a_3$ ngokuya ku-$p$.
U-$a_3$ uba yisisho se-quadratic ku-$p$. Khetha isixazululo esiyinombolo enhle.
Veza inombolo engaphansi kwempande njengamandla enye inombolo.
Sebenzisa isici esifanele phakathi kwalezi: $\sqrt[n]{a}\sqrt[n]{b}=\sqrt[n]{a\times b}$, $\frac{\sqrt[n]{a}}{\sqrt[n]{b}}=\sqrt[n]{\frac{a}{b}}$, $\sqrt[m]{\sqrt[n]{a}}=\sqrt[mn]{a}$.

alg_sectorForward.prompt: Isiyingi sesigaba esinoqhele olungu-${r}$ cm nehlangothi eliphakathi elingu-${th}$ sinobude bomphetho obungu-$a\pi$ cm nendawo engu-$b\pi$ cm$^{2}$. Inani lika-$a+b$ liyini? (Libhale njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, libhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isib.: 3/4)
hints: Uma uguqula i-engeli eliphakathi libe ama-radian, ubude bomphetho bungu-$l=r\theta$ nendawo ingu-$S=\frac{1}{2}r^{2}\theta$.
Qala uthole ukuthi $\theta$ iphindwe ngokuphindwe kangaki ku-$\pi$.

alg_sectorPerimArea.prompt: Kunezigaba zesiyingi ezimbili ezinomjikelezo ongu-${P}$ cm nendawo engu-${S}$ cm$^{2}$ (i-engeli eliphakathi lincane kuno-$2\pi$). Kulezi, irediyasi yesigaba esinerediyasi enkulu ingamasentimitha amangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma irediyasi ingu-$r$ nobude bomphetho bungu-$l$, umjikelezo ungu-$2r+l$ nendawo ingu-$\frac{1}{2}rl$.
Uma ususa u-$l$, uthola isibalo se-quadratic ku-$r$.
alg_sectorPerimArea.explanation: Ku-$2r+l={P}$, $\frac{1}{2}rl={S}$, uma kususwa u-$l$ kuvela ${work}$, ngakho irediyasi enkulu ingu-${ans}$ cm.

alg_seqIntTerms.prompt: Uma ithemu elijwayelekile lokulandelana $\{a_n\}$ lingu-$a_n=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$, mangaki amatemu eyizinombolo ezephelele? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Hlukanisa inombolo ephezulu ngephansi ukuze uthole uhlobo $a_n=k+\frac{c}{n+r}$ ($k$ iyinombolo ephelele, $c$ iyinombolo engashintshi).
Bala izihlukanisi zalokho okungashintshi ezingaba yisihlukanisi $n+r$ (kunombolo yemvelo $n$, $n+r\ge{r1}$).
alg_seqIntTerms.explanation: ${work}$, ngakho amatemu eyizinombolo ezephelele wonke angu-${ans}$.

alg_seriesPattern.prompt: Thola inani lalesi samba. ${expr}$ (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Funa iphethini, uveze ithemu elijwayelekile $a_k$ njengesisho sika-$k$.
Bala usebenzisa amafomula e-$\sum k$, $\sum k^{2}$ njalonjalo (uma izimpawu zishintshana, bahlanganise ngababili).

alg_sigmaSquare.prompt: Kuma-sequence amabili $\{a_n\}$, $\{b_n\}$, uma $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_k^{2}={A}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_kb_k={B}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}b_k^{2}={C}$, inani le-$\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}({comb})^{2}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Yenza isikwele salokho okuphakathi kwamabhulakethi bese ukwandisa.
Sebenzisa ubuqondo be-$\sum$ (i-linearity: $\sum(pa_k+qb_k)=p\sum a_k+q\sum b_k$) ukukubonisa ngezamba ezintathu ezinikeziwe.

alg_sigmaSubseq.prompt: Uma ibinzana elijwayelekile le-sequence $\{a_n\}$ lingu-$a_n={an}$, inani le-$\sum_{k=1}^{{m}}a_{{idx}}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Isisho esibekwa esikhundleni sika-$n$ ku-$a_n$ singu-${idx}$. Singenisa lokhu ukuze uthole isisho ngo-$k$.
Sebenzisa $\sum k=\frac{m(m+1)}{2}$, $\sum k^{2}=\frac{m(m+1)(2m+1)}{6}$, $\sum c=cm$.

alg_sigmaTelescope.prompt: Bala inani lalesi samba. ${expr}$ (Bhala njengengxenyana elula. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Zama ukuhlukanisa ithemu ngalinye libe yizingxenyana ezingxenyiwe. Isibonelo: $\frac{1}{k(k+1)}=\frac{1}{k}-\frac{1}{k+1}$
Uma wengeza, amathemu angaphambili nangemuva ayanyamalala ngokulandelana, kusale okumbalwa kokuqala nokumbalwa kokugcina kuphela.

alg_sumToTerm.prompt: Uma isamba sethemu lokuqala kuya kwelesi-$n$ le-sequence $\{a_n\}$ singu-$S_n={expr}$, inani le-$a_{1}+a_{{k}}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: $a_1=S_1$, futhi uma $n\ge2$ $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$.
Ungathathi kungenasidingo ukuthi inani lisesisho se-$a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$ uma ufaka $n=1$ lilingana no-$S_1$.

alg_survey.prompt: Ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili u-A no-B lingu-${d}$ m. Lapho libukwa kwenye indawo u-C, $\angle CAB=\alpha$, $\angle CBA=\beta$ futhi $\sin\alpha={sa}$, $\sin\beta={sb}$ ($\alpha$, $\beta$ ama-acute angle). Ibanga lisuka ku-A liya ku-C lingamamitha amangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ngoba $\angle C=180^\circ-\alpha-\beta$, $\sin C=\sin(\alpha+\beta)$.

Ku-$\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta$, thola i-cosine nge-$\cos=\sqrt{1-\sin^{2}}$. Bese usebenzisa umthetho we-sine $\frac{\overline{A C}}{\sin\beta}=\frac{\overline{A B}}{\sin C}$.
alg_survey.explanation: ${work}$, ngakho ibanga kusuka ku-A kuya ku-C ngu-${ans}$ m.

alg_trigGraphParam.prompt: Uma isikhathi se-function $y=a{fn}\,bx+c$ ($a>0$, $b>0$) sinenani eliphezulu ${M}$, inani eliphansi ${m}$ kanye nenkathi ${per}$, inani lomphumela wezingaguquki ezintathu $abc$ liyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Inani eliphezulu ngu-$a+c$, futhi eliphansi ngu-$-a+c$.
Sebenzisa ukuthi inkathi ngu-$\frac{2\pi}{b}$ ukuthola u-$b$.

alg_trigIdentity.prompt: Kunombolo engempela $\theta$, uma ${given}$, inani le-${E}$ liyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: $\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$. Uma uyenza isikwele ezinhlangothini zombili zesisho esinikeziwe, kuvela u-$\sin\theta\cos\theta$.
Yenza isikwele sesisho esinikeziwe ukuthola inani le-$\sin\theta\cos\theta$. Uma isisho osifunayo siyisikwele esinye, sibonise ngendlela efanayo usebenzisa u-$\sin\theta\cos\theta$.

alg_trigPeriod.prompt: Uma isikhathi esincane kakhulu esiphozithivu somsebenzi ${f}$ singu-$k\pi$, linini inani lika-$k$? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Isikhathi sika-$y=\sin bx$, $y=\cos bx$ ngu-$\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$, futhi sika-$y=\tan bx$ ngu-$\frac{\pi}{|b|}$.

Uma kunenani eliphelele, ingxenye engeyona ephozithivu yegrafu iyaguqulwa isuke phezulu, ngakho isikhathi sisiza sibe uhhafu. Bhala kabusha izikwele njengo-$\sin^{2}x=\frac{1-\cos2x}{2}$, $\cos^{2}x=\frac{1+\cos2x}{2}$.

alg_trigPoint.prompt: Uma umugqa wokuqala ungohlangothi oluphozithivu lwe-$x$-axis futhi iphoyinti elilodwa emugqeni wokugcina yi-P$({xp}, {yp})$, futhi usayizi we-engeli ungu-$\theta$, linini inani le-${E}$? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthole ibanga $r=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}$ kusukela emvelaphi O kuya kuphoyinti P (lapho ama-coordinate ephoyinti P engu-$(x, y)$).
$\sin\theta=\frac{y}{r}$, $\cos\theta=\frac{x}{r}$, $\tan\theta=\frac{y}{x}$.

alg_trigRootCount.prompt: Ku-$0\le\theta<2\pi$, i-equation ${eq}$ inezimpande zangempela ezihlukene ezingaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma $k\theta=\phi$, ububanzi buka-$\phi$ bungu-$0\le\phi<2k\pi$.
Bala inani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana kwegrafu ka-$y=\sin\phi$ nokunye nomugqa $y=$ (constant) esikhathini ngasinye.

alg_trigSpecial.prompt: Thola inani lalokhu. ${expr}$ (Ungabhala njengedesimali noma ngengxenyana njengo-3/4)
hints: Shintsha i-engeli ibe yi-engeli engu-$0^\circ$ noma ngaphezulu futhi engaphansi kuka-$360^\circ$ (i-engeli enomugqa wokugcina ofanayo).
Sebenzisa $\sin30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\cos60^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\tan45^\circ=1$ nezimpawu ku-quadrant ngayinye.

bm_absIneq.prompt: Phakathi kwezixazululo zokungalingani ${ineq}$, zingaki izinombolo ezigcwele $x$ ezingu-$-{N}\le x\le {N}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uhlukanise ukuthi inani eliphelele lincane noma likhulu kunenombolo ethile.
Uma lincane, shintsha libe yifomu $-c<A<c$; uma likhulu, libe yifomu $A<-c$ noma $A>c$, uthole ububanzi buka-$x$, bese ubala izinombolo ezigcwele ebangeni elinikeziwe.
bm_absIneq.explanation: Ngemuva kokuxazulula izimpawu zenani eliphelele, isixazululo se-${ineq}$ ngu-${sol}$. Phakathi kwazo, izinombolo ezigcwele ezingu-$-{N}$ noma ngaphezulu futhi ${N}$ noma ngaphansi zingu-${ans}$ sezonke.

bm_circleLine.prompt: Zingaki izinombolo ezigcwele $m$ ezenza indingilizi: ${circ}$ nomugqa: ${line}$ bahlangane emaphoyinteni amabili ahlukene? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma ufaka i-equation yomugqa ku-equation yendingilizi, kuba yi-quadratic equation ka-$x$.

Ukuze bahlangane emaphoyinteni amabili ahlukene, le quadratic equation kumele ibe nezimpande zangempela ezimbili ezihlukene. Thola ububanzi buka-$m$ ngo-discriminant $D>0$ bese ubala izinombolo ezigcwele.
bm_circleLine.explanation: Ukufaka i-equation yomugqa ku-equation yendingilizi kunikeza ${sub}=0$. Uma i-discriminant ingu-$D$, $\frac{D}{4}={d4}$, ngakho ku-$D>0$, ${cond}$. Ngoba ${chk}$, izinombolo ezigcwele $m$ zonke izinombolo ezigcwele ezingu-$-{hi}$ noma ngaphezulu futhi ${hi}$ noma ngaphansi, ngakho zingu-${ans}$ sezonke.

bm_compUnknown.prompt: Ngemisebenzi emibili $f(x)={f}$, $g$, uma i-composite function $(g\circ f)(x)={h}$, linini inani le-$g({k})$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuze uthole inani le-$g({k})$, thola u-$x$ lapho $f(x)={k}$.
Faka lowo $x$ ku-composite function $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$.
bm_compUnknown.explanation: Ku-$f(x)={k}$, $x={x0}$. Njengoba $(g\circ f)({x0})=g(f({x0}))=g({k})$, kusukela ku-$g({k})={h}$ uma $x={x0}$ inani ngu-${ans}$.

bm_countDigits.prompt: Kunamakhadi ${n}$ ahlukene, ikhadi ngalinye linenombolo eyodwa, futhi izinombolo ezikumakhadi ngu-${ds}$. Ukukhetha amakhadi angu-3 bese uwahlela emgqeni owodwa kwakha izinombolo zemvelo zamadijithi amathathu; zingaki kuzo eziphindwayo? (Idijithi lokuqala alikwazi ukuba ngu-0. Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Idijithi lokugcina kumele libe yinombolo ephindwayo. Qala ngokunquma idijithi lokugcina, bese ugcwalisa amanye amadijithi.

Hlukanisa ngezimo lapho idijithi lokugcina lingu-0 nalapho kuyinombolo ephindwayo engeyona u-0, bese ubala ngenani le-permutation. Uma inombolo ephindwayo engeyona u-0 iba yidijithi lokugcina, idijithi lokuqala alikwazi ukuba ngu-0.
bm_countDigits.explanation: Lapho idijithi lokugcina lingu-0: amadijithi amabili asele akhethwa kumakhadi ${n1}$ asele futhi ahlelwe emgqeni, ngakho kuyi-${zex}$. Lapho idijithi lokugcina liyinombolo ephindwayo engeyona u-0: idijithi lokugcina likhethwa kumakhadi ${nz}$ anenombolo ephindwayo engeyona u-0, idijithi lokuqala likhethwa kumakhadi ${n2}$ asele ngaphandle ko-0, nedijithi eliphakathi likhethwa kumakhadi ${n2}$ asele, ngakho kuyi-${oex}$. Ngomthetho wesamba, kuyi-${z}+{o}={ans}$.

bm_discK.prompt: Umdwebo womsebenzi we-quadratic $y={f}$ uhlangana ne-$x$-axis emaphoyinteni amabili ahlukene. Zingaki izinombolo ezigcwele $k$ ezinjalo ezingu-$-{N}\le k\le {N}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuthi umdwebo uhlangana ne-$x$-axis emaphoyinteni amabili ahlukene kufana nokuthi i-quadratic equation $y=0$ inezimpande zangempela ezimbili ezihlukene.
Thola ububanzi be-$k$ ukuze i-discriminant $D$ ibe ngaphezu kuka-0, bese ubala izinombolo ezigcwele kububanzi obunikeziwe.
bm_discK.explanation: Ukuze kube nezimpande zangempela ezimbili ezihlukene, i-discriminant $D={D}>0$ kufanele, ngakho ${cond}$. Izinombolo ezigcwele $k$ ezifeza lokhu ku-$-{N}\le k\le {N}$ zingu-${ans}$ sizonke.

bm_funcCount.prompt: Isethi $X$ iyisethi yazo zonke izinombolo zemvelo ezingu-${m}$ noma ngaphansi, futhi isethi $Y$ iyisethi yazo zonke izinombolo zemvelo ezingu-${n}$ noma ngaphansi. Mingaki imisebenzi $f$ esuka ku-$X$ iye ku-$Y$ enokuthi $f(1)=1$ futhi engeyona one-to-one? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma $f(1)=1$, inani lomsebenzi lesinye isici ngasinye lingakhethwa ngokukhululekile kunoma yisiphi isici se-$Y$.
Thola ngokuthi (yonke imisebenzi eyanelisa isimo) $-$ (leyo eyi-one-to-one). Emsebenzini one-to-one, izici ezihlukene zinamanani ahlukene.
bm_funcCount.explanation: Imisebenzi enokuthi $f(1)=1$: izici ezisele ${m1}$ ngasinye singaba namanani angu-${n}$ ahlukene, ngakho kuyi-${tot}$, futhi kuyo leyo eyi-one-to-one ngu-${inj}$ ngoba izici ezisele kumele zibe namanani ahlukene angeyona u-1. Ngakho ${tot}-{inj}={ans}$.

bm_ineqSystem.prompt: Phakathi kwezixazululo ezifanayo zezinkinga ezimbili ezingalinganile ezilayini ${i1}$ kanye ${i2}$, zingaki izinombolo ezigcwele $x$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Xazulula ukungalingani ngakunye ngokwehlukana ukuze uthole ububanzi be-$x$ kuqala.

Bonisa ingxenye lapho ububanzi obubili buhlangana emgqeni wezinombolo, bese ubala izinombolo ezigcwele ngaphakathi. Uma uhlukanisa noma ukhulisa ngenombolo engaphansi kuka-0, uhlangothi lwesiphawu sokungalingani luyashintsha.
bm_ineqSystem.explanation: Ukungalingani kokuqala kunikeza ${s1}$, okwesibili kunikeza ${s2}$. Izinombolo ezigcwele ebubanzini obufanayo ngu-${ints}$, ngakho zingu-${ans}$ sizonke.

bm_lineParPerp.prompt: Kunomugqa $L:{L}$ futhi iphoyinti $\mathrm{P}$ linamalungiselelo $({x0},{y0})$. Uma i-$y$-intercept yomugqa odlula ku-$\mathrm{P}$ futhi ofana ne-$L$ ingu-$s$, kanti i-$y$-intercept yomugqa odlula ku-$\mathrm{P}$ futhi othe nkqo ku-$L$ ingu-$t$, linini inani le-$s+t$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: I-slope yomugqa ofomu $ax+by+c=0$ ingu-$-\frac{a}{b}$, futhi umkhiqizo wama-slope emigqa emibili ethe nkqo ngu-$-1$.
Umugqa ofanayo unamakhoefishenti afanayo e-$x$ ne-$y$, futhi umugqa othe nkqo unefomu $bx-ay=k$ ($k$ ayishintshi). Faka amalungiselelo e-P uthole u-$k$.
bm_lineParPerp.explanation: Umugqa ofanayo ungu-${par}$ futhi ngokufaka $x=0$, $s={s}$. Umugqa othe nkqo ungu-${perp}$ futhi ngokufaka $x=0$, $t={t}$. Ngakho $s+t={ans}$.

bm_matUnknown.prompt: Ngama-matrix $A={A}$, $B={B}$, $C={C}$, uma ${ex}=C$ iyiqiniso, linini inani le-$x+y$ lezinombolo zangempela $x$ no-$y$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuze ama-matrix amabili alingane, izingxenye endaweni efanayo kumele zilingane.
Yakha i-linear equation ngengxenye equkethe u-$x$ ukuze uthole u-$x$, bese wenza okufanayo ku-$y$.
bm_matUnknown.explanation: Uma sihlaziya ingxenye equkethe u-$x$, ${eqx}$, ngakho $x={xv}$; uma sihlaziya ingxenye equkethe u-$y$, ${eqy}$, ngakho $y={yv}$. Ngakho $x+y={ans}$.

bm_polyExpand.prompt: Uma ukunwetshwa kwenkulumo ${expr}$ kuhlelwa ngokwehla kwamandla ka-$x$, isamba se-coefficient ka-$x^2$ nesitholakalo esiqhubekayo siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Nweta umkhiqizo ngamunye ngokwehlukana, bese uhlanganisa amagama afanayo.
Kulula ukusebenzisa ifomula $(ax+b)^2=a^2x^2+2abx+b^2$. Ungakhohlwa izimpawu nama-coefficient angaphambili.
bm_polyExpand.explanation: Njengoba kunjalo ukuthi $({e1}){op}({e2})$, uma kuhlelwa kuba ngu-${total}$. I-coefficient ka-$x^2$ ngu-${c2}$ futhi isitholakalo esiqhubekayo ngu-${c0}$, ngakho isamba ngu-${ans}$.

bm_polyFactor.prompt: Umphumela wokwenza izici kwenkulumo ye-quadratic ${Pex}$ ngu-$(ax+b)(cx+d)$. Uma u-$a$, $b$, $c$, $d$ bengama-integer, $a>0$, $c>0$, $a\le c$, futhi uma $a=c$ khona-ke $b\le d$, inani le-$a+b+c+d$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Cabanga ngamapheya ama-integer enza isitholakalo esiqhubekayo $bd$ ne-coefficient ka-$x^2$ elingu-$ac$.
Khetha umuntu ongase abe yilo, uyinwetshe, bese uhlola ukuthi i-coefficient ka-$x$ iyalingana no-$ad+bc$.

bm_propRange.prompt: Mayelana nezimo ezimbili ze-$x$ yenombolo yangempela $p:{pc}$ no-$q: m\le x\le {n}$, yiliphi inani elikhulu kakhulu le-integer $m$ elenza isitatimende $p\to q$ sibe yiqiniso? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma isitatimende $p\to q$ siyiqiniso, isethi yeqiniso ye-$p$ ifakiwe esethini yeqiniso ye-$q$.
Qala ngokuthola ububanzi be-$x$ obufeza u-$p$, bese wenza ukuthi iphethelo lasekhohlo lobu bubanzi libe nkulu noma lilingane no-$m$.
bm_propRange.explanation: Isethi yeqiniso ye-$p$ ngu-$\{x\mid {lo}{rl}x{rl}{hi}\}$. Ukuze ifakwe esethini yeqiniso ye-$q$ engu-$\{x\mid m\le x\le {n}\}$, kumele $m\le {lo}$ futhi ${hi}\le {n}$. Ngakho inani elikhulu kakhulu le-integer $m$ ngu-${ans}$.

bm_quadRange.prompt: Mayelana nomsebenzi we-quadratic $f(x)={f}$, uma inani elikhulu kakhulu le-$f(x)$ ku-${s}\le x\le {t}$ lingu-$M$ futhi elincane kakhulu lingu-$m$, inani le-$M+m$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Shintsha ube yifomu $f(x)=a(x-p)^2+q$ ukuze uthole i-vertex.
Njengoba ukuxhumanisa kwe-$x$ kwe-vertex kungaphakathi kwebanga elinikeziwe, qhathanisa amanani omsebenzi ku-vertex nasemaphethelweni amabili ebanga.
bm_quadRange.explanation: Njengoba $f(x)={vf}$, i-vertex ingu-$({h},{k})$ futhi ingaphakathi kwebanga. Amanani omsebenzi emaphethelweni amabili angu-$f({s})={fs}$ no-$f({t})={ft}$, ngakho inani elikhulu kakhulu $M={M}$, elincane kakhulu $m={m}$ futhi $M+m={ans}$.

bm_quadRoots.prompt: Ezimpandeni ezimbili zangempela ezihlukene zesibalo ${eq}$ se-$x$, uma ezincane ziqala kungu-$\alpha$ no-$\beta$, inani le-$\beta-2\alpha$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Hambisa wonke amagama asohlangothini lwesokudla uye ngakwesokunxele ukuze wenze isimo se-(quadratic)$=0$.
Yenza izici ukuze uthole izimpande ezimbili, bese ufaka impande encane ku-$\alpha$ nenkulu ku-$\beta$.
bm_quadRoots.explanation: Uma kuhlelwa, ${std}=0$ futhi uma kwenziwa izici ${fac}=0$, ngakho $\alpha={al}$, $\beta={be}$. Ngakho $\beta-2\alpha={ans}$.

bm_setOps.prompt: Isethi yendawo yonke $U$ iyisethi yazo zonke izinombolo zemvelo ezingaphansi noma ezilingana no-${n}$, kanti kusuka kumasethi angaphansi amabili e-$U$, $A$ iyisethi yazo zonke izihlukanisi ze-${a}$, no-$B$ iyisethi yawo wonke amaphindwe e-${b}$. Isamba sazo zonke izakhi zesethi $A\cap B^{c}$ siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bhala u-$A$ no-$B$ ngokuthola zonke izakhi. Cabanga ngo-$B$ ngaphakathi kuka-$U$ kuphela.
$B^{c}$ yiyona esele ngemuva kokususa izakhi zika-$B$ ku-$U$. Khetha kuphela izakhi zika-$A$ ezingekho ku-$B$.
bm_setOps.explanation: Njengoba $A=\{{As}\}$, $B=\{{Bs}\}$, $A\cap B^{c}=\{{Rs}\}$ futhi isamba sezakhi ngu-${ans}$.

bm_transform.prompt: Izixhumanisi zephoyinti $\mathrm{P}$ ziyi-$({a},{b})$. Iphoyinti $\mathrm{P}$ lihanjiswa ngokuhambisana nolayini ngo-${p}$ ohlangothini lwe-eksisi ka-$x$ nango-${q}$ ohlangothini lwe-eksisi ka-$y$ libe yiphoyinti $\mathrm{Q}$, iphoyinti $\mathrm{Q}$ lisheshiswa ngokuphawula ku-eksisi ka-$x$ libe yiphoyinti $\mathrm{R}$, futhi iphoyinti $\mathrm{R}$ lisheshiswa ngokuphawula komugqa $y=x$ libe yiphoyinti $\mathrm{S}(m,n)$. Liyini inani lika-$2m+n$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuhambisa: $(x,y)\to(x+p,\,y+q)$, ukuphawula ku-eksisi ka-$x$: $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$, ukuphawula komugqa $y=x$: $(x,y)\to(y,x)$.
Thola iphoyinti linye ngesikhathi ngokulandelana.

ca1_absNotDiff.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$, zingaki izinombolo zangempela $k$ lapho $f$ ingenakuphikiswa ku-$x=k$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: $|g(x)|$ iyagoba emaphoyintini lapho uphawu luka-$g(x)$ lushintsha. Hlola ukuthi uphawu lushintsha yini empandeni (noma ngabe kuyimpande ephindwe kabili).
Uma ubuningi bempande ngayinye bungu-odd, akunakuphikiswa kuleliphoyinti; uma bungu-even, kungaphikiswa.
ca1_absNotDiff.explanation: Phakathi kwezimpande zesisho (zezisho) ngaphakathi kwenani eliphelele, ezinobuningi obungu-odd ziyi-${oddr}$ nezinobuningi obungu-even ziyi-${evenr}$. Ezimpandeni ezinobuningi obungu-odd uphawu luyashintsha futhi ama-derivative asekhohlo nasesokudla ayahluka, ngakho akunakuphikiswa; ezimpandeni ezinobuningi obungu-even kungaphikiswa. Ngakho amaphoyinti afunwayo angu-${ans}$.

ca1_areaCubicAxis.prompt: Siyini isamba sezindawo zezingxenye ezimbili ezijikelezwe ngumcibisholo $y={f}$ ne-eksisi ka-$x$? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Thola izixhumanisi ze-$x$ zamaphoyinti lapho umcibisholo uhlangana khona ne-eksisi ka-$x$ (izimpande ezintathu ze-cubic).
Ingxenyeni ngayinye hlola ukuthi umcibisholo ungaphezulu noma ungaphansi kwe-eksisi ka-$x$, bese uguqula uphawu uma ungaphansi ngaphambi kokuhlanganisa.
ca1_areaCubicAxis.explanation: Umcibisholo uhlangana ne-eksisi ka-$x$ ku-$x={rs}$. Ebanjeni $[{r1},{r2}]$, $\int y\,dx={i1}$, ebanjeni $[{r2},{r3}]$, $\int y\,dx={i2}$, ngakho isamba sezindawo ngu-$\left|{i1}\right|+\left|{i2}\right|={ansf}$.

ca1_areaLineParam.prompt: Uma indawo yesimo esijikelezwe ngumcibisholo $y={cur}$ nomugqa $y=mx$ ($0<m<{a}$) ingu-${S}$, liyini inani lesingeniso $m$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Izixhumanisi ze-$x$ zamaphoyinti okuhlangana kwalo mcibisholo nomugqa ziyi-$0$, ${a}-m$.
Hlanganisa (umcibisholo)−(umugqa) phakathi kwala maphoyinti amabili, uvezwe ngo-$m$, bese uxazulula i-equation lapho leli nani lingu-${S}$.
ca1_areaLineParam.explanation: Izixhumanisi ze-$x$ zamaphoyinti okuhlangana ziyi-$0$, ${a}-m$ futhi indawo ngu-$\int_0^{{a}-m}\{({a}-m)x-x^2\}dx=\frac{({a}-m)^3}{6}$. Ngoba lokhu kungu-${S}$, ${a}-m={d}$, okungukuthi $m={ans}$.

ca1_areaParabolaLine.prompt: Siyini indawo yesimo esijikelezwe yi-parabola $y={f}$ nomugqa $y={g}$? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Xazulula ndawonye izibalo zombili ukuthola izixhumanisi ze-$x$ zamaphoyinti okuhlangana $\alpha<\beta$.
Hlanganisa (isibalo esiphezulu)−(isibalo esiphansi) kusukela ku-$\alpha$ kuya ku-$\beta$.
ca1_areaParabolaLine.explanation: Uma izibalo zombili zixazululwa ndawonye, izixhumanisi ze-$x$ zamaphoyinti okuhlangana ziyi-${al}$, ${be}$ futhi umehluko wezibalo ungu-${dif}$. Uma kuhlanganiswa (igrafu ephezulu)−(igrafu ephansi) kuleli banga, indawo ingu-${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_areaTangentParabola.prompt: Siyini indawo yesimo esijikelezwe yi-tangent iphoyintini le-parabola $y={f}$ elinesixhumanisi se-$x$ esingu-${a}$, le parabola, ne-eksisi ka-$y$? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthole isibalo se-tangent. I-tangent ihlala ohlangothini olulodwa lwe-parabola (ngaphezulu noma ngaphansi).
Hlanganisa inani eliphelele le-(parabola)−(tangent) kusukela ku-$x=0$ kuya ku-$x={a}$.
ca1_areaTangentParabola.explanation: Isibalo se-tangent singu-$y={tl}$ futhi umehluko we-parabola ne-tangent ungu-${dif}$. Uma kuhlanganiswa inani eliphelele lalo mehluko kusukela ku-$x=0$ kuya ku-$x={a}$, indawo ingu-${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_contProduct.prompt: Ngomsebenzi ${pw}$ no-$g(x)={gd}$ (onke amagama asesibalweni se-$g$ angama-constant), uma i-$f(x)g(x)$ iqhubeka kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela $x$, inani le-$g({kq})$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuze i-$f(x)g(x)$ iqhubeke nasemaphoyintini lapho i-$f$ ingaqhubeki, i-$g$ kumele ibe yini kuleyo ndawo?
Sebenzisa isimo sokuthi $g=0$ kuleyo ndawo ukuze unqume ama-constant asesibalweni se-$g$.
ca1_contProduct.explanation: I-$f$ iyatsiba ku-${ptxt}$, ngakho ukuze i-$f(x)g(x)$ iqhubeke, kumele $g=0$ kuleyo maphoyinti. Ngalesi simo, uma unquma ama-constant, $g(x)={gfull}$ futhi $g({kq})={ans}$.

ca1_contRadical.prompt: Uma umsebenzi ${pw}$ uqhubeka ku-$x={c}$, inani le-constant $k$ liyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Ukuze uqhubeke ku-$x={c}$, inani lomkhawulo lapho $x\to {c}$ kumele libe yi-$k$.
Hlanganisa isisekelo se-radical esibalweni noma esihlukanisini bese unciphisa isici esivamile.
ca1_contRadical.explanation: Ukuze uqhubeke, $k=\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x)$. Ku-$x\ne {c}$ ngokwenza i-rationalization nokunciphisa, $f(x)={rat}$, ngakho inani lomkhawulo lapho $x\to {c}$ ngu-$k={ansf}$.

ca1_contTwoJoint.prompt: Uma umsebenzi ${pw}$ uqhubeka kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela $x$, inani le-$a+b$ ngama-constant $a$, $b$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Izindawo lapho kungase kungaqhubeki yilapho isibalo sishintsha, $x={p1}$, $x={p2}$.
Setha izibalo lapho inani lesibalo sangakwesobunxele linganayo nelesibalo sangakwesokudla kuphoyinti ngalinye.
ca1_contTwoJoint.explanation: Ku-$x={p1}$, $x={p2}$ amanani ezibalo zombili izinhlangothi kumele alingane, ngakho uthola izibalo ezimbili, futhi ngokuzixazulula, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Ngakho $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_defIntAbs.prompt: Inani le-$\int_{{p}}^{{q}}|{g}|\,dx$ liyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
