hints: Thola iphoyinti lapho uphawu lwesibalo ngaphakathi kwenani eliphelele lushintsha, okungukuthi impande ye-$x$ esesikhaweni.
Hlukanisa isikhawu kuleyo phoyinti, susa inani eliphelele esikhaweni ngasinye bese uhlanganisa.
ca1_defIntAbs.explanation: Isibalo esingaphakathi kwenani eliphelele sishintsha uphawu ku-$x={zs}$, ngakho sihlukanisa isikhawu. Ngoba uphawu luhlala lufana engxenyeni ngayinye, uma ufaka inani eliphelele le-definite integral yengxenye ngayinye, ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_defIntFindBound.prompt: Kunombolo ephozithivu $a$, uma $\int_{{lo}}^{a}\left({g}\right)dx={V}$, inani le-$a$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Thola i-indefinite integral bese ubhala $\int_{{lo}}^{a}$ njenge-polynomial ku-$a$.
Esibalweni osithole, funa isixazululo lapho $a>{lo}$. Ngoba isibalo siyakhula, kunesixazululo esisodwa kuphela.
ca1_defIntFindBound.explanation: I-indefinite integral eyodwa ngu-$G(x)={G}$, ngakho $G(a)-G({lo})={V}$, futhi ku-$a>{lo}$ leli nani liyakhula ngokuya nge-$a$, ngakho kunesixazululo esisodwa kuphela. Ngokuxazulula, $a={ans}$.

ca1_defIntSplit.prompt: Ngomsebenzi oqhubekayo $f(x)$, uma $\int_{{a0}}^{{p}}f(x)\,dx={A}$, $\int_{{a0}}^{{q}}f(x)\,dx={B}$, inani le-$\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({mf}\right)dx$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Sebenzisa izakhiwo ze-definite integral $\int_a^b f\,dx+\int_b^c f\,dx=\int_a^c f\,dx$ ne-$\int_b^a f\,dx=-\int_a^b f\,dx$.
Bhala i-integral ye-$f$ oyifunayo ngamanani amabili anikeziwe, bese uhlanganisa ingxenye engaguquki ngokwehlukana.
ca1_defIntSplit.explanation: Esikhaweni esifunwayo, $\int f(x)\,dx={I}$. Ngokuphathelene nesigaba esingaguquki, bala $\int c\,dx=c\times(\text{ubude besikhawu obunesiqondiso})$ bese uyangeza. Ngakho inani liyi-${ans}$.

ca1_defIntSymm.prompt: Inani le-$\int_{-{a}}^{{a}}\left({g}\right)dx$ liyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Isikhawu sihambisana nomsuka. I-integral yamagama anamandla angajwayelekile ka-$x$ ingu-$0$.
Nweba isibalo uzigcine izigaba zamandla ajwayelekile kuphela, bese ubala nge-$2\int_0^{a}$.
ca1_defIntSymm.explanation: Ngokulungisa isibalo, i-definite integral yamagama obuningi obungajwayelekile ingu-$0$ futhi amagama obuningi obujwayelekile angu-${evp}$. Ngakho $2\int_0^{a}\left({evp}\right)dx={ansf}$.

ca1_derivSignMin.prompt: Ngomsebenzi we-polynomial $f$, uma ${given}$, isamba sawo wonke amanani e-$x$ lapho u-$f$ une-local minimum siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: I-extremum ivela lapho uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ lushintsha. Empandeni ephindwe kabili (isici esinesikwele) uphawu alushintshi.
Hlola uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ ohlangothini ngalunye lempande ngayinye, bese ufuna amaphoyinti lapho lushintsha kusuka ku-$-$ liye ku-$+$.
ca1_derivSignMin.explanation: Amaphoyinti lapho uphawu lwe-$f'(x)$ lushintsha kusuka ku-$-$ luye ku-$+$ angama-local minimum. Ngokwenza ithebula lophawu, amaphoyinti anjalo yilapho u-$x$ engu-${mins}$, futhi isamba singu-${ans}$.

ca1_diffLimitPoly.prompt: Uma $f(x)={f}$, inani le-${lim}$ liyini? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Ungashintsha isisho sibe yifomu lencazelo ye-derivative ka-$f$, $\lim\frac{f(a+\Delta)-f(a)}{\Delta}$. Engeza futhi ukhiphe ukuze kuvele ifomu elithi $f(x)-f({a})$ enombolweni engaphezulu.
Thola inani le-$f({a})$ noma le-$f'({a})$ kuqala, bese uzihlanganisa ukuze zihambisane nesisho.
ca1_diffLimitPoly.explanation: Kuqala thola u-$f'(x)$: $f'({a})={d1}$ futhi $f({a})={d0}$. Ukubonisa i-limit njenge-derivative, ${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_diffParam.prompt: Uma umsebenzi ${pw}$ uyi-differentiable ku-$x={c}$, inani le-$a+b$ lemvamisa $a$, $b$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma i-differentiable, iyaqhubeka ku-$x={c}$, futhi i-derivative yesobunxele ne-derivative yesokudla iyalingana.
Yakha ama-equation amabili: amanani omsebenzi ka-$x={c}$ emisebenzini yomibili alingana, namanani e-derivative alingana.
ca1_diffParam.explanation: Njengoba iyaqhubeka ku-$x={c}$, amanani ezisho zombili ayalingana, futhi njengoba i-differentiable, amanani e-derivative ayalingana. Ngokuxazulula ama-equation amabili, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$, ngakho $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_extremaCoef.prompt: Umsebenzi we-cubic $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$, $c$ ayizinguquko) une-local maximum ku-$x={m}$ kanye ne-local minimum ku-$x={n}$, futhi $f({z})={w}$. Isamba se-local maximum ne-local minimum siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Emaphoyinteni e-local maximum ne-minimum, $f'(x)=0$, ngakho ungathola u-$a$, $b$ ngo-$f'({m})=f'({n})=0$.
Ngemuva kokuthola u-$a$, $b$, nquma u-$c$ ngesimo $f({z})={w}$. Ekugcineni, bala i-local maximum $f({m})$ ne-local minimum $f({n})$ bese uzifaka ndawonye.
ca1_extremaCoef.explanation: Ku-$f'({m})=f'({n})=0$, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$, futhi ku-$f({z})={w}$, $c={cv}$. I-local maximum ngu-$f({m})={fm}$, i-local minimum ngu-$f({n})={fn}$, ngakho isamba singu-${ans}$.

ca1_indefInitial.prompt: I-derivative yomsebenzi $f(x)$ ngu-$f'(x)={d}$ futhi $f({p})={q}$. Inani lika-$f({r})$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: $f(x)$ yi-indefinite integral ka-$f'(x)$. Thola u-$f(x)$ uhlanganise i-constant of integration $C$.
Nquma u-$C$ ngesimo $f({p})={q}$, bese uthola inani lika-$f({r})$.

ca1_indefSecond.prompt: Ngomsebenzi $f(x)$, $f''(x)={d}$, $f'({p})={s}$, $f({q})={w}$. Inani lika-$f({r})$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuhlanganisa u-$f''$ kanye kunikeza u-$f'$, kanye futhi kunikeza u-$f$. Ukuhlanganisa ngakunye kuletha i-constant eyodwa.
Nquma i-constant yokuqala ngesimo $f'({p})={s}$, neyesibili ngesimo $f({q})={w}$.
ca1_indefSecond.explanation: Ngokuhlanganisa u-$f''$ nokunquma i-constant ngo-$f'({p})={s}$, $f'(x)={g1}$; ngokuhlanganisa futhi nokunquma i-constant ngo-$f({q})={w}$, $f(x)={g0}$. Ngakho $f({r})={ans}$.

ca1_ineqParam.prompt: Ngomsebenzi $f(x)={f}$, inani elincane kakhulu lenombolo yangempela $a$ elenza ukungalingani $f(x)+a\ge 0$ kuhlale kuyiqiniso ebanzini ${dom}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuze $f(x)+a\ge0$ kuhlale kuyiqiniso, inani elincane kakhulu lika-$f(x)$ kulobu banzi kumele libe ngu-$-a$ noma ngaphezulu.
Thola inani elincane kakhulu lika-$f(x)$ ebanzini ngokuqhathanisa amanani e-extremum nawokugcina kobubanzi.
ca1_ineqParam.explanation: Inani elincane kakhulu lika-$f(x)$ kulobu banzi ngu-${mn}$. Ukuze $f(x)+a\ge0$ kuhlale kuyiqiniso, $a\ge {mn2}$, ngakho inani elincane kakhulu lika-$a$ ngu-${ans}$.

ca1_integralEq.prompt: Uma i-polynomial function $f(x)$ iyanelisa $f(x)={rhs}$ kuwo wonke amanani angempela $x$, inani le-$f({k})$ lithini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt$ ingaguquki engahlangene no-$x$. Yibize ngo-$c$, bese ubonisa i-$f(x)$ ngo-$c$.
Faka leyo $f(x)$ ku-$\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ ukuze uthole u-$c$.
ca1_integralEq.explanation: Uma ubeka $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ (ingaguquki), i-$f(x)$ iba yi-quadratic equiphethe u-$c$. Kusuka esibalweni sokuthi inani lalokhu lapho lihlanganiswa kusuka ku-$0$ kuya ku-$1$ lilingana no-$c$, $c={c}$, futhi $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralFuncExtremum.prompt: Uma $f(t)={f}$, inani eliphansi kakhulu lokwehla kwesiphetho se-function $G(x)=\int_{{s}}^{x}f(t)\,dt$ lithini? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Ngoba $G'(x)=f(x)$, ukukhula nokwehla kuka-$G$ kunqunywa uphawu luka-$f(x)$.
Ku-$x$ lapho uphawu luka-$f(x)$ luguquka luvela ku-$-$ luya ku-$+$ kunendawo ephansi, futhi inani layo likalwa ngo-$\int_{s}^{x}f(t)\,dt$.
ca1_integralFuncExtremum.explanation: Iphoyinti lapho uphawu luka-$G'(x)=f(x)$ luguquka luvela ku-$-$ luya ku-$+$ ngu-$x={z}$. Inani eliphansi yi-$G({z})=\int_{{s}}^{{z}}f(t)\,dt={ansf}$.

ca1_integralFuncFind.prompt: Uma i-polynomial function $f(x)$ iyanelisa $\int_{{c}}^{x}f(t)\,dt={F}$ ($a$ ingaguquki) kuwo wonke amanani angempela $x$, inani le-$f({k})$ lithini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma $x={c}$, i-integral ohlangothini lwesobunxele ingu-$0$, ngakho ungasebenzisa lokhu ukuthola u-$a$.
Bese uhlukanisa ohlangothini ngalunye ngokuya ku-$x$ ukuze uthole i-$f(x)$.
ca1_integralFuncFind.explanation: Uma $x={c}$, uhlangothi lwesobunxele luyi-$0$, ngakho $a={av}$. Uma uhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili, $f(x)={fx}$, ngakho $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralLimit.prompt: Ku-polynomial function $f(x)={f}$, inani le-${lim}$ lithini? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Isihlukanisi nenombolo engaphezulu kokubili kusondela ku-$0$. Zama ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-definite integral ne-indefinite integral $\frac{d}{d x}\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=f(x)$.
Uma u-$F$ enga-$F'(x)=f(x)$, beka $\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=F(x)-F(a)$, futhi kuba yifomu lencazelo ye-derivative.
ca1_integralLimit.explanation: Uma u-$F$ enga-$F'(x)=f(x)$, uma ubhala i-integral ngokuthi $F(\text{umkhawulo ongaphezulu})-F(\text{umkhawulo ongaphansi})$, i-limit iba yifomu le-derivative ka-$F$, futhi inani layo li-${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_ivtCount.prompt: Zingaki izinombolo ezipheleleyo $a$ ezenza i-equation ${fx}=0$ ibe nempande engempela esikhathini esivulekile $({m},{n})$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Lo msebenzi uyakhula kuso sonke isikhawu. Ngakho amanani omsebenzi eziphethweni zombili zesikhawu kumele abe nophawu oluhlukile.
Bhala isimo sokuthi uphawu lwe-$f({m})$ ne-$f({n})$ luphikisanayo, okungukuthi $f({m})f({n})<0$, njenge-inequality ngo-$a$.
ca1_ivtCount.explanation: Ngoba $f(x)={fx}$ ine-$f'(x)>0$ futhi iyakhula, isimo esidingekile nesanele sokuba nempande engempela esikhawini ngu-$f({m})f({n})<0$. Izinombolo ezipheleleyo $a$ eziyanelisa lokhu yilezo ezinga-${alo}<a<{ahi}$, ngakho zingu-${ans}$.

ca1_kinCoefFind.prompt: Indawo yephoyinti P elihamba emgqeni wezinombolo ngesikhathi $t$ ingu-$x(t)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ ziyizingaguquki). Uma ngesikhathi $t={p}$ isivinini sephoyinti P singu-$0$ nokukhuphuka kwesivinini kungu-${q}$, indawo yephoyinti P ngesikhathi $t={k}$ iyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Isivinini ngu-$v(t)=x'(t)$, ukukhuphuka kwesivinini ngu-$a(t)=v'(t)$. Bhala izimo ezimbili njengezibalo: $v({p})=0$, $a({p})={q}$.
Xazulula izibalo zombili ndawonye ukuze uthole u-$a$ no-$b$, bese ubala inani le-$x({k})$.

ca1_limCoefPoly.prompt: Ngomsebenzi $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ ayizinguquko), uma ${lim}={L}$, linini inani le-$f(1)$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Njengoba i-limit ikhona futhi i-denominator iba ngu-$0$, i-numerator nayo kumele ibe ngu-$0$ ku-$x={c}$.
Khona-ke i-limit ngu-${rel}$, ngakho yenza uhlelo lwama-equation luka-$a$, $b$ ngesimo sokuthi leli nani lingu-${L}$ nesimo se-numerator.
ca1_limCoefPoly.explanation: Njengoba i-numerator kumele ibe ngu-$0$ ku-$x={c}$, $f({c})={m0}$. Khona-ke i-limit ngu-${rel}$ futhi leli nani lingu-${L}$, ngakho ngokuxazulula ama-equation amabili, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$ futhi $f(1)={ans}$.

ca1_limCoefRational.prompt: Uma $\lim_{x\to {c}}\frac{{num}}{{den}}={L}$, linini inani le-$a+b$ lama-constant $a$, $b$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuze i-limit ibe khona ku-$x={c}$ lapho i-denominator iba ngu-$0$, i-numerator nayo kumele ibe ngu-$0$ ku-$x={c}$.
Bonisa u-$b$ ngo-$a$ ukuze i-numerator ibe nesici ${xc}$, bese wakha i-equation yokuthi i-limit yesisho esenziwe lula ilingana nenani elinikeziwe (${L}$).
ca1_limCoefRational.explanation: Njengoba i-limit ikhona futhi i-denominator iba ngu-$0$ ku-$x={c}$, i-numerator nayo kumele ibe ngu-$0$ ku-$x={c}$. Ngemuva kokunciphisa isici esifanayo se-numerator ne-denominator, ngesimo sokuthi i-limit ilingana nenani elinikeziwe (${L}$), $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Ngakho $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_limDerivForm.prompt: Ngomsebenzi we-differentiable $f(x)$, uma $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, linini inani le-${lim}$? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Engeza futhi ukhiphe noma yenza ifektha ukuze i-numerator ibe nefomu $f(x)-f({a})$ (noma $f(a+h)-f(a)$).
Incazelo ye-derivative ngu-$\lim_{x\to {a}}\frac{f(x)-f({a})}{{xa}}=f'({a})$.
ca1_limDerivForm.explanation: Ngokwenza ifomu $f(x)-f({a})$ ku-numerator nokusebenzisa incazelo ye-derivative, njengoba $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, i-limit ngu-${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_limExistence.prompt: Ngomsebenzi ${pw}$, uma $\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x)$ ikhona, linini inani le-constant $a$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuze i-limit ibe khona, i-left limit ne-right limit lapho $x\to {c}$ kumele zilingane.
Faka amanani aseduze no-$x={c}$ esishweni sika-$x<{c}$ nesika-$x>{c}$ ngokwehlukana, bese ubonisa ama-limit amabili ngo-$a$.
ca1_limExistence.explanation: I-left limit yinani lesisho sika-$x<{c}$ lapho $x\to {c}$, ne-right limit yinani lesisho sika-$x>{c}$. Njengoba amanani amabili kumele alingane, $a={ans}$.

ca1_limInfRatio.prompt: Inani le-$\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ liyini? (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala uqhathanise izinga lamabinzana aphezulu kakhulu ku-numerator nase-denominator. Uma izinga le-numerator liphansi kunalelo le-denominator, i-limit ngu-$0$.
Zama ukuhlukanisa i-denominator ne-numerator ngamandla amakhulu kakhulu ka-$x$.
ca1_limInfRatio.explanation: Lapho $x\to\infty$, i-numerator inqunywa yifomu ${nl}$ ne-denominator ${dl}$, ngakho i-limit ilingana ne-limit yesilinganiso samabinzana amabili $\frac{{nl}}{{dl}}$, futhi leli nani ngu-${ansf}$.

ca1_limPiecewise.prompt: Ngomsebenzi ${pw}$, linini inani le-{ask}? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Isisho somsebenzi $f$ siyashintsha ku-$x={k}$. Qala unqume ukuthi inani eliphakathi kuka-$f$ lisondela ku-${k}$ livela ohlangothini oluncane noma olukhulu.
Thola inani ku-$x={k}$ esishweni sohlangothi olunqunyiwe. Inani lomsebenzi $f({k})$ uqobo alihlangene ne-limit.
ca1_limPiecewise.explanation: I-limit lapho $x\to {k}^{-}$ ngu-${lv}$, ne-limit lapho $x\to {k}^{+}$ ngu-${rv}$ (inani lomsebenzi ku-$x={k}$ ngu-${e}$, kodwa alihlangene ne-limit). Ngokubheka ukuthi inani eliphakathi kwesisho esifunwayo lisondela ku-${k}$ livela ohlangothini olungaphi, futhi usebenzisa la manani ngokufanele, impendulo ngu-${ans}$.

ca1_limRadical.prompt: Liyini inani lika-$\lim_{x\to\infty}\left({expr}\right)$? (Ungabhala ngedesimali noma ngengxenyana efana no-3/4)
hints: Ngomehluko wezisho ezinezikwele, noma umehluko wesisho esinesikwele nesisho somugqa, phindaphinda isihlukanisi nenombolo ngesamba (isisho esinesikwele)+(esinye isisho) ukuze ususe isikwele.
Ngemva kokususa isikwele, hlukanisa isihlukanisi nenombolo ngo-$x$ bese uvumela u-$x\to\infty$.
ca1_limRadical.explanation: Uma isinombolo sisusiwe isikwele, isisho siba uhlobo lwe-$\frac{{numr}}{{den2}}$. Uma sihlukanisa isihlukanisi nenombolo ngo-$x$, inombolo isondela ku-${nc}$ nesihlukanisi sisondela ku-${dc}$, ngakho inani lomkhawulo ngu-${ans}$.

ca1_maxMinFind.prompt: Uma inani eliphezulu lomsebenzi $f(x)={f}$ ($a$ uyisingeniso) ebanjeni elivaliwe $[{s},{t}]$ lingu-${M}$, liyini inani eliphansi kakhulu kuleli banga? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ebanjeni elivaliwe, thola okuphezulu nokuphansi ngokuqhathanisa amanani omkhawulo angaphakathi namanani omsebenzi ezigcawini zombili zebanga.
Thola inani eliphezulu usagcine u-$a$, unqume u-$a$, bese uthola inani eliphansi ngendlela efanayo.
ca1_maxMinFind.explanation: Uma kuqhathaniswa amanani omkhawulo angaphakathi nawomsebenzi ezigcawini zombili, inani eliphezulu ngu-${mx0}+a$ futhi lokhu kungu-${M}$, ngakho $a={av}$. Inani eliphansi ngu-${mn0}+a={ans}$.

ca1_monoGiven.prompt: Uma umsebenzi wekhubhikhi $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ ziyizingeniso) uncipha ebanjeni elivaliwe $[{m},{n}]$, futhi unyuka emabangeni amabili $(-\infty,{m}]$, $[{n},\infty)$ ngakunye, uyini umehluko phakathi kwenani eliphezulu neliphansi lika-$f(x)$ ebanjeni $[{m},{n}]$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: $f'(x)=0$ ezindaweni $x={m}$, $x={n}$ lapho $f$ ishintsha isuka ekukhuleni iye ekuncipheni, nasekuncipheni iye ekukhuleni.

Ngoba $f'(x)$ iyisisho se-quadratic esinezimpande $x={m}$, $x={n}$, yibhale njengo-$f'(x)=($i-coefficient yetemu elingu-$x^2)\times{fm}{fn}$ bese uthole u-$a$, $b$. Ebanjeni elincipha, inani eliphezulu neliphansi livela kuliphi iphoyinti lokugcina?
ca1_monoGiven.explanation: Ngoba $f'(x)=0$ ku-$x={m}$, $x={n}$ lapho kushintsha ukukhula nokuncipha, $f'(x)={d3}{fm}{fn}$. Uma kuqhathaniswa ama-coefficient, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Ngoba ncipha ebanjeni, inani eliphezulu ngu-$f({m})={fmv}$, eliphansi ngu-$f({n})={fnv}$, futhi umehluko wawo ungu-${ans}$.

ca1_mvtBound.prompt: Umsebenzi onokuphikiswa $f(x)$ unalo ${lo}\le f'(x)\le {hi}$ kuwo wonke ama-$x$ ayinombolo yangempela futhi ${cond}$. Liyini inani eliphezulu lika-$f({b})$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ngetiyori yenani eliphakathi kukhona $c$ onga-$f(b)-f(a)=f'(c)(b-a)$. Sebenzisa inani eliphezulu lika-$f'(c)$.
Uma kunamaphoyinti amabili aziwayo, cabanga ngelisondele kakhulu kuleli ofuna ukulithola.
ca1_mvtBound.explanation: Iphoyinti elaziwayo eliseduze kakhulu no-$f({b})$ olifunayo ngu-$x={na}$ ($f({na})={nm}$) futhi igebe lingu-${gap}$. Ngetiyori yenani eliphakathi, $f({b})-({nm})=f'(c)\times{gap}\le {hi}\times{gap}$, ngakho $f({b})\le {ans}$. Lelo nani lingatholakala ngempela ngomsebenzi onomthambeka ohlala ungu-${hi}$, ngakho inani eliphezulu ngu-${ans}$.

ca1_mvtC.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={f}$, liyini inani le-$c$ elingu-real ($c$ likhulu kuno-${a}$ futhi lincane kuno-${b}$) eligcwalisa itiyori yenani eliphakathi ebanjeni $[{a},{b}]$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: I-$c$ yetiyori yenani eliphakathi igcwalisa $\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}=f'(c)$.
Qala uthole izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha, bese ukhetha isixazululo se-$f'(c)=($izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha$)$ esiseduze kwebanga elivulekile.
ca1_mvtC.explanation: Izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha ngu-$\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}={sl}$, futhi isixazululo se-$f'(c)={sl}$ ebanjeni $({a},{b})$ siyi-$c={ans}$ kuphela.

ca1_noExtremum.prompt: Kumsebenzi wekhubhikhi $f(x)={f}$, zingaki izinombolo ezigcwele $a$ ezenza ukuthi $f$ ingabi namanani omkhawulo? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Umsebenzi wekhubhikhi ongenawo amanani omkhawulo usho ukuthi uphawu luka-$f'(x)$ alushintshi.
Bhala i-discriminant $D\le 0$ ye-equation ye-quadratic $f'(x)=0$ njengokungalingani ku-$a$ bese ubala izixazululo ezigcwele.
ca1_noExtremum.explanation: Ngoba uphawu luka-$f'(x)$ akufanele lushintshe, i-discriminant ye-$f'(x)=0$ ithi $D\le 0$. Izinombolo ezigcwele $a$ ezigcwalisa lokhu ziyi-${lo}\le a\le {hi}$, ngakho zingu-${ans}$.

ca1_optimBox.prompt: Ephepheni eliyisiquxande elinobude obungu-${W}$ cm nobubanzi obungu-${H}$ cm, kusikwa izikwele ezilinganayo emakoneni amane, bese kugoqwa okusele kwenziwe ibhokisi elingenasivalo. Ivolumu enkulu kakhulu yebhokisi ingamasentimitha-cube amangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Thatha ubude bohlangothi lwesikwele esisikiwe njengo-$x$ bese ubhala ivolumu yebhokisi njengomsebenzi $V(x)$ ka-$x$.
Ivolumu iba inkulu kakhulu kunani lesisombululo se-$V'(x)=0$ elisebangeni $0<x<(\text{uhlangothi olufushane})\div 2$.
ca1_optimBox.explanation: Uma uhlangothi lwesikwele esisikiwe lungu-$x$ cm, $V(x)=x({W}-2x)({H}-2x)$ ($0<x<{hh}$), futhi ngokuxazulula $V'(x)=0$, ivolumu iba inkulu kakhulu ku-$x={x}$ lapho ishintsha isuka ekukhuleni iye ekuncipheni. Ivolumu enkulu kakhulu ingu-${ans}$ cm³.

ca1_optimProfit.prompt: Uma into ikhiqizwa ngamayunithi angu-$x$ ngosuku ($0\le x\le {X}$) yonke ithengiswe, izindleko zizonke ngu-$C(x)={cost}$ (man won), futhi intengo yeyunithi ngayinye ngu-${price}$ man won. Inzuzo enkulu kakhulu ngosuku (okuthengisiwe kususwe izindleko zizonke) ingamangaki man won? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Thatha inzuzo njengo-$P(x)={price}x-C(x)$ bese uxazulula $P'(x)=0$.
Qhathanisa hhayi kuphela inani lomsebenzi ku-$x$ ye-maximum, kodwa nokwe-$x=0$ no-$x={X}$ ezigcineni zesikhawu.
ca1_optimProfit.explanation: $P(x)={price}x-C(x)$ futhi ku-$P'(x)=0$ iphoyinti le-local maximum esikhaweni ngu-$x={xs}$. Kuleli phoyinti nasezindaweni zokugcina, $P({xs})={ans}$, $P(0)={p0}$, $P({X})={pX}$, ngakho inani elikhulu kakhulu ngu-${ans}$ man won.

ca1_powerFindN.prompt: Kunombolo yemvelo $n$, $f(x)={f}$. Uma $f'({a})={V}$, inani lika-$n$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: I-derivative ye-$x^n$ ngu-$nx^{n-1}$.
Bhala $f'(x)$ njengesisho sika-$n$, bese ucabanga ukuthi inani lishintsha kanjani uma u-$n$ ekhula.
ca1_powerFindN.explanation: $f'(x)={cc}\cdot n\cdot x^{n-1}-{kk}$, ngakho $f'({a})={cc}\cdot n\cdot{a}^{n-1}-{kk}$. Leli nani likhula uma u-$n$ ekhula, ngakho kukhona inombolo yemvelo eyodwa kuphela $n$ enenani ${V}$, futhi $n={ans}$.

ca1_powerTangentN.prompt: Ekhefini $y={fx}$ ($n$ iyinombolo yemvelo engu-$2$ noma ngaphezulu), uma i-$y$-intercept ye-tangent ephoyintini elinesixhumanisi se-$x$ esingu-${a}$ ingu-${V}$, inani lika-$n$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: I-derivative ye-$x^n$ ngu-$nx^{n-1}$, ngakho i-slope ye-tangent iyisisho sika-$n$.
Uma i-$y$-intercept ye-tangent ibhalwa njengesisho sika-$n$, inani layo eliphelele likhula njengoba u-$n$ ekhula.
ca1_powerTangentN.explanation: Ku-$f(x)={fx}$, $f'(x)={cc}nx^{n-1}$, ngakho i-$y$-intercept ye-tangent ngu-$f({a})-{a}f'({a})=(1-n)\cdot{ccp}\cdot{a}^n$. Inani layo eliphelele likhula njengoba u-$n$ ekhula, ngakho kukhona u-$n$ oyedwa kuphela onenani ${V}$, futhi $n={ans}$.

ca1_prodAbstract.prompt: Kuma-function amabili ahlukaniseka $f(x)$, $g(x)$, $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, $g({a})={u}$, $g'({a})={w}$. Uma $h(x)={hx}$, inani le-$h'({a})$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Umthetho womkhiqizo ngu-$\{f(x)g(x)\}'=f'(x)g(x)+f(x)g'(x)$.
Uma umkhiqizo unezinto ezintathu noma ngaphezulu, engeza amatemu etholakala ngokuhlukanisa eyodwa ngesikhathi.

ca1_returnTime.prompt: Iphoyinti P elihamba emugqeni wenombolo liqala ku-origin ngesikhathi $t=0$, futhi isivinini sakhona ngesikhathi $t$ ($t\ge0$) ngu-$v(t)={v}$. Isivinini sephoyinti P ngesikhathi lapho libuyela ku-origin okokuqala ngemva kokuqala siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Isikhundla yi-antiderivative yesivinini, futhi njengoba isikhundla sokuqala singu-$0$, $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds$.
Thola inani elincane kakhulu eliphozithivu lika-$t$ elenza $x(t)=0$ bese ulifaka ku-$v(t)$.
ca1_returnTime.explanation: $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds={xt}$ futhi amanani aphozithivu $t$ lapho $x(t)=0$ angu-${rs}$. Ku-$t={t0}$ okuncane kakhulu, $v({t0})={ans}$.

ca1_rootCountK.prompt: Ngomsebenzi $f(x)={f}$, mingaki inombolo ephelele $k$ eyenza ukuthi isibalo $f(x)=k$ sibe nezimpande zangempela ezihlukene ezingu-${nr}$ ngqo? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Cabanga ngenani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana kwegrafu ye-$y=f(x)$ nomugqa ovundlile $y=k$.
Thola inani eliphezulu nelincane endaweni, bese unquma ukuthi $k$ isebangeni elinjani ukuze kube namaphoyinti angu-${nr}$.
ca1_rootCountK.explanation: Ukuthola amanani amaphoyinti okuphela ku-$f'(x)=0$ kunikeza ${ext}$. Ukuze kube nezimpande zangempela ezihlukene ezingu-${nr}$, kumele ${rng}$, ngakho izinombolo eziphelele $k$ zingu-${ans}$.

ca1_tangentFromPoint.prompt: Imikhiqizo yamathambeka emigqeni emibili eyithangenti esuka kuphoyinti $({p},{q})$ iya ku-curve $y={f}$ ingakanani? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma ukuxhumanisa kuka-$x$ kwephoyinti lokuthinta kungu-$t$, ithangenti ingu-$y=f'(t)(x-t)+f(t)$, futhi lo mugqa kumele ube nga-$y={q}$ uma $x={p}$.
Kule nqubo uthola isibalo se-quadratic ku-$t$, uthole izimpande zombili, bese ubala ithambeka $f'(t)$.
ca1_tangentFromPoint.explanation: Uma ukuxhumanisa kuka-$x$ kwephoyinti lokuthinta kungu-$t$, ngomthetho wokuthi $y={q}$ uma $x={p}$ uthola isibalo se-quadratic, izimpande zingu-$t={t1}, {t2}$. Amathambeka angu-$f'({t1})$ no-$f'({t2})$ ngokulandelana, futhi umkhiqizo wawo ungu-${ans}$.

ca1_tangentIntercept.prompt: Ithangenti ephuma ephoyinti elingu-$x$ elingu-${a}$ ku-curve $y={f}$ ihlangana ne-eksisi ye-$y$ kuphi? Thola ukuxhumanisa kuka-$y$ kwalelo phoyinti. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ithambeka lethangenti liyi-derivative ephoyintini lokuthinta $f'({a})$.
Esibalweni sethangenti $y-f({a})=f'({a})\{x-({a})\}$, thola inani le-$y$ uma $x=0$.

ca1_tangentIntersect.prompt: Ithangenti ephuma ephoyinti elingu-$x$ elingu-${a}$ ku-curve $y={f}$ ihlangana ne-curve kanye ngaphezulu kwelinye iphoyinti elingelona ilokuthinta. Ukuxhumanisa kuka-$y$ kwalelo phoyinti kuyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuxhumanisa kuka-$x$ kwamaphoyinti okuhlangana kwethangenti ne-curve kuyizimpande ze-(isibalo se-curve)−(isibalo sethangenti)$=0$, futhi lesi sibalo sinempande ephindwe kabili ku-$x={a}$.
Isamba sezimpande ezintathu zesibalo se-cubic sitholakala kokulinganisayo kuka-$x^2$, ngakho thola impande eyodwa esele bese uyifaka kusibalo se-curve.
ca1_tangentIntersect.explanation: (Curve)−(ithangenti)$=0$ isibalo se-cubic esinempande ephindwe kabili ku-$x={a}$, futhi isamba sezimpande ezintathu sinqunywa ukuhlobana kwezimpande nokulinganisayo. Impande esele ngu-$x={s}$, futhi uma ifakwa kusibalo se-curve, ukuxhumanisa kuka-$y$ kungu-${ans}$.

ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.prompt: Kunemigqa emibili ethinta i-curve $y={f}$ enethambeka elingu-${m}$. Isamba sama-intercept ka-$y$ alemigqa emibili singakanani? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma ithambeka lingu-${m}$, ukuxhumanisa kuka-$x$ kwephoyinti lokuthinta kuyisisombululo se-$f'(x)={m}$.
Kuphoyinti ngalinye lokuthinta $(s, f(s))$, i-intercept ka-$y$ ngu-$f(s)-s\cdot{m}$.
ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.explanation: Ngokuxazulula isibalo $f'(x)={m}$, ukuxhumanisa kuka-$x$ kwamaphoyinti okuthinta kungu-${s1}$ no-${s2}$. Ngokuthola i-intercept ka-$y$ yethangenti ngayinye bese uzihlanganisa, uthola ${ans}$.

ca1_throwImpact.prompt: Ibhola lijikijelwe phezulu lisuka ekuphakameni okungu-${h0}$ m ngaphezu komhlaba, futhi ukuphakama kwebhola ngemuva kwamasekhondi angu-$t$ kwakungu-$h(t)={h}$ (m). Isivinini sebhola ngomzuzwana lishayisa phansi singakanani ngo-m/s? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Umzuzwana wokushayisa phansi yinani elihle le-$t$ lapho $h(t)=0$. Isivinini ngu-$h'(t)$.
Xazulula $h(t)=0$ uthole impande ephozithivu, bese ubala inani eliphelele lesivinini kuleso sikhathi.
ca1_throwImpact.explanation: Impande ephozithivu ye-$h(t)=0$ ngu-$t={T}$ amasekhondi, futhi $h'(t)={v0}-10t$, ngakho $h'({T})={vv}$. Isivinini sibalwa njengenani eliphelele lesivinini esiqondisiwe, ngakho singu-${ans}$ m/s.

ca1_totalDistPos.prompt: Indawo yephoyinti P elihamba emgqeni wezinombolo ngesikhathi $t$ ($t\ge0$) ingu-$x(t)={f}$. Ibanga elihanjwe yiphoyinti P kusukela ku-$t=0$ kuya ku-$t={T}$ lingakanani? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ibanga elihanjiwe akuyona inguquko yendawo, kodwa isamba samabanga ezigaba ngazinye ezehlukaniswe ezikhathini lapho isiqondiso siguquka.
Qala ngokuhlola ukuthi ngabe izikhathi lapho $v(t)=x'(t)=0$ ziphakathi nesigaba $(0,{T})$.
ca1_totalDistPos.explanation: Ngokuthola izikhathi lapho $v(t)=x'(t)=0$, izikhathi lapho isiqondiso siguquka esigabeni ngu-${turns}$. Ngokwehlukanisa isigaba kulezi zikhathi nokuhlanganisa amanani aphelele enguquko yendawo, ibanga elihanjiwe lingu-${ans}$.

ca1_totalDistVel.prompt: Isivinini sephoyinti P elihamba emugqeni wenombolo ngesikhathi $t$ ($t\ge0$) singu-$v(t)={v}$. Ibanga eliqhutshwe iphoyinti P kusukela ku-$t=0$ kuya ku-$t={T}$ liyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Ibanga elihanjiwe liyinani lokuhlanganisa kwesivinini esingenasiqondiso $|v(t)|$.
Hlukanisa isikhawu ngezikhathi lapho $v(t)=0$ bese uhlanganisa ngokuhambisana nophawu.
ca1_totalDistVel.explanation: Izikhathi lapho uphawu lwesivinini lushintsha ngaphakathi kwesikhawu ngu-${zs}$. Uma isikhawu sihlukaniswa kulezi zikhathi, uphawu luhlala lufana engxenyeni ngayinye, ngakho ngingeza amanani aphelele e-$\int v(t)\,dt$ ngithole ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_twoRootsK.prompt: Kumsebenzi $f(x)={f}$, siyini isamba sawo wonke amanani amaqiniso $k$ lapho isibalo $f(x)=k$ sinezimpande eziqinisweni ezehlukene ezingu-${nr}$ ngqo? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Cabanga ngomngcele lapho inani lezimpande ezehlukene lishintsha, okungukuthi lapho umugqa othe nkqo $y=k$ uthinta igrafu ezindaweni ze-extreme.
Ngokwesimo segrafu, nquma ukuthi iyiphi i-extreme enika izimpande ezingu-${nr}$ ngqo.
ca1_twoRootsK.explanation: Amanani e-extreme angu-${ext}$. Uma kubhekwa inani lezindawo zokuhlangana lapho umugqa othe nkqo uthinta igrafu ezindaweni ze-extreme nalapho ungazithinti, amanani $k$ afanele angu-${kk}$, futhi isamba sawo ngu-${ans}$.

ca1_velZeroAccel.prompt: Isikhundla sephoyinti P elihamba emugqeni wenombolo ngesikhathi $t$ ($t\ge0$) singu-$x(t)={f}$. Isivinini sephoyinti P sibe ngu-$0$ ezikhathini ezimbili; ukusheshisa ngesikhathi sesibili (esilandelayo) kungakanani? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Isivinini siyi-derivative yesikhundla ku-$t$, $v(t)=x'(t)$, ukusheshisa kuyi-derivative yesivinini, $a(t)=v'(t)$.
Thola izimpande ezimbili ze-$v(t)=0$, bese ufaka eyesibili ku-$a(t)$.
ca1_velZeroAccel.explanation: $v(t)=x'(t)$ futhi izimpande ezimbili ze-$v(t)=0$ ngu-$t={t1}$, $t={t2}$. Inani le-$a(t)=v'(t)$ ngesikhathi sesibili $t={t2}$ ngu-${ans}$.

ca2_addTheorem.prompt: Uma ${ga}$, ${gb}$ futhi ${ra}$, ${rb}$, thola inani le-${ask}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa amanani anikeziwe ne-$\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$ ukuthola amanani asele e-trigonometric. Uphawu lunqunywa yi-quadrant lapho i-engeli ikhona.
Faka amanani atholakele ku-addition theorem.

ca2_areaCurves.prompt: Uma indawo ebiyelwe amagrafu amabili $y={f}$, $y={g}$ nemigqa emibili $x={a}$, $x={b}$ ingu-$S$, thola inani le-${ask}$. (Qaphela: i-$x$-axis ngu-$y=0$.) (Bhala njengengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Hlanganisa umehluko wesibalo segrafu esiphezulu nesiphansi esikhawini.

Sebenzisa $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ ukuthola ama-antiderivative ezimisebenzi ze-exponential, trigonometric ne-rational; uma isimo sixubile sebenzisa ukuhlanganisa ngokufaka esikhundleni.
ca2_areaCurves.explanation: Esikhawini $[{a},{b}]$, $y={f}$ iphezulu, ngakho $S=\int_{{a}}^{{b}}({f}-{gg})\,dx={wk}$. Ngakho inani le-${ask}$ ngu-${res}$.

ca2_ballDistance.prompt: Ibhola lifakwa lehlele phansi ukusuka ekuphakameni okungu-${h}$ m. Njalo lapho lishayisa phansi, liphinda likhuphuke libe ngu-${ratio}$ wokuphakama kwangaphambilini, bese liwa futhi, lokhu kuphindwa kungapheli. Isamba sebanga lonke elihanjiwe libhola singamamitha amangaki? (Bhala njengengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Cabanga ngokuwa kokuqala okungu-${h}$ m, kanye nebanga ngokunyuka nokwehla ngalokho (okuphindwe kabili ukuphakama okunyukile).
Ukuphakama okunyukile kwakha uchungechunge lwe-geometric olunentuthuko yokuqala (ukuphakama kokuqala)×(isilinganiso sokubuya).
ca2_ballDistance.explanation: Isamba sokuphakama okunyukile singu-${up}$ m, ibanga lokunyuka nokwehla liphindwe kabili, ngakho ibanga lonke ngu-${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_ballReverse.prompt: Ibhola lehliswa lisuka phezulu othile, futhi njalo lapho lithinta phansi liphinde liqhume liye ekuphakameni okuphindwe ${ratio}$ kokuphakama kokugcina kokuwa, liphinde lilokhu liwa njalo ngokungapheli. Uma ukuphakama kokuqhuma kwe-${nb}$ kungu-${H}$ m, isamba sebanga lonke elihanjwe yibhola singamamitha amangaki? (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Uma ukuphakama kokuqala kungu-$h$ m, njalo ukuqhuma kuphakama ngokuphindwe ${ratio}$ kokuphakama kokugcina, ngakho ukuphakama kokuqhuma kwe-$n$ ngu-$h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{n}$.
Qala uthole i-$h$, bese uthola ibanga lonke ngesamba sebanga lokuqala lokuwa $h$ nebanga lokukhuphuka nokwehla (kabili ukuphakama kokukhuphuka).
ca2_ballReverse.explanation: Uma ukuphakama kokuqala kungu-$h$ m, ${H}=h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{{nb}}$, ngakho $h={h}$. Isamba sokuphakama kokukhuphuka singu-${up}$ m, ngakho ibanga lonke ngu-${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_chainTable.prompt: Ngemisebenzi emibili ehlukaniseka $f$, $g$, ${tbl}$. Uma $h(x)={hx}$, thola inani le-$h'({a})$. (Ungaloba njengedesimali noma njengengxenyana efana no-3/4)
hints: Bheka ukuthi i-$h$ ngumkhiqizo, isilinganiso noma umsebenzi oyinhlanganisela, bese usebenzisa i-formula ye-derivative ehambisanayo.

Thola ethebuleni amanani omsebenzi nama-derivative adingekayo ku-$x={a}$ bese uwafaka. Uma kungumsebenzi oyinhlanganisela, inani lomsebenzi wangaphakathi liyiphoyinti elifakwa emsebenzini wangaphandle.

ca2_commonTangent.prompt: Amajika amabili $y={f}$, $y={g}$ ahlangana endaweni ene-$x={x0}$, futhi anayo i-tangent efanayo kuleyo ndawo. Ngama-constant $a$, $b$, thola inani le-$ab$. (Loba izinombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma amajika amabili ehlangana ku-$x={x0}$, amanani omsebenzi alinganayo, futhi uma i-tangent ifana, ama-derivative alinganayo.
Xazulula ngokubambisana izibalo ezimbili ze-$a$, $b$ uthole $a$, $b$.
ca2_commonTangent.explanation: Ku-$y={f}$, ku-$x={x0}$ inani lomsebenzi ngu-${F}$ ne-derivative ngu-${D}$, ngakho ${wk}$. Ngakho $ab={ans}$.

ca2_derivExpLog.prompt: Ngomsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$, thola inani le-$f'({x0})$. (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthole i-$f'(x)$ usebenzisa $(e^{x})'=e^{x}$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ nomthetho womsebenzi oyinhlanganisela.
Uma inani elifakiwe lisesimweni se-$\ln m$, sebenzisa ukuthi $e^{\ln m}=m$.

ca2_doubleAngle.prompt: Uma ${cd}$, thola inani le-${ask}$. (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa $\sin2\alpha=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha$, $\cos2\alpha=\cos^{2}\alpha-\sin^{2}\alpha$ no-$\sin^{2}\alpha+\cos^{2}\alpha=1$.

Uma kunikezwe $\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha$, zama ukufaka isikwele ezinhlangothini zombili. Uma $\tan\alpha=t$, $\sin2\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos2\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$, futhi uma $\tan\frac{\alpha}{2}=t$, $\sin\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$.

ca2_eExponent.prompt: Uma $\lim_{{to}}{ex}=e^{k}$, thola inani le-$k$. (Ungaloba njengedesimali noma njengengxenyana efana no-3/4)

Hlukanisa futhi uphindaphinde i-exponent ukuze i-$h$ esisekelweni ne-exponent kube yizingxenyana eziphambene.

ca2_expLogLimit.prompt: Thola inani lomkhawulo olandelayo. $\lim_{{to}}{ex}$ (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Shintsha isisho ukuze usebenzise $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{e^{x}-1}{x}=1$, $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}=1$.
Phindaphinda futhi uhlukanise ngama-coefficient ukuze isihlukanisi nenombolo kube nesimo esifanayo.
ca2_expLogLimit.explanation: Uma isisho sishintshwa ukuze kusetshenziswe imikhawulo eyisisekelo, ${wk}$, ngakho inani lomkhawulo ngu-${res}$.

ca2_extremaPair.prompt: Umsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$ unenani elilodwa kuphela eliphezulu lendawo nelilodwa eliphansi lendawo. Uma kunenani eliphezulu lendawo ku-$x=\alpha$ neliphansi lendawo ku-$x=\beta$, thola inani lika-$\alpha-\beta$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Thola u-$x$ lapho $f'(x)=0$, bese ubheka ukuthi uphawu luka-$f'(x)$ lushintsha kanjani ngaphambi nangemva kwalo.
Uma uphawu luka-$f'(x)$ lushintsha lusuka kuyiphozithivu luye kunegethivu, kuyinani eliphezulu lendawo; uma lusuka kunegethivu luye kuyiphozithivu, kuyinani eliphansi lendawo.
ca2_extremaPair.explanation: Ngoba $f'(x)={fp}$, kunenani eliphezulu lendawo ku-$x={mx}$ neliphansi lendawo ku-$x={mn}$. Ngakho $\alpha-\beta=({mx})-({mn})={ans}$.

ca2_geoConvCount.prompt: Thola isamba sazo zonke izinombolo ezigcwele $x$ ezenza ukuthi lokhu okulandelayo kuhlangane. ${obj}$ (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uchungechunge $\{r^{n}\}$ luhlangana uma $-1<r\le 1$, futhi uchungechunge lwejometri olungapheli $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}r^{n}$ luhlangana uma $-1<r<1$.
Bhala isimo sokuhlangana njengokungalingani ku-$x$, bese uthola zonke izinombolo ezigcwele ezigcwalisa lokho kungalingani uzengeze.
ca2_geoConvCount.explanation: Ngesimo sokuhlangana, ${rg}$. Izinombolo ezigcwele $x$ ezigcwalisa lokhu ziyi-${lst}$, ngakho isamba sazo ngu-${ans}$.

ca2_geoSeriesParam.prompt: Uma uchungechunge olungapheli $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{term}$ luhlangana futhi isamba salo singu-${S}$, thola inani lesingeniso $r$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Isamba sochungechunge lwejometri olungapheli ngu-(ithemu lokuqala)÷(1-isilinganiso esivamile).
Qala uthole ithemu lokuqala nesilinganiso esivamile ethemini elijwayelekile lochungechunge.
ca2_geoSeriesParam.explanation: Ithemu lokuqala ${fa}$ nesilinganiso esivamile ${ratio}$, ngakho isamba singu-${sumf}={S}$. Uma lokhu kuxazululwa, $r={res}$.

ca2_implicitDeriv.prompt: Uma $y$ kungumsebenzi ka-$x$, ephoyintini $ {pt} $ kumcibisholo ${eq}$, thola inani lika-${what}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Phikisa izinhlangothi zombili zesibalo ngokuya ngo-$x$, kodwa amatemu aqukethe u-$y$ aphindaphindwe ngo-$\frac{ dy }{ dx }$.
Faka izixhumanisi zephoyinti esibalweni esiphikisiwe bese uxazulula u-$\frac{ dy }{ dx }$. Uma kuyi-derivative yesibili, phikisa isibalo esiphikisiwe kanye futhi ngokuya ngo-$x$.
ca2_implicitDeriv.explanation: Uma izinhlangothi zombili ziphikiswa ngokuya ngo-$x$ bese kubekwa $y'=\frac{ dy }{ dx }$, ${wk}$, ngakho inani lingu-${res}$.

ca2_integralBasic.prompt: Uma $I=\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({fx}\right)dx$, thola inani lika-${ask}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa $\int e^{x}dx=e^{x}$, $\int\sin x\,dx=-\cos x$, $\int\cos x\,dx=\sin x$, $\int\frac{1}{x}dx=\ln|x|$, $\int\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}dx=\tan x$.
Qaphela ukuthi $\int f(kx)\,dx=\frac{1}{k}F(kx)$, bese ufaka imikhawulo ephezulu nephansi bese uyasusa.

ca2_inverseDeriv.prompt: Uma umsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$ onyukayo kusethi yazo zonke izinombolo zangempela unomsebenzi ophambene $g(x)$, thola inani lika-$g'({b})$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthole u-$a$ ogcwalisa $f(a)={b}$.
I-derivative yomsebenzi ophambene: $g'({b})=\frac{1}{f'(a)}$.

ca2_limitPair.prompt: Kuzingeniso $a$, $b$, uma ${eq}$, thola inani lika-$ab$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma umkhawulo ukhona kodwa isihlukanisi siba ngu-$0$ emkhawulweni, inombolo nayo kumele ibe ngu-$0$. Qala ngalesi simo ukuthola ubuhlobo phakathi kuka-$a$ no-$b$.
Ngemva kokufaka lobo buhlobo, hlukanisa inombolo ibe yizici, susa isikwele, noma usebenzise $1-\cos x=\frac{\sin^{2}x}{1+\cos x}$ ukuthola umkhawulo, bese uwulinganisa nenani elinikeziwe.

ca2_lineAngle.prompt: Uma ikhoneni elibukhali eliqoqwa yimigqa emibili $ {l1} $, $ {l2} $ linosayizi $\theta$, thola inani lika-$\tan\theta$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Ikhoneni $\alpha$ elenziwa umugqa onomthambeka $m$ nohlangothi oluhle lwe-eksisi ka-$x$ ligcwalisa $\tan\alpha=m$. Uma ushintsha isisho sibe uhlobo lwe-$y=mx+k$, ungazi umthambeka.
Sebenzisa ithiyori yokungeza ye-tangent yomehluko wamakhoneni amabili, bese uthatha inani eliyiphozithivu ngoba ikhoneni liyabukhali.

ca2_monotoneParam.prompt: Thola inani lezinombolo ezigcwele $a$ ezenza ukuthi umsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$ unyuke kusethi yazo zonke izinombolo zangempela. (Uma $f'(x)\ge 0$ kuwo wonke ama-$x$ angempela, kuthiwa uyanyuka.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuze umsebenzi onokuphikiswa unyuke kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela, kumele $f'(x)\ge0$ kuwo wonke ama-$x$.
Thola ibanga lika-$a$ lapho inani eliphansi lika-$f'(x)$ (noma i-discriminant) lingabi ngaphansi kuka-$0$, bese ubala izinombolo ezigcwele.
ca2_monotoneParam.explanation: ${wk}$. Ngakho izinombolo ezigcwele $a$ ezigcwalisa isimo ziyi-${lst}$, futhi zingu-${ans}$ sizonke.

ca2_motionReverse.prompt: Isikhundla sephoyinti P elihamba emgqeni wezinombolo ngesikhathi $t$ ($t>0$) singu-$x(t)={xt}$. Thola ukusheshisa ngesikhathi lapho isivinini sephoyinti P siba ngu-$0$ okokuqala. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Isivinini siyi-derivative yesikhundla ngokuya ngo-$t$, $v(t)=x'(t)$, futhi ukusheshisa ngu-$a(t)=v'(t)$.
Thola inombolo encane kakhulu eyiphozithivu $t$ egcwalisa $v(t)=0$, bese uyifaka ku-$a(t)$.
ca2_motionReverse.explanation: Ngoba ${wk}$, ukusheshisa ngesikhathi lapho isivinini siba ngu-$0$ okokuqala kungu-${res}$.

ca2_paramDeriv.prompt: Kumcibisholo $x={xt}$, $y={yt}$, uma $t={t0}$, thola inani lika-${what}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Ukuphikisa umsebenzi omiswe ngama-parameter: $\frac{ dy }{ dx }=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}$.
I-derivative yesibili itholakala ngokuveza $\frac{ dy }{ dx }$ njengesisho sika-$t$, uyiphikise ngokuya ngo-$t$, bese uhlukanisa ngo-$\frac{ dx }{ dt }$.

ca2_partialSumSeries.prompt: Uma isamba sesifanekiso $\{a_n\}$ kusukela ethemini yokuqala kuya kwelesi-$n$ singu-$S_n=\frac{{sa}}{{sb}}$, thola inani lika-${ask}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)

Qala ukuhlukanisa ukuthi inani elifunwayo yitemu noma isamba sochungechunge. Isamba sochungechunge olungapheli ngumkhawulo wesamba esingenxenye $S_n$, futhi itemu litholakala ngo-$S_n-S_{n-1}$.

ca2_partsEval.prompt: Uma $I=\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}{fx}\,dx$, thola inani lika-${ask}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Esiphindweni ngaphakathi kwe-integral, beka ohlangothi olulula uma luphikiswa njengo-$u$, nolulula ukuluhlanganisa njengo-$v'$, bese wenza ukuhlanganisa ngezingxenye $\int uv'dx=uv-\int u'v\,dx$.
Uma kunesidingo, phinda ukuhlanganisa ngezingxenye kanye. Bala amanani emisebenzi ye-trigonometry ezigcawini zebanga.
ca2_partsEval.explanation: Ngokuhlanganisa ngezingxenye, ${wk}$, ngakho inani lika-${ask}$ lingu-${res}$.

ca2_partsFormula.prompt: Umsebenzi $f$ uyi-differentiable futhi i-$f'$ iyaqhubeka. Uma ${given}$, thola inani le-${tg}$. (Ungabhala ngedesimali noma ngengxenyana njenge-3/4)

Beka i-$f'(x)$ njenge-$v'$, nesibalo esiphindaphindiwe njenge-$u$.

ca2_quotientDeriv.prompt: Ngomsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$, thola inani le-$f'({x0})$. (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)

Thola amanani e-$u$, $v$ ne-$u'$, $v'$ ku-$x={x0}$ ngayinye bese uwafaka.

ca2_riemann.prompt: Uma $L=\lim_{n\to\infty}{pre}\sum_{k=1}^{n}{body}$, thola inani le-${ask}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)

Isikhawu se-definite integral sinqunywa yimikhawulo yenani le-$\frac{k}{n}$ uma $k=1$ nalapho $k=n$.
ca2_riemann.explanation: Uma uguqula uchungechunge lube yi-definite integral, $L={wk}$. Ngakho inani le-${ask}$ ngu-${res}$.

ca2_rootCount.prompt: Thola inani lezimpande zangempela ezihlukene zesibalo ${eq}$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Beka uhlangothi lwesobunxele njenge-$f(x)$, bese ucabanga ngenani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana kwegophe $y=f(x)$ nolayini $y=k$ ($k$ iyi-constant yesokudla).
Hlola ukwenyuka nokwehla kwe-$f$, uqinisekise amanani akhulu nancane namanani lapho $x\to\pm\infty$, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi i-$k$ ihlobene kanjani nawo. Linganisa inani le-$e$ ngo-$2.7<e<2.8$.
ca2_rootCount.explanation: Njengoba ${fpx}$, ngokuhlola ukwenyuka nokwehla, amanani akhulu nancane angu-${ext}$ futhi imikhawulo ngu-${lim}$. Lapha ${cm}$, ngakho amaphoyinti okuhlangana egophe $y=f(x)$ nolayini $y=k$ angu-${ans}$, futhi izimpande zangempela nazo ziyi-${ans}$.

ca2_rootCountParam.prompt: Thola inani lama-integer $k$ enza isibalo ${eq}$ sibe nezimpande zangempela ezihlukene ezingu-${nr}$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Beka uhlangothi lwesobunxele njenge-$f(x)$, bese uthola ububanzi be-$k$ obenza amaphoyinti okuhlangana egophe $y=f(x)$ nolayini $y=k$ abe ngu-${nr}$ ngokwenyuka nokwehla kwegrafu namanani akhulu nancane.
Uma i-$e$ ikhona emanani akhulu nancane, linganisa ngo-$2.7<e<2.8$ bese ubala ama-integer ababanzini.
ca2_rootCountParam.explanation: Njengoba ${fpx}$, amanani akhulu nancane angu-${ext}$, futhi ukuze kube namaphoyinti okuhlangana angu-${nr}$, ${rg}$. Ama-integer $k$ kulobu bubanzi angu-${lst}$, ngakho angu-${ans}$.

ca2_seqGeoLimit.prompt: Thola inani lomkhawulo wolandelwano olulandelayo. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Amandla anenani eliphelele elikhulu kakhulu lesisekelo esihlukanisini nesibalweni anquma umkhawulo.
Uma uhlukanisa isibalo nesihlukanisi ngalawo mandla, amagama anenani eliphelele elincane lesisekelo aya ku-$0$.
ca2_seqGeoLimit.explanation: Uma uhlukanisa isibalo nesihlukanisi ngegama elinenani eliphelele elikhulu kakhulu lesisekelo ${dom}$, amagama asele aya ku-$0$ futhi kusala ingxenye ye-coefficient kuphela, ${wk}$. Ngakho inani lomkhawulo ngu-${res}$.

ca2_seqLimit.prompt: Thola inani lomkhawulo wolandelwano olulandelayo. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Hlukanisa isibalo nesihlukanisi ngegama lezinga eliphezulu esihlukanisini, noma uma kunempande yenza i-rationalization kuqala.
Uma $n\to\infty$, amagama anjenge-$\frac{1}{n}$, $\frac{1}{n^{2}}$ aya ku-$0$.
ca2_seqLimit.explanation: Uma ulungisa isibalo, ${wk}$, ngakho inani lomkhawulo ngu-${res}$.

ca2_seqSumLimit.prompt: Thola inani lomkhawulo olandelayo. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^{2}=\frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^{3}=\left\{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}\right\}^{2}$ ukuveza isamba njenge-polynomial ku-$n$.
Uma $n\to\infty$, qhathanisa kuphela ama-coefficient emigomo ephezulu kunazo zonke yenombolo nesihlukanisi.
ca2_seqSumLimit.explanation: Uma isamba sivezwa njengenkulumo ku-$n$, singu-${wk}$, ngakho inani lomkhawulo ngu-${res}$.

ca2_subsTransform.prompt: Ngomsebenzi oqhubekayo $f$, uma ${gv}$, thola inani le-${tg}$. (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Beka inkulumo engaphakathi kwe-integral ibe ngu-$u$, bese ushintsha ibanga ne-$dx$ kube yizinto ze-$u$.
Qinisekisa ukuthi ibanga elishintshiwe lifana nebanga le-integral enikeziwe.

ca2_substitution.prompt: Thola inani le-definite integral $\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}{fx}\,dx$. (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Uma ubeka inkulumo ehlanganiswe ndawonye ngaphakathi kwe-integral (ezibaliweni, ngaphansi kwempande, i-exponent, isihlukanisi, njalo njalo) ibe ngu-$u$, i-$du$ izofana nengxenye esele.
Ungakhohlwa ukuthi uma ushintsha, ibanga le-integral nalo lishintshela emanani e-$u$.

ca2_tangentLine.prompt: Thola i-$y$ coordinate yephoyinti lapho i-tangent endaweni $ {pt} $ yejika ${cv}$ ihlangana khona ne-$y$ axis. (Ungaloba njengedesimali noma njengengxenyana efana no-3/4)
hints: I-derivative endaweni ethintwayo iyi-slope ye-tangent.
Faka $x=0$ ku-equation ye-tangent $y-y_0=m(x-x_0)$.
ca2_tangentLine.explanation: Ngoba izixhumanisi zephoyinti elithintwayo ngu-$ {pt} $ ne-slope $m={sl}$, i-tangent ngu-$y={tl}$, futhi i-$y$ intercept ngu-${res}$.

ca2_tangentTriangle.prompt: Thola indawo kanxantathu ovalwe yi-tangent endaweni $ {pt} $ yejika ${cv}$, ne-$x$ axis ne-$y$ axis. (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ngokuthola i-equation ye-tangent, bese uthola amaphoyinti ihlangana ngawo nama-axis womabili (ama-intercept).
Isisekelo nobude bukanxantathu yi-$|x\text{intercept}|$ ne-$|y\text{intercept}|$.
ca2_tangentTriangle.explanation: I-tangent ngu-$y={tl}$, i-$x$ intercept ngu-${xi}$ ne-$y$ intercept ngu-${yi}$, ngakho indawo ngu-$\frac{1}{2}\times|{xi}|\times|{yi}|={res}$.

ca2_telescope.prompt: Thola isamba se-infinite series $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{term}$. (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Ama-factor esihlukanisi alandelana ngezikhathi ezilinganayo. Zama ukwahlukanisa ngama-partial fraction.

$\frac{1}{A(A+d)}=\frac{1}{d}\left(\frac{1}{A}-\frac{1}{A+d}\right)$, futhi uma kunama-factor amathathu, $\frac{1}{A(A+1)(A+2)}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{A(A+1)}-\frac{1}{(A+1)(A+2)}\right)$. Thola amatemu asele emva kokucisha esambeni esingaphelele.
ca2_telescope.explanation: Uma kwahlukaniswa ngama-partial fraction bese kutholwa isamba esingaphelele, emva kokucisha kusala ${wk}$, ngakho isamba ngu-${res}$.

ca2_trigDeriv.prompt: Ngomsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$, thola inani le-$f'({x0})$. (Ungaloba njengedesimali noma njengengxenyana efana no-3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa $(\sin x)'=\cos x$, $(\cos x)'=-\sin x$, $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$ kanye nemithetho yomkhiqizo, yesilinganiso nomsebenzi oyinhlanganisela ukuthola i-$f'(x)$.
Faka $x={x0}$ ku-$f'(x)$ otholile bese ubala amanani omsebenzi we-trigonometric.

ca2_trigLimit.prompt: Bala inani le-limit elilandelayo. $\lim_{{to}}{ex}$ (Bhala njengengxenyana elula. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Sebenzisa $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\sin x}{x}=1$, $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\tan x}{x}=1$ no-$1-\cos x=\frac{\sin^{2}x}{1+\cos x}$.
Kuma-limit e-$x\to c$, beka $t=x-c$ bese ushintshela ku-$t\to0$. Uma $x\to\infty$, zama ukubeka $h=\frac{1}{x}$.
ca2_trigLimit.explanation: Uma uguqula ukuze usebenzise ama-limit ayisisekelo, ${wk}$, ngakho inani le-limit ngu-${res}$.

ca2_trigLimitUnknown.prompt: Thola inani le-$a$, inombolo ephelele evumayo, eliyenza ukulingana ${eq}$ kuphumelele. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bonisa inani le-limit uma $x\to0$ ngo-$a$.
Beka isisho esitholakele silingane nenani elinikeziwe bese uxazulula u-$a$. Isimo sokuthi $a$ iyinombolo ephelele evumayo siyenza ibe munye.
ca2_trigLimitUnknown.explanation: Inani le-limit ngu-${wk}$, futhi lilingana nenani elinikeziwe. Inombolo ephelele evumayo eyanelisa lokhu ngu-$a={ans}$, futhi uma ufaka esikhundleni, ${chk}$ iyaphumelela.

ca2_velocityIntegral.prompt: Isivinini sephoyinti P elihamba emgqeni wezinombolo ngesikhathi $t$ ($t\ge0$) singu-$v(t)={vt}$. Thola ibanga elihanjwe yiphoyinti P kusukela ku-$t=0$ kuze kube ngu-$t={T}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Ibanga elihanjiwe liyi-integral yejubane $|v(t)|$, okungu-$\int_{0}^{T}|v(t)|\,dt$.
Thola izikhathi lapho uphawu lwesivinini luguquka, uhlukanise isikhawu, bese unquma uphawu lwe-$|v(t)|$ esikhawini ngasinye bese uhlanganisa.

ca2_volumeRotate.prompt: Uma ivolumu yento etholakala ngokujikisa indawo evalelwe yigrafu $y={f}$, $y={g}$ nemigqa emibili $x={a}$, $x={b}$ ngokuzungeza i-eksisi ka-$x$ ingu-$V$, thola inani le-${ask}$. (Isikhumbuzo: i-eksisi ka-$x$ ngu-$y=0$.) (Bhala njengengxenyana elula. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Ivolumu yento ejikisiwe ngu-$V=\pi\int_{\alpha}^{\beta}\{(\text{irediyasi engaphandle})^{2}-(\text{irediyasi engaphakathi})^{2}\}\,dx$.
Beka igrafu ephezulu njengeredi yasemaphandleni nephansi njengeredi yangaphakathi. $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$ futhi $\sin^{2}x=\frac{1-\cos 2x}{2}$.

cm1_absIneqCount.prompt: Zingaki izinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$ ezisezixazululweni ze-inequality ${expr}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: $|A|<c$ kusho okufanayo no-$-c<A<c$ ($c>0$, futhi kuyafana noma kuyi-$\le$).
Hlanganisa isisho esinophawu lwenani eliphelele nxazonke zibe ohlangothini olulodwa, ulandise ube yifomu elingu-$|A|<c$, bese ususa uphawu lwenani eliphelele.
cm1_absIneqCount.explanation: Uma ulandisa, ${norm}$, okungukuthi ${chain}$, ngakho ${sol}$. Izinombolo ezipheleleyo $x$ eziyanelisa lokhu yi-${ints}$, ziyonke ${ans}$.

cm1_absIneqRep.prompt: Uma isixazululo se-inequality $|{mx}-a|{op}c$ singu-${lo}{op}x{op}{hi}$, inani lika-$a+c$ liyini kuzingaguquki $a$, $c$? (Lapho $c>0$) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: $|A|{op}c$ kusho okufanayo no-$-c{op}A{op}c$.
Ngemva kokuguqulela ku-$a-c{op}{mx}{op}a+c$, qhathanisa iziphetho zebanga luka-$x$ nesixazululo esinikeziwe, bese uthola uhlelo lwezibalo ezilayini ezimbili ngo-$a$ no-$c$.
cm1_absIneqRep.explanation: Ku-$-c{op}{mx}-a{op}c$, $a-c{op}{mx}{op}a+c$, futhi njengoba isixazululo singu-${lo}{op}x{op}{hi}$, $a-c={mlo}$ kanye no-$a+c={mhi}$. Ngakho $a={a}$, $c={c}$ futhi $a+c={ans}$.

cm1_coloring.prompt: Kunezindawo ezingu-${n}$ ezinezinombolo ${regs}$. Izindawo zalawa mapheya kuphela ezithintanayo: ${edges}$. Izindawo ezimbili ezithintanayo kufanele zidwetshwe ngemibala ehlukene. Ungasebenzisa imibala engu-${k}$, ungasebenzisa umbala owodwa ezindaweni eziningi, futhi omunye ungasetshenziswa. Zingaki izindlela zokudweba zonke izindawo? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Nquma ukulandelana kokudweba, bese ubala inani lemibala esele uma ususa imibala esetshenziswe ezindaweni eziseduze esezidwetshiwe.
Uma inani lemibala ongayisebenzisa lishintsha ngokuthi izindawo eziseduze ezidwetshwe ngaphambili zinombala owodwa noma ehlukene, hlukanisa izimo bese usebenzisa umthetho wokuhlanganisa.
cm1_coloring.explanation: Uma udweba ngokulandelana futhi ubala imibala engasetshenziswa ngomthetho wokuphindaphinda nowokuhlanganisa, kunezindlela ezingu-${work}={ans}$.

cm1_combCommittee.prompt: Kwabafana abangu-${m}$ nezintombazane ezingu-${w}$, kufanele kukhethwe ilunga lekomiti elingu-${r}$. Umfana oyedwa othile kumele akhethwe, intombazane eyodwa ethile ayikhethwa, futhi kumele kube nezintombazane okungenani ezingu-${a}$. Zingaki izindlela zokukhetha? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma unquma oyedwa okumele akhethwe noyedwa ongakhethwa, inkinga iba ukukhetha inani eliseleyo kwabanye abantu.
Hlukanisa izimo lapho inani lezintombazane liyi-${a}$, ${a}+1$, $\ldots$ bese ufaka (izindlela zokukhetha izintombazane)$\times$(izindlela zokukhetha abafana).
cm1_combCommittee.explanation: Njengoba umfana oyedwa esekhethiwe nentombazane eyodwa ikhishiwe, kusele ukukhetha abangu-${r1}$ kubafana abangu-${m1}$ nezintombazane ezingu-${w1}$, kodwa okungenani ezingu-${a}$ zibe yizintombazane. ${work}={ans}$.

cm1_complexCond.prompt: Kunombolo yangempela $x$, kunombolo eyinkimbinkimbi $z={zs}$. Siyini isilinganiso se-$x$ lapho i-$z$ iyinombolo engokoqobo engekho? (Qaphela: i-imaginary ehlanzekile inengxenye yangempela engu-$0$ nengxenye engekho yangempela engeyona-$0$.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Hlela i-$z$ ibe yifomu (ingxenye yangempela)$+$(ingxenye engekho yangempela)$i$. $i^2=-1$.
Thola i-$x$ eyenza ingxenye yangempela ibe $0$, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi ingxenye engekho yangempela ayiyona-$0$.
cm1_complexCond.explanation: Ingxenye yangempela ye-$z$ yi-${re}$, ingxenye engekho yangempela yi-${im}$. Njengoba ingxenye yangempela kumele ibe $0$, ${roots}$. Inani lengxenye engekho yangempela ngalesi sikhathi yi-${chk}$, ngakho i-imaginary ehlanzekile yilapho $x={ans}$.

cm1_cubicOneReal.prompt: Uma isamba sezimpande zangempela ezihlukene zesibalo ${eq}=0$ siyi-$S$, futhi umphumela wokuphindaphinda zonke izimpande ezingekho zangempela ezihlukene uyi-$T$, siyini isilinganiso se-$S+T$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Esibalweni esinomkhawulo ophezulu ongu-$1$ nama-coefficients angama-integer, izimpande eziyi-integer ziphakathi kwabahlukanisi bokuthi inombolo engaguquki. Qinisekisa ngethiyori yokuhlukanisa.
Thola impande eyodwa bese uhlukanisa ngendlela ye-synthetic division; kuyasala isibalo sezinga eliphansi. Sebenzisa i-discriminant yesibalo esisele ukuze ubone ukuthi izimpande azingekho zangempela.
cm1_cubicOneReal.explanation: Ngokuhlukanisa, ${eq}={fac}$. I-discriminant yesibalo ${quad}$ yi-$D={D}<0$, ngakho inezimpande ezimbili ezingekho zangempela, umphumela wazo uyi-$T={q}$, futhi isamba sezimpande zangempela yi-$S={S}$. Ngakho $S+T={ans}$.

cm1_discrimCount.prompt: Zingaki izinombolo ze-integer $k$ ezisuka ku-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ ezenza izimpande zombili zesibalo ${eq}=0$ zingabi zangempela? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuze isibalo se-quadratic sibe nezimpande ezingekho zangempela, i-discriminant kumele ibe $D<0$.
Uma i-coefficient ye-$x$ iyinombolo ephindwayo, kulula ukusebenzisa $\frac{D}{4}=\left(\frac{b}{2}\right)^2-ac$. Xazulula lokhu njenge-inequality ku-$k$.
cm1_discrimCount.explanation: Kumele $\frac{D}{4}={d4}<0$, futhi ngokuyixazulula, ${kr}$. Ama-integer $k$ ayanelisa lokhu yi-${ks}$, ngakho phakathi kuka-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ kunawo angu-${ans}$.

cm1_divisorCount.prompt: Phakathi kwabahlukanisi abanhle benombolo yemvelo $N={fac}$, bangaki abayizikhathi zika-${m}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Abahlukanisi abayizikhathi zika-${m}$ bangabhalwa ngefomu ${m}\times t$. Cabanga ngezinombolo ezingaba yi-$t$.
Abahlukanisi abanjalo banefomu ${m}\times t$, futhi i-$t$ ingumhlukanisi we-$\frac{N}{{m}}$.
cm1_divisorCount.explanation: Abahlukanisi abayizikhathi zika-${m}$ banefomu ${m}\times t$, futhi i-$t$ ingumhlukanisi we-$\frac{N}{{m}}={Nm}$. Inani labahlukanisi balo yi-${prod}={ans}$.

cm1_factorEval.prompt: Ngokusebenzisa i-factorization, inani le-${expr}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Beka inombolo enkulu ngohlamvu $N$, wenze i-factorization yesibalo bese unciphisa nesihlukanisi.
Isibonelo, $N^3-1=(N-1)(N^2+N+1)$, $N^4+N^2+1=(N^2+N+1)(N^2-N+1)$, $N^4-1=(N^2+1)(N^2-1)$; isibalo esifana nesihlukanisi sivela njengesici sesibalo.
cm1_factorEval.explanation: Uma $N={N}$, i-factorization yesibalo ngu-${fac}$, futhi ngemuva kokunciphisa nesihlukanisi, ${simp}$. Ngakho inani ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_gridPaths.prompt: Endizeni yama-coordinate, phakathi kwezindlela ezimfushane kakhulu ezisuka epoyinteni $(0,0)$ ziye epoyinteni $({a},{b})$ ngokunyakazela kanye kanye ngo-$+1$ ohlangothini lwe-$x$-axis noma lwe-$y$-axis, zingaki izindlela ezidlula epoyinteni A$({p},{q})$ kodwa ezingadluli epoyinteni B$({u},{v})$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Inani lezindlela ezimfushane kakhulu ezisuka ku-$(0,0)$ ziye ku-$(m,n)$ ngu-${}_{m+n}\mathrm{C}_{m}$, inani lezindlela zokukhetha ukulandelana kwezinyathelo ezingu-$m$ ezibheke kwesokudla nezinyathelo ezingu-$n$ ezibheke phezulu.
Ezindleleni 'ezidlulayo', phindaphinda inani lezindlela ezingxenyeni ngayinye; ezindleleni 'ezingadluli', susa ezindleleni zonke ezidlula epoyinteni A lezo ezidlula nakwiphoyinti B.
cm1_gridPaths.explanation: Izindlela ezidlula epoyinteni A zingu-${t1}$. Kuzo, ezidlula nakwiphoyinti B zingu-${t2}$. Ngakho inani lezindlela ezifunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_iPower.prompt: Uma $z={z}$, isamba sengxenye yangempela nengxenye engekho yangempela ye-${expr}$ siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Amandla ka-$i$ aphindeka ngalolu hlelo: $i,\ -1,\ -i,\ 1$. Uma $z$ inefomu eliyinkimbinkimbi, qala uyenze ibe lula ibe yifomu elingu-$a+bi$.
Njengoba $z^4=1$, amandla e-$z$ aphinda inani elifanayo njalo ngo-$4$. Kumele ubheke kuphela insalela yesichazi uma sihlukaniswa ngo-$4$.
cm1_iPower.explanation: Ngokuyenza ibe lula kuqala, $z={zs}$ futhi $z^4=1$. Ngokushintshela insalela yesichazi uma sihlukaniswa ngo-$4$, ${work}$. Ngakho isamba sengxenye yangempela nengxenye engekho yangempela ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_iPowerSum.prompt: Uma $z={z}$, isamba sengxenye yangempela nengxenye engekho yangempela ye-${expr}$ siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala wenze i-$z$ ibe lula ibe yifomu elingu-$a+bi$, ubheke ukuthi $z^4=1$ yini. Ngaleyo ndlela uzokwazi inani lesamba samandla amane alandelanayo $z+z^2+z^3+z^4$.
Uma ubopha ngamagama amane, isamba sebhanqu ngalinye siyafana. Amagama asele ekugcineni ngenani lensalela yenani lamagama ahlukaniswe ngo-$4$.
cm1_iPowerSum.explanation: Ngokwenza kube lula kuqala, $z={zs}$, ngakho $z^4=1$ futhi $z+z^2+z^3+z^4=0$. Uma ubopha ngamagama amane, isamba sebhanqu ngalinye singu-$0$, futhi ${n}={q4}\times4+{rm}$, ngakho amagama asele angu-${rm}$ okuqala kuphela, ngakho ${work}$. Ngakho isamba sengxenye yangempela nengxenye engekho yangempela ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_identity.prompt: Ku-identity ${lhs}={rhs}$ ngokuphathelene ne-$x$, ngama-constant ${consts}$, inani le-${ask}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: I-identity yisibalo esilungile noma yiliphi inani elifakwa esikhundleni sika-$x$. Ungakhulisa uhlangothi lwesobunxele uqhathanise ama-coefficient ezinga elifanayo.
Uma $x={p}$, isibalo esingaphakathi kwama-brackets siba ngu-$0$. Ukufaka leli nani kunikeza ngokushesha inani elihambisana negama elingaguquki.
cm1_identity.explanation: Ngokuqhathanisa ama-coefficient noma ngokufaka inani elifanele ku-$x$, ${sol}$. Ngakho ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_linIneqCount.prompt: Phakathi kwezixazululo ze-inequalities ${i1}$, ${i2}$ ezihlangene, zingaki izinombolo ze-integer $x$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Xazulula i-inequality ngayinye ngokwehlukana uthole ububanzi be-$x$, bese uthola ingxenye evamile. Uma uphindaphinda noma uhlukanisa ngenombolo engaphansi kuka-0 zombili izinhlangothi, isiqondiso se-inequality siyashintsha.
Dweba ububanzi obubili emugqeni wezinombolo ubale ama-integer asengxenyeni ehlangene. Qaphela ukuthi ingabe kukhona uphawu lokulingana.
cm1_linIneqCount.explanation: Isixazululo sokuqala ngu-${s1}$, sesibili ngu-${s2}$, ngakho ububanzi obuvamile ngu-${s}$. Ama-integer $x$ anelisa lokhu ngu-${ints}$, futhi wonke angu-${ans}$.

cm1_linIneqParam.prompt: Phakathi kwezixazululo ze-inequalities ${i1}$, ${i2}$ ezihlangene, ungeza yonke inani le-integer $k$ elenza kube nama-integer $x$ angu-${n}$ kanye? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala ngokuxazulula i-inequality engenayo i-$k$ uthole ububanzi be-$x$, bese ubhala ububanzi be-$x$ kwenye nge-$k$.
Ukuze ububanzi obuhlangene bube nama-integer angu-${n}$ kanye, cabanga ukuthi iziphetho zesikhawu kumele zibe phakathi kwawaphi ama-integer.
cm1_linIneqParam.explanation: Isixazululo sesibalo sokuqala siyi-${s1}$, esesibili siyi-${s2}$. Ukuze kube nama-integer $x$ angu-${n}$ kanye, kumele ${kr}$, ngakho ama-integer $k$ ayi-${ks}$, futhi isamba sawo yi-${ans}$.

cm1_matCayley.prompt: Kuma-matrix $A={A}$, $E={Emat}$, kunezinombolo zangempela $p$, $q$ ezenza $A^{{n}}=pA+qE$. Inani le-${ask}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bala i-$A^{{n}}$ ngqo ngokuphindaphinda ama-matrix uthole izingxenye zayo.
Bhala izingxenye ze-$pA+qE$ nge-$p$, $q$ bese uziqhathanisa nezingxenye ze-$A^{{n}}$; uthola isistimu yezibalo ku-$p$, $q$.
cm1_matCayley.explanation: $A^{{n}}={Apow}$, futhi uma uyiqhathanisa nezingxenye ze-$pA+qE$, $p={p}$, $q={q}$. Ngakho ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_matWord.prompt: Izitolo ezimbili u-A no-B zithengisa izinhlobo ezingu-${ni}$ zempahla. Ingxenye (i, j) ye-matrix $P={mp}$ iyintengo (ngama-won) yento eyodwa yesi-j esitolo i (umugqa 1: isitolo A, umugqa 2: isitolo B), futhi ingxenye (j, l) ye-matrix $Q={mq}$ inani lento yesi-j umuntu wesi-l ofuna ukuyithenga, phakathi kuka-Gap (ikholomu 1) no-Eul (ikholomu 2). U-Gap no-Eul ngamunye uthenga yonke impahla edingekayo esitolo esisodwa, futhi bobabili bakhetha isitolo esishibhile. Isamba semali ababhatha yona bobabili singaki ngama-won? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Inani elikhokhwa umuntu l esitolo i liyisamba sokuphindaphinda izingxenye zomugqa i we-$P$ nekholomu l ye-$Q$ ngokulandelana.
Lawo manani yizingxenye ze-matrix $PQ$. Thola i-$PQ$, bese ukhetha inani elincane kukholomu ngayinye bese uwangeza.
cm1_matWord.explanation: $PQ={pq}$. U-Gap ukhokha ${pq11}$ won esitolo A, ${pq21}$ won esitolo B, ngakho ${m1}$ won ngokushibhile, u-Eul ukhokha ${pq12}$ won esitolo A, ${pq22}$ won esitolo B, ngakho ${m2}$ won ngokushibhile. Ngakho isamba siyi-${ans}$ won.

cm1_omega.prompt: Uma i-$\omega$ iyimpande eyodwa engekho yangempela yesibalo se-quadratic ${eq}$, inani le-${expr}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma uphindaphinda zombili izinhlangothi zesibalo ngo-$x-1$ noma $x+1$, ungathola inani le-$\omega^3$.
Uma i-$\omega^3=\pm1$ bese i-$\omega^6=1$. Kumele ubheke kuphela insalela yesichazi uma sihlukaniswa ngenkathi.
cm1_omega.explanation: Njengoba i-$\omega$iyimpande ye-${eq}$, ${rel}$. Ngakho amandla abuyela enanini elifanayo njalo ngo-${per}$, futhi uma uhlukanisa isichazi ngo-${per}$ ubheka insalela kuphela, ${step}$. Ngakho inani elifunwayo liyi-${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLine.prompt: Uma le parabola nolayini kuthinta, inani le-constant $k$ liyini? (parabola $y={f}$, ulayini $y={g}$) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuthinta kusho ukuthi isibalo se-quadratic esitholakala ngokuhlanganisa izibalo ezimbili sinempande eyodwa phindwe kabili.
Yenza i-discriminant yesibalo se-quadratic ngemuva kokususa i-$y$ ibe ngu-$0$.
cm1_parabolaLine.explanation: Ku-${f}={g}$, ${eq2}=0$, futhi njengoba kuthinta, i-discriminant $D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)=0$. Ngokuxazulula, $k={ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLineCount.prompt: Zingaki izinombolo ze-integer $k$ ezisuka ku-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ ezenza le parabola nolayini zingahlangani? (parabola $y={f}$, ulayini $y={g}$) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukungahlangani kwamagrafu amabili kusho ukuthi isibalo se-quadratic esitholakala ngokuhlanganisa izibalo ezimbili asinazo izimpande zangempela.
Thola ububanzi be-$k$ obenza i-discriminant $D<0$ ngemuva kokususa i-$y$, bese ubala ama-integer ngaphakathi.
cm1_parabolaLineCount.explanation: Ku-${f}={g}$, ${eq2}=0$, futhi ukuze zingahlangani kumele i-discriminant $D<0$. Ku-$D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)={dk}<0$, ${kr}$, ngakho ama-integer ku-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ yi-${ks}$, futhi wonke angu-${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaXaxis.prompt: Uma igrafu yesisho se-quadratic $y={f}$ ihlangana ne-eksisi ye-$x$ ezindaweni ezimbili ezihlukene, futhi ibanga phakathi kwalezo zindawo lingu-${d}$, inani lokungashintshi $k$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Izixhumanisi ze-$x$ zezindawo ezimbili zokuhlangana ziyimpande ezimbili zesibalo ${f}=0$.
Uma impande ezimbili zingu-$\alpha$ no-$\beta$, ibanga phakathi kwezindawo lingu-$|\alpha-\beta|$, futhi $(\alpha-\beta)^2=(\alpha+\beta)^2-4\alpha\beta$.
cm1_parabolaXaxis.explanation: Izixhumanisi ze-$x$ zezindawo zokuhlangana, $\alpha$ no-$\beta$, ziyimpande ezimbili ze-${f}=0$, ngakho $\alpha+\beta={sm}$. Ku-$(\alpha-\beta)^2=({sm})^2-4\alpha\beta={d}^2$ kuvela $\alpha\beta={ab}$, futhi ngobuhlobo phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient $\alpha\beta=\frac{k}{{p}}$, ngakho $k={ans}$.

cm1_permArrange.prompt: Uma abafana abangu-${m}$ namantombazane angu-${w}$ emiswa emgqeni owodwa ukuze kungabikho amantombazane amabili aseduzane, zingaki izindlela zokuma? (Bonke abafundi bahlukile komunye nomunye.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Kulula ukungenisa abangafanele ukuseduzana (amantombazane) kamuva. Qala uhlele abafana emgqeni.
Kwakheka izikhala phakathi kwabafana nasemaphethelweni womabili, lapho amantombazane angama khona. Khetha izikhala ezihlukene kulezo zikhala ukuze umise amantombazane.
cm1_permArrange.explanation: Izindlela zokuhlela abafana abangu-${m}$ kuqala zingu-${m}!={mf}$. Izindlela zokukhetha izikhala ezihlukene ezingu-${w}$ phakathi kwezikhala ezingu-${m1}$ (phakathi kwabafana nasemaphethelweni womabili) nokumisa amantombazane zingu-${}_{{m1}}\mathrm{P}_{{w}}={pv}$. Ngakho ${mf}\times{pv}={ans}$ izindlela.

cm1_permNumbers.prompt: Kunamakhadi angu-${nc}$ ahlukene, ngalinye linombolo eyodwa ebhaliwe, futhi izinombolo ezibhaliwe ziyi-${digs}$. Uma kukhethwa amakhadi angu-${r}$ kuwo, ahlelwe emgqeni ukwakha inombolo yemvelo enezinombolo ezingu-${r}$, mangaki angamaphindwa ka-${m}$? (Inombolo $0$ ayikwazi ukuba ngaphambili kokuqala.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuthi liyiphindwa ka-${m}$ noma cha kunqunywa yinombolo yamanani. Qala unqume izinombolo ezingaba sendaweni yamanani.
Ngemva kokunquma indawo yamanani, indawo yokuqala ikhethwa phakathi kwezinombolo ezingeyona $0$, kanti ezinye izindawo zigcwaliswa ngamakhadi asele (umthetho wokuphindaphinda).
cm1_permNumbers.explanation: Izinombolo ezingaba sendaweni yamanani ziyi-${Lstr}$. Kwenye neyodwa, thola (inani lezindlela zokukhetha indawo yokuqala)$\times$(inani lezindlela zokugcwalisa ezinye izindawo) bese uhlanganisa, kuvela ${work}={ans}$.

cm1_polyDivQR.prompt: Kupholinomiyali $P(x)={pp}$, uma isiphumo sokuhlukanisa $P(x)\div({dv})$ singu-$Q(x)$ futhi insalela ingu-$R(x)$, inani lika-$Q({t})+R({t})$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Hlukanisa amatemu anamandla aphezulu kakhulu ukuze uthole ithemu lokuqala lesiphumo, phinda uphindaphinde isihlukanisi bese ukhipha, uphindaphinde lokhu.
Ithemu lokuqala lesiphumo lingu-${qlead}$, futhi izinga lensalela liphansi kunelesihlukanisi.
cm1_polyDivQR.explanation: Uma wenza ukuhlukanisa, $P(x)=({dv})({qq})+({rr})$, ngakho $Q(x)={qq}$ no-$R(x)={rr}$. Ngakho $Q({t})+R({t})={ans}$.

cm1_polyProdCoef.prompt: Kupholinomiyali ezimbili $A={pa}$ no-$B={pb}$, i-coefficient ka-$x^{{k}}$ lapho kunwetshwa u-$AB$ iyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Akudingeki unwebe u-$AB$ wonke. Funa kuphela amatemu aphindwa abe yi-$x^{{k}}$.
Kuwo wonke amapheya amatemu ka-$A$ no-$B$ lapho izinga lawo lihlangene ku-${k}$, phindaphinda ama-coefficient, bese uhlanganisa wonke amanani.
cm1_polyProdCoef.explanation: Uma uhlanganisa imiphumela yama-coefficient amatemu aphindwa abe yi-$x^{{k}}$, kuvela ${terms}={ans}$. (Uma unweba ngempela, $AB={prod}$.)

cm1_quadFence.prompt: Ngocingo lwensimbi olungu-${L}$ m ubude, kuzokwakhiwa uthango olunomumo wengxande oluhlangothi olulodwa lutholakala odongeni, futhi kuzokwakhiwa izihlukanisi ezingu-${j}$ ezibhekene nodonga ukuze kuhlukaniswe isikhala. Uma ocingweni lungasetshenziswa ohlangothini lodonga futhi izihlukanisi zenziwe ngocingo olufanayo, inani elikhulu kunawo wonke lendawo yonke yothango lingu-$\mathrm{m}^2$ bangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Vumela ubude bohlangothi olubhekene nodonga bube ngu-$x$ m, bese ubala ukuthi zingaki izinhlangothi ezinjalo sezonke.
Bonisa ubude bohlangothi olufanayo nodonga ngo-$x$, yenza indawo ibe yi-quadratic ku-$x$, bese uthola i-vertex.
cm1_quadFence.explanation: Izinhlangothi ezibhekene nodonga zingu-${k}$ sezonke, ezimbili ezimaphethelweni nezihlukanisi ezingu-${j}$, ngakho ubude bohlangothi olufanayo nodonga bungu-$({L}-{k}x)$ m. Indawo $S(x)=x({L}-{k}x)$ inkulu kakhulu ku-$x={u}$ futhi inani elikhulu ngu-${ans}$ $\mathrm{m}^2$.

cm1_quadIneqAlways.prompt: Linini inani lezinombolo ezigcwele $k$ ezenza isixazululo sokungalingani ${ineq}$ sibe zonke izinombolo zangempela? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Njengoba ikhoefishenti ka-$x^2$ ngu-$k$, hlukanisa izimo ngo-$k=0$ nalapho kungenjalo. Uma $k\ne0$, kumele ivulekele phezulu futhi i-discriminant $D<0$ (noma $D\le0$).
Bhala i-discriminant $D$ njengesisho sika-$k$ bese uxazulula ukungalingani. Isimo sokuvuleka phansi ($k<0$) asikwazi ukuba yiqiniso kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela.
cm1_quadIneqAlways.explanation: Uma $k=0$, uhlangothi lwesobunxele luyi-constant ${n}$ kuphela, futhi leli nani likhulu kuno-$0$, ngakho ukungalingani kuhlale kuyiqiniso. Uma $k\ne0$, kumele kuvulekele phezulu, ngakho $k>0$ futhi $\frac{D}{4}={d4}{rel}0$ kumele ibe yiqiniso, futhi ngokuxazulula, ${kr}$. Ngakho kuhlanganisa u-$k=0$, izinombolo ezigcwele $k$ zingu-${ks}$, ngakho sezonke ziyi-${ans}$.

cm1_quadIneqSol.prompt: Uma isixazululo sokungalingani kwe-quadratic ${mx2}+ax+b{op}0$ singu-${sol}$, linini inani le-${ask}$ ngama-constant $a$, $b$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Amanani emaphethelweni amabili esixazululo wempande ezimbili ze-quadratic equation ${mx2}+ax+b=0$.
Bhala i-quadratic ngefomu elithi (ikhoefishenti ka-$x^2$)$\times(x-\alpha)(x-\beta)$ bese uqhathanisa nefomu elandisiwe.
cm1_quadIneqSol.explanation: Njengoba isixazululo singu-${sol}$, izimpande ezimbili ngu-${lo}$, ${hi}$, futhi njengoba ikhoefishenti ka-$x^2$ ingu-${m}$, ${mx2}+ax+b={fac}={full}$. Ngakho $a={a}$, $b={b}$ futhi ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_quadRange.prompt: Linini isamba senani elikhulu kunawo wonke nelincane kunawo wonke lomsebenzi $y={f}$ ku-${m}\le x\le {n}$? (Lapha, $x$ yinombolo yangempela.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ku-quadratic function, qala ngokuhlola ukuthi i-$x$ coordinate ye-vertex iphakathi kobubanzi obunikeziwe yini.
Uma i-vertex iphakathi kobubanzi, qhathanisa amanani omsebenzi ku-vertex nasemaphethelweni amabili; uma ingaphandle, qhathanisa emaphethelweni amabili kuphela.
cm1_quadRange.explanation: I-vertex yalo msebenzi ngu-$({h},{kv})$, futhi amanani ka-$y$ emaphethelweni amabili obubanzi angu-${fm}$ lapho $x={m}$ no-${fn}$ lapho $x={n}$. Ngokuhlola ukuthi i-$x$ coordinate ye-vertex iphakathi kobubanzi ${m}\le x\le {n}$ yini, bese uthola okukhulu nokuncane, isamba singu-${ans}$.

cm1_quadRevenue.prompt: Uma into enexabiso lokukhiqiza elingu-${w}$ won ithengiswa ngo-${a}$ won ngayinye, kuthengiswa izingcezu ezingu-${b}$ ngosuku. Njalo lapho intengo yokuthengisa ikhuphuka ngo-${s}$ won, inani elithengiswayo ngosuku liyancipha ngezingcezu ezingu-${c}$. Uma intengo yokuthengisa ingakhuphuka ngo-${s}$ won izikhathi ezigcwele (kuhlanganise no-$0$), inzuzo enkulu kunazo zonke ngosuku ingu-won bangaki? (Inzuzo ibalwa ngo-(intengo yokuthengisa $-$ ixabiso lokukhiqiza)$\times$(inani elithengiswayo).) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Vumela inani lokukhuphula intengo libe ngu-$t$, bese ubonisa intengo yokuthengisa nenani elithengiswayo ngo-$t$.
(Inzuzo ngengcezu)$\times$(inani elithengiswayo) i-quadratic ku-$t$. Hlola ukuthi u-$t$ we-vertex uyinombolo ephelele yini.
cm1_quadRevenue.explanation: Uma inani lokukhuphula ngu-$t$, inzuzo ngengcezu ngu-$({e1}+{s}t)$ won, inani elithengiswayo ngu-$({b}-{c}t)$, ngakho inzuzo ngu-$({e1}+{s}t)({b}-{c}t)$ won. Le quadratic inkulu kakhulu ku-$t={tstar}$ futhi inzuzo ngaleso sikhathi ngu-${ans}$ won.

cm1_remQuadDiv.prompt: Kwi-polynomial $P(x)$, insalela ye-$P(x)\div({dv1})$ ingu-${r1}$ futhi insalela ye-$P(x)\div({dv2})$ ingu-${r2}$. Uma insalela ye-$P(x)\div\left(({dv1})({dv2})\right)$ ingu-$R(x)$, inani le-$R({c})$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Insalela yokuhlukanisa nge-quadratic iyisisho somugqa noma esingaphansi. Beka $R(x)=px+q$.
Ku-$P(x)=({dv1})({dv2})Q(x)+R(x)$, faka amanani amabili enza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-$0$.
cm1_remQuadDiv.explanation: Uma $R(x)=px+q$, $R({a})=P({a})={r1}$, $R({b})=P({b})={r2}$. Uma uxazulula izibalo zombili ndawonye, $p={p}$, $q={q}$, ngakho $R(x)={Rx}$ futhi $R({c})={ans}$.

cm1_remUnknown.prompt: Kwi-polynomial $P(x)={pp}$, insalela ye-$P(x)\div({dv})$ ingu-${R}$. Inani lengaguquki $k$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: I-remainder theorem: insalela yokuhlukanisa i-polynomial $P(x)$ ngo-$x-a$ ilingana no-$P(a)$.
Inani le-$x$ elenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-$0$ ngu-$x={t}$. Uma ufaka leli nani ku-$P(x)$, uthola isibalo somugqa ngo-$k$.

cm1_rootSignCond.prompt: Kusibalo se-quadratic ${eq}=0$, inani elincane kakhulu lenombolo ephelele $k$ elenza zombili izimpande ezimbili ezingafani ezingempela zibe ngaphezulu kuka-${t}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-$f(x)$, ngu-$y=f(x)$ ihlangana ne-eksisi ka-$x$ emaphoyintini amabili ahlukile futhi wombili ngakwesokudla sika-$x={t}$.
Hlola zonke izimo ezintathu: i-discriminant $D>0$, indawo ye-eksisi (eksisi $x>{t}$), kanye no-$f({t})>0$.
cm1_rootSignCond.explanation: Ku-$f(x)={eq}$, ukuze izimpande zombili zibe ngaphezulu kuka-${t}$, kumele kwanelise zonke: (i) $\frac{D}{4}={d4}>0$, (ii) ku-eksisi $x=k$, $k>{t}$, (iii) $f({t})={ft}>0$. Inombolo ephelele encane kakhulu eyanelisa lokhu ngu-$k$ ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricEval.prompt: Kwizinombolo ezingempela $x$, $y$, uma ${cond}$, inani le-${expr}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bonisa isisho osifunayo ngesamba $x+y$ nomphumela $xy$. Isibonelo, $x^2+y^2=(x+y)^2-2xy$.
Kwezikhawu ezintathu sebenzisa $x^3+y^3=(x+y)^3-3xy(x+y)$, futhi kwesine thola u-$x^2+y^2$ kuqala bese usebenzisa $x^4+y^4=(x^2+y^2)^2-2(xy)^2$.
cm1_symmetricEval.explanation: Uma uguqula ifomula yokuphindaphinda, ${expr}={work}$. (Lapha $(x-y)^2=(x+y)^2-4xy={dd}\ge0$, ngakho kukhona izinombolo ezingempela $x$, $y$ eziyanelisa isimo.) Ngakho inani elifunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricInv.prompt: Kunombolo engempela $x$, uma $x+\frac{1}{x}={k}$, inani le-${expr}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Umphumela ka-$x$ no-$\frac{1}{x}$ ngu-$1$. Ngakho uma wazi kuphela inani lesamba $x+\frac{1}{x}$, ungathola izamba zamandla.
$x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^2-2$, $x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^3-3\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)$, futhi kwesine yenza isikwele $x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}$ kanye.
cm1_symmetricInv.explanation: Uma uguqula ifomula yokuphindaphinda, ${expr}={work}$. (Kunombolo engempela $x$, $\left|x+\frac{1}{x}\right|\ge2$, ngakho kukhona inombolo engempela eyanelisa lesi simo.) Ngakho inani elifunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_sysReal.prompt: Uma kunesistimu ye-equation ${e1}$, ${e2}$, zingaki izinombolo ezigcwele $k$ ku-$-{M}\le k\le {M}$ ezenza ukuthi kube nesixazululo sangempela $(x, y)$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Sebenzisa i-equation eyodwa ukuqeda u-$y$, uthole i-equation ye-quadratic ka-$x$.
Ukuze ibe nezixazululo zangempela, i-discriminant yaleyo quadratic kumele ibe ngu-$0$ noma ngaphezulu.
cm1_sysReal.explanation: Uma u-$y$ eqedwa nge-equation eyodwa, kutholakala i-quadratic ka-$x$, futhi ukuze kube nezixazululo zangempela kumele ${dcond}$. Okungukuthi ${kr}$, ngakho izinombolo ezigcwele ku-$-{M}\le k\le {M}$ zingu-${ans}$ sizonke.

cm1_sysTwo.prompt: Uma izinombolo zangempela $x$, $y$ zingesixazululo sesistimu ${e1}$, ${e2}$, liyini inani eliphezulu lika-$x$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Hlukanisa i-equation eyodwa ibe yizici noma veza uhlamvu olulodwa ngolunye ukuze wehlise inani lezinhlamvu.
Thola zonke izixazululo zangempela ezingenzeka $(x, y)$, bese ukhetha elikhulu kakhulu phakathi kwamanani ka-$x$.
cm1_sysTwo.explanation: Uma isistimu ixazululwa, $(x,\ y)={sols}$. Phakathi kwalokhu, inani eliphezulu lika-$x$ ngu-${ans}$.

cm1_vietaExpr.prompt: Uma izimpande ezimbili ze-equation ye-quadratic ${eq}=0$ ziyi-$\alpha$, $\beta$, liyini inani lika-${expr}$? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Kwi-equation ye-quadratic $ax^2+bx+c=0$, isamba sezimpande ezimbili singu-$-\frac{b}{a}$ nomphumela wazo ungu-$\frac{c}{a}$.
Veza isisho esifunwayo ngo-$\alpha+\beta$ no-$\alpha\beta$, bese ufaka amanani.

cm1_vietaUnknown.prompt: Ake sithi izimpande ezimbili ze-equation ye-quadratic $x^2-kx{cs}=0$ ziyi-$\alpha$, $\beta$. Uma ${cond}$, liyini inani eliyiphozithivu lika-$k$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ngobuhlobo phakathi kwezimpande nama-coefficient, isamba sezimpande ezimbili singu-$k$, futhi umphumela wazo ungu-${c}$.
Veza isimo esinikeziwe ngo-$\alpha+\beta$, $\alpha\beta$, noma beka impande eyodwa njengohlamvu bese uveza enye ngaso ukuthola u-$k$.

cm2_amgmMin.prompt: Uma ${dom}$, liyini inani eliphansi kakhulu lika-${ex}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Kwezinombolo ezimbili eziyiphozithivu $A$, $B$, $A+B\ge 2\sqrt{A\,B}$ (ukulingana kuba khona uma $A=B$).
Bhanqa ukuze umphumela ube yinto engashintshi, usebenzise ubuhlobo phakathi kwesilinganiso se-arithmetic nesejometri, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi inani lika-$x$ lapho kulingana likubanga lesimo ${dom}$.
cm2_amgmMin.explanation: ${work}$, futhi ukulingana kuba khona uma $x={xe}$, nalelo nani likubanga lesimo ${dom}$. Ngakho inani eliphansi kakhulu ngu-${ans}$.

cm2_chordLength.prompt: Indingilizi $C$: ${circ}$, umugqa $l$: ${line}$. Bungakanani ubude be-chord enqunywa ngu-$l$ ku-$C$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Umugqa oqonde ngqo osuka maphakathi nendingilizi uye emgqeni uhlukanisa i-chord ibe yizingxenye ezimbili ezilinganayo. Qala uthole ibanga eliphakathi nendingilizi nomugqa.
Uma irediyasi ingu-$r$ nebanga eliphakathi nomugqa lingu-$d$, ubude be-chord bungu-$2\sqrt{r^2-d^2}$.
cm2_chordLength.explanation: Maphakathi nendingilizi ku-$({cx}, {cy})$, irediyasi ingu-${rad}$. Ibanga eliphakathi nomugqa ngu-$d=\frac{|{la}\times({cx})+({lb})\times({cy})+({lc})|}{\sqrt{({la})^2+({lb})^2}}=\frac{{dh}}{{h}}={d}$, ngakho ubude be-chord bungu-$2\sqrt{{rad}^2-{d}^2}=2\times{half}={ans}$.

cm2_circleGeneral.prompt: Isibalo ${eq}$ sivezwa indingilizi. Uma izixhumanisi zaphakathi nendingilizi ziyi-$(a, b)$ nerediyasi ingu-$r$, liyini inani lika-$a+b+r$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
