hints: Yishintshe ibe uhlobo lwesikwele esiphelele $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$ ku-$x$ nasku-$y$.
Hlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili nge-coefficient ka-$x^2$, $y^2$, bese ubhanqa ama-$x$ ndawonye nama-$y$ ndawonye ukwenza izikwele eziphelele.
cm2_circleGeneral.explanation: Ngoba i-coefficient ka-$x^2$ ingu-${kk}$, uma izinhlangothi zombili zihlukaniswa ngayo bese kwenziwa izikwele eziphelele, kutholakala ${std}$. Maphakathi ku-$({cx}, {cy})$, irediyasi ingu-${rad}$, ngakho $a+b+r={cx}+({cy})+{rad}={ans}$.

cm2_circleTangentAxes.prompt: Phakathi kwezindingilizi ezinenkabazwe ku-quadrant yokuqala ezithinta zombili ama-eksisi e-$x$ ne-$y$ ngesikhathi esisodwa, zimbili kuphela eziphasa iphoyinti $P({p}, {q})$. Phakathi kwalezi ezimbili, irediyasi yendingilizi enerediyasi enkulu iyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Inkabazwe yendingilizi ethinta ama-eksisi womabili ku-quadrant yokuqala ingu-$(r, r)$ futhi irediyasi ingu-$r$.
Faka izixhumanisi zephoyinti endingilizini $(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$, bese uxazulula isibalo se-quadratic ku-$r$.
cm2_circleTangentAxes.explanation: Isibalo sendingilizi singu-$(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ ($r>0$) futhi siphasa iphoyinti $P$, ngakho $({p}-r)^2+({q}-r)^2=r^2$, okungukuthi $r^2-{u}r+{t}=0$. Uma uxazulula, $r={rs}$ noma $r={rl}$, ngakho irediyasi enkulu ngu-${ans}$.

cm2_compFindG.prompt: Kuma-function amabili $f$ no-$g$, $f(x)={f}$ futhi i-composite function $(f\circ g)(x)={comp}$. Inani lika-$g({t})$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Njengoba $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, faka u-$g(x)$ endaweni ka-$x$ esibalweni sika-$f$.
Ku-$f(g(x))={comp}$ xazulula isibalo se-$g(x)$ uthole u-$g(x)$, bese ufaka $x={t}$.

cm2_compTable.prompt: Ama-function amabili $f$ no-$g$ avela kusethi $X=\{{xset}\}$ aya ku-$X$ abonakala kanje. $f$: ${ft}$, $g$: ${gt}$. Mangaki amalungu $x$ e-$X$ ahlangabezana no-$(f\circ g)(x)=(g\circ f)(x)$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$. Thola amanani amabili ngokwehlukana ku-$x$ ngamunye.
Ku-$x=1, 2, \dots$ yenza ithebula le-$f(g(x))$ ne-$g(f(x))$ ngokulandelana bese uliqhathanisa.
cm2_compTable.explanation: Uma uthola u-$f(g(x))$ no-$g(f(x))$ ku-$x$ ngamunye, kuyi-${work}$. Inani lika-$x$ lapho amanani amabili alingana lingu-${ans}$.

cm2_divPoint.prompt: Kunamaphoyinti amabili $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, futhi kukhona iphoyinti $P$ ehlukanisa ucezu $AB$ ngaphakathi. Uma $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={m}:{n}$, isamba sezixhumanisi ze-$x$ ne-$y$ zephoyinti $P$ siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Izixhumanisi zephoyinti elihlukanisa ucezu $AB$ ngaphakathi ngo-$m:n$ ziyi-$\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Thola izixhumanisi ze-$x$ ne-$y$ ngokwehlukana bese ubeka. Isixhumanisi se-$x$ singu-$\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}}$.

cm2_divRatioFind.prompt: Emaphoyinteni amathathu $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, $P({px}, {py})$, iphoyinti $P$ lisocezwini $AB$ futhi $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=m:n$. Uma $m$ no-$n$ bezinombolo zemvelo ezingenayo into efanayo, inani lika-$m+n$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma $P$ ehlukanisa u-$AB$ ngo-$m:n$ ngaphakathi, isixhumanisi se-$x$ singu-$\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n}$. Sebenzisa ngokuphambene ukuthola isilinganiso ezixhumanisini zika-$P$.
Ngomehluko wezixhumanisi ze-$x$ thola $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=|p_x-x_1|:|x_2-p_x|$ bese wenza lula.
cm2_divRatioFind.explanation: Uma uqhathanisa izixhumanisi ze-$x$, $|{px}-({x1})|={u}$, $|({x2})-({px})|={w}$, ngakho $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={u}:{w}$, futhi uma kuboniswa njengesilinganiso sezinombolo ezingenayo into efanayo kungu-${m}:{n}$. (Izixhumanisi ze-$y$ nazo zinikeza isilinganiso esifanayo.) Ngakho $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_existsInterval.prompt: $U$ yisethi yazo zonke izinombolo ezigcwele ezingu-${p}$ noma ngaphezulu futhi ${q}$ noma ngaphansi. Linini inani elikhulu kunawo wonke lenombolo ephelele $k$ eyenza isitatimende 'Kunengxenye ethile $x$ ye-$U$ lapho ${form}$' siphelele ube yiqiniso? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: 'Kunengxenye ethile $x$' kusho ukuthi iqiniso uma kukhona ngisho no-$x$ oyedwa owanelisa isimo.
Shintsha ukungalingani kube yifomu $k<g(x)$, bese uthola inani elikhulu kakhulu le-$g(x)$ phakathi kwezingxenye ze-$U$.
cm2_existsInterval.explanation: ${form}$ ingashintshwa ibe yifomu $k<{gx}$. Phakathi kwezingxenye ze-$U$, ${gx}$ inkulu kakhulu uma $x={xm}$, futhi ingu-${gm}$, futhi uma $k<{gm}$, iba yiqiniso kulo $x$. Ngakho inani elikhulu kunawo wonke lenombolo ephelele $k$ ngu-${ans}$.

cm2_funcInjective.prompt: Phakathi kwemisebenzi ye-one-to-one $f$ esuka kusethi $X=\{{xset}\}$ iye kusethi $Y=\{{yset}\}$, mingaki enokuthi $f(1)\le {t}$ futhi $f(2)\ge {u}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Umsebenzi we-one-to-one uxhumanisa izingxenye ezihlukene ze-$X$ namanani omsebenzi ahlukene. Qala unqume u-$f(1)$, $f(2)$.
Bala inani lamapheya $(f(1), f(2))$ anokuthi $f(1)\ne f(2)$, bese uphindaphinda ngenani lezindlela zokunquma amanani omsebenzi ezingxenye ezisele.
cm2_funcInjective.explanation: $f(1)$ unezindlela ezingu-${t}$, $f(2)$ unezindlela ezingu-${n}-{u}+1$, futhi kunezindlela ezingu-${ov}$ lapho $f(1)=f(2)$, ngakho $(f(1), f(2))$ unezindlela ezingu-${pairs}$. Izingxenye ezisele ezingu-${mr}$ zixhumaniswa ngokufana nelinye ngamanani asele angu-${nr}$, ngakho kunezindlela ezingu-${rest}$, futhi inani elifunwayo ngu-${pairs}\times{rest}={ans}$.

cm2_funcMonotone.prompt: Phakathi kwemisebenzi $f$ esuka kusethi $X=\{{xset}\}$ iye kusethi $Y=\{{yset}\}$, mingaki enokuthi ${chain}$ futhi $f(1)\ge {u}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma $f(1)<f(2)<\cdots$, wonke amanani omsebenzi ahlukile, futhi uma amanani enqunyiwe, ukuxhumana kunqunywa ngokukodwa ngokulandelana kobukhulu.
Izinombolo ezingaba amanani omsebenzi yizinombolo ezigcwele ezingu-${u}$ noma ngaphezulu futhi ${w}$ noma ngaphansi, futhi lokhu yinani lezindlela zokukhetha ${m}$ ezihlukene kuzo.
cm2_funcMonotone.explanation: Amanani omsebenzi akhethwa ngokukhetha ${m}$ ezihlukene phakathi kwezinombolo ezigcwele ezingu-${k}$ ezingu-${u}$ noma ngaphezulu futhi ${w}$ noma ngaphansi. Uma amanani akhethiwe ahlelwa kusuka kwelincane kuya ku-$f(1), f(2), \dots$, kunqunywa ngokukodwa, ngakho inani ngu-$_{{k}}\mathrm{C}_{{m}}={ans}$.

cm2_inclusionParam.prompt: Ngamasethi amabili $A=\{x\mid {Ac}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {Cc}\}$ ($x$ yinombolo yangempela), linini inani lamasethi $B=\{x\mid a\le x\le b\}$ ($a$, $b$ izinombolo ezigcwele) anelisa $A\subset B\subset C$? (Lapha, $\subset$ ihlanganisa nesimo lapho amasethi amabili alingana.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala ubonise u-$A$ no-$C$ njengamabanga wefomu $\alpha\le x\le\beta$.

Uma $A\subset B$, u-$a$ ungu-ngaphansi noma ulingana nomkhawulo wesobunxele ka-$A$, no-$b$ ungu-ngaphezulu noma ulingana nomkhawulo wesokudla ka-$A$, futhi uma $B\subset C$, u-$a$, $b$ kumele babe ebangeni lika-$C$. Bala amanani angaba khona ka-$a$ no-$b$ ngokwehlukana.
cm2_inclusionParam.explanation: $A=\{x\mid {al}\le x\le {ar}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {cl}\le x\le {cr}\}$. Ukuze $A\subset B\subset C$, kumele ${cl}\le a\le {al}$, ${ar}\le b\le {cr}$, ngakho u-$a$ unamanani angu-${na}$, u-$b$ unamanani angu-${nb}$, futhi inani lika-$B$ ngu-${na}\times{nb}={ans}$.

cm2_inverseQuadDom.prompt: Uma i-inverse function yomsebenzi $f(x)={fx}$ (${dom}$) ibizwa ngo-$g$, inani lika-$g({t})$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ngokukhawulela i-domain (${dom}$), u-$f$ uyi-one-to-one correspondence futhi unomsebenzi ophambene.
Uma $g({t})=x$, $f(x)={t}$. Thola izixazululo ze-quadratic equation $f(x)={t}$ bese ukhetha lowo ohambisana ne-domain.
cm2_inverseQuadDom.explanation: Ingabhalwa kabusha njengo-$f(x)={vf}$ futhi ku-$f(x)={t}$, ${sq}={s2}$, ngakho ${xp}=\pm{s}$. Njengoba i-domain ingu-${dom}$, ${xp}={rt}$ futhi $g({t})={ans}$.

cm2_inverseRational.prompt: Uma i-inverse function ye-$f(x)=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ ingu-$g$, inani lika-$g({k})$ liyini? (Isizinda sika-$f$ yizo zonke izinombolo zangempela lapho isihlukanisi singeyona $0$.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma $g({k})=x$, khona $f(x)={k}$.
Phindaphinda amaceleni womabili ka-$\frac{{num}}{{den}}={k}$ ngesihlukanisi, bese uxazulula njengesibalo sezinga lokuqala ku-$x$.
cm2_inverseRational.explanation: Uma $g({k})=x$, khona $f(x)={k}$, ngakho ${num}={k}\times({den})$. Uma uhlela ngokuya ku-$x$, $({coef})x={rhs}$, ngakho $x={ans}$, okungukuthi $g({k})={ans}$.

cm2_irrLineCount.prompt: Mangaki amanani aphelele $k$ enza ijika $y=\sqrt{{fr}}$ nomugqa $y=x+k$ kuhlangane ezindaweni ezi-2? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Chaza uhlamvu olusha $t$ ngale ndlela: $t=\sqrt{{fr}}$ ($t\ge 0$). Khona ungaveza u-$x$ ngokuya ku-$t$. Inani lezindawo zokuhlangana lilingana nenani lezimpande zangempela ezihlukene ezingeyona eziphansi kuka-zero zesibalo se-quadratic ku-$t$.
Isibalo se-quadratic ku-$t$ sinezimpande ezimbili zangempela ezihlukene ezingeyona eziphansi kuka-zero uma $D>0$, (isamba sezimpande ezimbili)$\ge 0$, (umphumela wezimpande ezimbili)$\ge 0$.
cm2_irrLineCount.explanation: Uma uchaza uhlamvu olusha $t$ ngendlela $t=\sqrt{{fr}}\ (t\ge 0)$, $x=\frac{t^2-({b})}{{a}}$ futhi ku-$t=x+k$ kuvela $t^2-{a}t+({a}k-({b}))=0$. Ukuze kube nezimpande ezimbili zangempela ezihlukene ezingeyona eziphansi kuka-zero, kudingeka $D={a}^2-4({a}k-({b}))>0$ nomphumela ${a}k-({b})\ge 0$ (isamba ${a}>0$), ngakho ${lt}\le k<{ht}$. Amanani aphelele $k$ angagculisa lokhu kusukela ku-${lo}$ kuya ku-${hi}$ angu-${ans}$.

cm2_irrationalMinMax.prompt: Inani eliphezulu le-$f(x)={fx}$ ku-${lo}\le x\le {hi}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Njengoba isisho esingaphansi kwempande siyisezinga lokuqala, uma u-$x$ ekhula, u-$f(x)$ ushintsha ngendlela eyodwa kuphela. Ngakho qhathanisa amanani ezigcawini zombili zesikhawu.
Thola inani lomsebenzi lapho $x={lo}$ nalapho $x={hi}$, bese ukhetha elikhulu.
cm2_irrationalMinMax.explanation: $f({lo})=\sqrt{{rl}}+({c})={flo}$, $f({hi})=\sqrt{{rh}}+({c})={fhi}$. Kulesi sikhawu u-$f$ uyakhula kuphela noma uyehla kuphela, ngakho elikhulu kuwo womabili lingenani eliphezulu futhi lingu-${ans}$.

cm2_irrationalPass.prompt: Iphoyinti elilodwa kugrafu yomsebenzi onengqondo-ngempande $y=\sqrt{a({xp})}{qs}$ ($a$ iyinombolo engashintshi engeyona $0$) ngu-$P({x0}, {y0})$. Inani lika-$a$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Faka izixhumanisi zephoyinti esibalweni. Qaphela ukuthi impande yesikwele ayingaphansi kuka-$0$.
Shiya impande yodwa, uphindaphinde amaceleni womabili ngokwesikwele, bese uxazulula isibalo sezinga lokuqala ku-$a$.
cm2_irrationalPass.explanation: Uma ufaka iphoyinti $P$, ${y0}=\sqrt{a({x0}-({p}))}+({q})$, ngakho $\sqrt{a\times({d})}={s}$. Uma uphindaphinda amaceleni womabili ngokwesikwele, $a\times({d})={s2}$, ngakho $a={ans}$.

cm2_lineCircleCount.prompt: Indingilizi $C$: ${circ}$, umugqa $l$: ${line}$. Mangaki amanani aphelele amahle $k$ enza ukuthi $C$ no-$l$ behlangane ezindaweni ezimbili ezihlukene? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma ibanga phakathi kwenkabazwe yendingilizi nomugqa lincane kunerediyasi, behlangana ezindaweni ezimbili ezihlukene.
Hlela lesi sisho sibe yi-inequality ku-$k$: ibanga $\frac{|{u}\times({cx})+({w})\times({cy})-k|}{\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}}<{rad}$.
cm2_lineCircleCount.explanation: Ibanga elisuka enkabazwe $({cx}, {cy})$ liye emugqeni kufanele libe lincane kunerediyasi ${rad}$, ngakho $|{K0}-k|<{rad}\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}=\sqrt{{R2}}$. Izinombolo eziphelele ezigculisa lokhu ziyi-${lo}\le k\le {hi}$, futhi inani lezinombolo eziphelele ezinhle phakathi kwazo lingu-${ans}$.

cm2_lineThroughPerp.prompt: Ephoyinteni $P({px}, {py})$, i-perpendicular edwetshelwe kumugqa $l$: ${line}$ (umugqa odlula epoyinteni $P$ futhi ume ngqo ku-$l$) ihlangana ne-$y$-axis epoyinteni elinesixhumanisi se-$y$ esiyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma imigqa emibili imi ngqo, isiphumo sokuthambeka kwayo siyi-$-1$.
Qala uthole ukuthambeka kwe-$l$, wakhe isibalo se-point-slope ngokuthambeka komugqa omi ngqo, bese ufaka $x=0$.
cm2_lineThroughPerp.explanation: Ukuthambeka komugqa $l$ ngu-${ms}$, ngakho ukuthambeka komugqa omi ngqo ngu-${mp}$. Njengoba udlula epoyinteni $P$, $y-({py})={mp}\left(x-({px})\right)$, futhi uma ufaka $x=0$, $y={ans}$.

cm2_necessaryDiv.prompt: Ngezimo ezimbili ze-integer $x$ $p$: $x$ iyisikhathi se-$m$. $q$: $x$ iyisikhathi se-${n}$. Zingaki izinombolo zemvelo $m$ lapho i-$p$ iyisimo esidingekayo se-$q$ kodwa ingesona isimo esanele? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma i-$p$ iyisimo esidingekayo se-$q$, $q\Rightarrow p$. Ngamasethi eqiniso, $Q\subset P$.
Ukuze zonke izikhathi ze-${n}$ zibe yizikhathi ze-$m$, i-$m$ kumele ibe yisihlukanisi se-${n}$. Ukuze kungabi yisimo esanele, i-$p\Rightarrow q$ akumele yenzeke.
cm2_necessaryDiv.explanation: Njengoba kuyisimo esidingekayo, $q\Rightarrow p$, okungukuthi zonke izikhathi ze-${n}$ kumele zibe yizikhathi ze-$m$, futhi lokhu kwenzeka uma i-$m$ iyisihlukanisi se-${n}$. Ukuze kungabi yisimo esanele, i-$p\Rightarrow q$ kumele ibe yinkohliso, kodwa uma i-$m$ iyisihlukanisi se-${n}$, i-$p\Rightarrow q$ yenzeka kuphela lapho $m={n}$. Njengoba i-${n}$ inezihlukanisi ezingu-${nd}$, inani le-$m$ elifunwayo ngu-${nd}-1={ans}$.

cm2_perpParam.prompt: Ngemigqa emibili $l_1: {l1}$, $l_2: {l2}$, yini isamba sawo wonke amanani angempela $k$ enza imigqa ihambisane noma ime ngqo? (Qaphela: lapho imigqa ingena enye, ayithathwa njengehambisanayo.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Imigqa emibili $ax+by+c=0$, $a'x+b'y+c'=0$ ihambisana (noma ingena enye) uma $ab'-a'b=0$, ime ngqo uma $aa'+bb'=0$.
Isimo sokuhambisana siba yisibalo se-quadratic ku-$k$, isimo sokuma ngqo siba yisibalo se-linear. Xazulula ngasinye uqoqe wonke amanani.
cm2_perpParam.explanation: Ama-coefficient e-$x$, $y$ ku-$l_1$ angu-${p}$, $k$ futhi ku-$l_2$ angu-$k{qs}$, ${rr}$. Isimo sokuhambisana: ${p}\times({rr})=k(k{qs})$, okungukuthi ${eqPar}=0$, $k={k1}$ noma $k={k2}$, futhi kuzo zombili izimo imigqa ayingeni enye. Isimo sokuma ngqo: ${p}(k{qs})+({rr})k=0$, $k={k3}$. Ngakho isamba ngu-${k1}+({k2})+({k3})={ans}$.

cm2_pointLineDist.prompt: Ibanga elisuka epoyinteni $P({x0}, {y0})$ liye kumugqa ${line}$ lingakanani? (Ungabhala ngedesimali noma ngengxenyana njenge-3/4)
hints: Ibanga eliphakathi kwephoyinti $(x_0,y_0)$ nomugqa $ax+by+c=0$ ngu-$\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$.
Isibalo sibalwa ngo-$|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|$, futhi isihlukanisi ngu-$\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}$.
cm2_pointLineDist.explanation: Ku-$\frac{|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|}{\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}}$, isibalo singu-${N}$ futhi $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}={h}$, ngakho ibanga ngu-$\frac{{N}}{{h}}={ans}$.

cm2_rationalAsym.prompt: Uma ama-asymptote amabili egrafu yomsebenzi we-rational $y=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ ayimigqa $x=p$, $y=q$, inani le-$p+q$ liyini? (Ungabhala ngedesimali noma ngengxenyana njenge-3/4)
hints: Inani le-$x$ eliyenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-$0$ yi-asymptote eqondile.
Inani lapho i-$y$ isondela kulo uma inani eliphelele le-$x$ likhula kakhulu yi-asymptote evundlile. Kuyisilinganiso sama-coefficient e-$x$ esibalweni nasesihlukanisini.
cm2_rationalAsym.explanation: I-asymptote eqondile yinani le-$x$ eyenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-$0$, ngakho umugqa $x={px}$. Uma $x\to\infty$, $y\to\frac{{a}}{{c}}={qy}$, ngakho i-asymptote evundlile ngu-$y={qy}$. Ngakho $p+q=({px})+({qy})={ans}$.

cm2_rationalIntersectCount.prompt: Zingaki izinombolo ezigcwele $n$ ezenza igrafu yomsebenzi $y={fr}$ nomugqa ${line}$ kube nezindawo ezimbili zokuhlangana, kanti $-{N}\le n\le {N}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Hlanganisa izibalo ezimbili wenze isibalo se-quadratic ku-$x$, bese ucabanga ngemibandela yokuba nezimpande ezimbili ezingafani (discriminant).
Njengoba uphindaphindile ngenkulumo ye-$x$ ukuze ususe isihlukanisi, hlola nokuthi izimpande zesibalo se-quadratic azenzi isihlukanisi sibe ngu-$0$.
cm2_rationalIntersectCount.explanation: Ngokuhlanganisa, ku-$\frac{{k}}{{den}}{qs}={mx}+n$, ngemva kokususa isihlukanisi, i-discriminant yesibalo se-quadratic ngu-$D=({nstr})^2{ds}$. (Izimpande azenzi isihlukanisi sibe ngu-$0$.) Kumele $D>0$, ngakho uma kususwa izinombolo ezigcwele $n$ ezingakwenzi lokhu, kususwa ${bad}$ kwezi-${tot}$ ebangeni, kusala ${ans}$.

cm2_rationalParam.prompt: Iphoyinti elilodwa kugrafu etholakala ngokushelelisa igrafu yomsebenzi $y=\frac{k}{x}$ ($k$ ngokungashintshi okungeyona u-$0$) nge-${p}$ endleleni ye-$x$ kanye ne-${q}$ endleleni ye-$y$ ngu-$P({x0}, {y0})$. Ihlangana nini i-$x$-axis, i-$x$-coordinate yephoyinti lokuhlangana ithini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma kushelelisiwe, kusibalo u-$x$ uba ngu-$x-({p})$ no-$y$ uba ngu-$y-({q})$.
Faka izixhumanisi zephoyinti elinikeziwe uthole u-$k$, bese ufaka u-$y=0$.
cm2_rationalParam.explanation: Igrafu eshelelisiwe ngu-$y=\frac{k}{{xsh}}{ysh}$. Njengoba iphoyinti $P$ lisegrafwini, ${y0}=\frac{k}{{dx}}{ysh}$ inika u-$k={kk}$. Uma u-$y=0$, $\frac{{kk}}{{xsh}}={nq}$, ngakho $x={ans}$.

cm2_reflectChainOrder.prompt: Iphoyinti $P(a, b)$ lishelelisiwe nge-${m}$ endleleni ye-$x$ nange-${n}$ endleleni ye-$y$ lenze iphoyinti $Q$, iphoyinti $Q$ liguqulelwe ngokuphindisa kunqobo lenze $R$, futhi $R$ liguqulelwe ku-$x$-axis lenze $S$. Uma izixhumanisi ze-$S$ zingu-$({sx}, {sy})$, inani le-$a+b$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuphindisa kunqobo kungu-$(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, ukuphindisa ku-$x$-axis kungu-$(x,y)\to(x,-y)$.
Njengoba ukushelelisa kwenziwa kuqala bese kuphindiswa, uphawu lushintsha nenani eligudluziwe. Buyela emuva isinyathelo ngasinye kusukela ku-$S$ noma ubhale ngo-$a$, $b$.

cm2_reflectCurve.prompt: Igrafu yomsebenzi $y={orig}$ iphindiswe kunqobo, bese ishelelisiwe nge-${m}$ endleleni ye-$x$ nange-${n}$ endleleni ye-$y$. Uma izixhumanisi ze-vertex yeparabola etholakele zingu-$(s, t)$, inani le-$s+t$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuphindisa kunqobo kungu-$(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, ngakho shintsha u-$x$ ube ngu-$-x$ no-$y$ ube ngu-$-y$ kusibalo.
Ungathola i-vertex yeparabola yokuqala usebenzise ukuguqula kokubili ngokulandelana, noma wakhe isibalo esiguquliwe ngqo.
cm2_reflectCurve.explanation: I-vertex yeparabola yokuqala ngu-$({h}, {k})$. Uma iphindiswa kunqobo, iba yiparabola yohlobo $y=-({orig2})$ ene-vertex ethi $({nh}, {nk})$. Ngokushelelisa nge-${m}$ ku-$x$ nange-${n}$ ku-$y$, $(s, t)=({s}, {t})$, ngakho $s+t={ans}$.

cm2_reflectPointChain.prompt: Iphoyinti $P(a, b)$ liguqulelwe emugqeni $y=x$ lenze $Q$, $Q$ liguqulelwe ku-$y$-axis lenze $R$, futhi $R$ lishelelisiwe nge-${m}$ endleleni ye-$x$ nange-${n}$ endleleni ye-$y$ lenze $S$. Uma izixhumanisi ze-$S$ zingu-$({sx}, {sy})$, inani le-$a+b$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ukuguqulela emugqeni $y=x$ kungu-$(x,y)\to(y,x)$, ukuguqulela ku-$y$-axis kungu-$(x,y)\to(-x,y)$.
Buyela emuva isinyathelo ngasinye kusukela ku-$S$, noma ubhale izixhumanisi ukusuka ku-$P(a,b)$ kuya ku-$S$ ngo-$a$, $b$.

cm2_reflectShortest.prompt: Ngephoyinti $A({a1}, {a2})$, iphoyinti $B({b1}, {b2})$ nephoyinti $P$ elihambayo ku-$x$-axis, inani elincane kakhulu lika-$\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Njengoba amaphoyinti amabili ohlangothini olulodwa lwe-$x$-axis, ngokukhombisa iphoyinti elilodwa ku-$x$-axis, ungashintsha u-$\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ ube ubude besigaba esisodwa.
Uma uthatha iphoyinti $B'$ elikhombisiwe lika-$B$ ku-$x$-axis, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$ futhi $\overline{A P}+\overline{PB'}\ge\overline{AB'}$.
cm2_reflectShortest.explanation: Uma iphoyinti elikhombisiwe lika-$B$ ku-$x$-axis lingu-$B'({b1}, {nb2})$, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$, ngakho $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}\ge\overline{AB'}$, futhi njengoba u-$A$ no-$B'$ bezinhlangothini ezibhekene ze-$x$-axis, isigaba $AB'$ sihlangana ne-$x$-axis, ngakho ukulingana kuyasebenza. $\overline{AB'}=\sqrt{({b1}-({a1}))^2+({a2}-({nb2}))^2}=\sqrt{{dx}^2+{ss}^2}={ans}$.

cm2_setOpSum.prompt: $U$ yisethi yazo zonke izinombolo zemvelo ezingu-1 noma ngaphezulu futhi ${N}$ noma ngaphansi, $A$ yisethi yawo wonke ama-divisor ka-${da}$ ezingxenyeni ze-$U$, futhi $B$ yisethi yawo wonke ama-multiple ka-${mb}$ ezingxenyeni ze-$U$. Isamba sazo zonke izingxenye zesethi ${ex}$ siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala ubonise u-$A$ no-$B$ ngokubhala izingxenye zazo.
I-complement $X^c$ yizingxenye ezisele ze-$U$ ngemuva kokususa izingxenye ze-$X$. Bala kusukela ngaphakathi kwamabhakede.

cm2_setSumCount.prompt: Ngamasethi amabili $A=\{{sa}\}$, $B=\{{sb}\}$, isamba sazo zonke izingxenye zesethi $C=\{x+y\mid x\in A,\ y\in B\}$ siyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Khetha ingxenye eyodwa ku-$A$ neyodwa ku-$B$ bese uzengeza, wenze zonke izinhlanganisela.
Noma inani elifanayo livela izikhathi eziningi, ingxenye yesethi ibalwa kanye kuphela.
cm2_setSumCount.explanation: Uma kutholakala zonke izamba ezingaba khona, amanani ahlukene ngu-${sc}$. Njengoba isethi ibhala ingxenye efanayo kanye kuphela, isamba sezingxenye ngu-${ans}$.

cm2_sufficientQuad.prompt: Kunezimo ezimbili ze-real number $x$, $p$: $x>a$, $q$: ${quad}>0$. Linini inani elincane kakhulu lenombolo ephelele $a$ eyenza u-$p$ abe yisimo esanele sika-$q$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma u-$p$ eyisimo esanele sika-$q$, $p\Rightarrow q$, okusho ukuthi isethi yeqiniso ka-$p$ iqukethwe yisethi yeqiniso ka-$q$.
Qala uxazulule ukungalingani kwe-quadratic ${quad}>0$ ukuze uthole isethi yeqiniso ka-$q$.
cm2_sufficientQuad.explanation: Isixazululo se-${quad}>0$ ngu-$x<{Rs}$ noma $x>{Rl}$. Ukuze isethi yeqiniso ka-$p$ $\{x\mid x>a\}$ iqukethwe yile sethi, kumele $a\ge {Rl}$. Ngakho inani elincane kakhulu lenombolo ephelele $a$ ngu-${ans}$.

cm2_tangentAtPoint.prompt: Iphoyinti elilodwa emgqeni we-tangent endaweni $({x1}, {y1})$ ye-circle ${circ}$ ngu-$Q({t}, k)$. Linini inani lika-$k$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: I-tangent endaweni elodwa ye-circle ibhekene nge-radius exhumanisa leyo ndawo nesikhungo.
Qala wakhe i-equation ye-tangent, bese ufaka ama-coordinate ephoyinti $Q$.
cm2_tangentAtPoint.explanation: I-equation ye-tangent ngu-${tang}$. Njengoba iphoyinti $Q$ lisemgqeni we-tangent, ngokufaka $x={t}$, $y=k$, $k={ans}$.

cm2_translateCurve.prompt: Igrafu yomsebenzi $y={orig}$ yathuthwa ngo-$m$ ngokuya ohlangothini lwe-$x$-axis nango-$n$ ngokuya ohlangothini lwe-$y$-axis, futhi yafana negrafu yomsebenzi $y={img}$. Linini inani le-$m+n$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma uthutha ngo-$m$ ohlangothini lwe-$x$-axis nango-$n$ ohlangothini lwe-$y$-axis, faka u-$x-m$ esikhundleni sika-$x$ no-$y-n$ esikhundleni sika-$y$.
Nweba u-$y-n=f(x-m)$ bese uqhathanisa ikhoefishenti ka-$x$ kuqala ukuthola u-$m$.
cm2_translateCurve.explanation: I-equation ethuthiwe ngu-$y-n={shift}$. Ngokunweba nokuqhathanisa amakhoefishenti ka-$x$, ${b}-({tw})m={b2}$, ngakho $m={m}$, futhi ngokuqhathanisa i-constant term, $n={n}$. Ngakho $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_truthRange.prompt: Kuzimo ezimbili $p$: ${quad}\le 0$, $q$: $|{cx}|\le a$ ngenombolo yangempela $x$, ukuze isitatimende $p\to q$ sibe nesiphikisi esiyiqiniso, inani elincane kakhulu lenombolo yemvelo $a$ ngu-$\alpha$, futhi ukuze okuphambene kwesitatimende $p\to q$ kube yiqiniso, inani elikhulu kakhulu lenombolo yemvelo $a$ ngu-$\beta$. Linani luni $\alpha\beta$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela.)
hints: Isitatimende nesiphikisi saso njalo kunobuqiniso obufanayo. Okuphambene $q\to p$ kudinga ukuhlolwa ngokwehlukile. Uma amasethi eqiniso ayi-$P$ no-$Q$, uma $p\to q$ iyiqiniso, khona-ke $P\subset Q$.
Qala ngokubhala $P$ njengesikhawu, bese ubhala $Q$ ngo-$a$ ngokuxazulula $|{cx}|\le a$. Thola ububanzi buka-$a$ ukuze isiphikisi sibe ngu-$P\subset Q$ nokuphambene kube ngu-$Q\subset P$.
cm2_truthRange.explanation: $P=\{x\mid {m}\le x\le {n}\}$ futhi $|{cx}|\le a$ ngu-$-a\le {cx}\le a$. Isiphikisi sinobuqiniso obufana nesitatimende sokuqala, ngakho kumele $P\subset Q$; ekugcineni kwe-$P$ ku-$x={m}$ no-$x={n}$ inani lika-${cx}$ yi-${u}$ ne-${w}$, ngakho $a\ge {d1}$, $a\ge {d2}$. Ngakho $\alpha={al}$. Okuphambene kumele kube ngu-$Q\subset P$, futhi $Q$ ngu-${lowS}\le {kx}\le {highS}$, ngakho ${lowS}\ge {km}$, ${highS}\le {kn}$, okungukuthi $a\le {d1}$, $a\le {d2}$. Ngakho $\beta={be}$ futhi $\alpha\beta={al}\times{be}={ans}$.

cm2_vennReverse.prompt: Kumasethi amabili angaphansi $A$, $B$ esethi yendawo yonke $U$, $n(U)={nu}$, $n(A)={na}$, $n(B)={nb}$, $n((A\cup B)^c)={nc}$. Linani luni $n(A^c\cup B)$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela.)
hints: Qala ngokuthola inani lezinto zenyunyana ngo-$n(A\cup B)=n(U)-n((A\cup B)^c)$.
Ngokusebenzisa $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$, $n(A^c\cup B)=n(U)-n(A-B)$.
cm2_vennReverse.explanation: $n(A\cup B)={nu}-{nc}={un}$ futhi $n(A\cap B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cup B)={na}+{nb}-{un}={ab}$. $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$ futhi $n(A-B)={na}-{ab}$, ngakho $n(A^c\cup B)={nu}-({na}-{ab})={ans}$.

cul_bordaMax.prompt: Lokhu ukuvota kwe-Borda kokukhetha oyedwa kubaqokiwe u-A, B, C. Indawo yokuqala inikwa amaphuzu angu-$2$, eyesibili iphuzu elingu-$1$, neyesithathu angu-$0$. Uma amashidi okuhleleka eyi-'{b1}' ${n1}$ abantu, '{b2}' ${n2}$ abantu, '{b3}' ${n3}$ abantu, liyini isamba esiphakeme kakhulu phakathi kwabaqokiwe abathathu? (Bhala inombolo kuphela.)
hints: Thola ukuthi umqokiwe ngamunye uyisikhundla sesingakanani eshidini ngalinye, bese unquma amaphuzu.
Thola izamba zabo bonke abathathu bese ukhetha inani elikhulu kakhulu.
cul_bordaMax.explanation: Isamba sika-A singamaphuzu angu-${eA}$, sika-B singu-${eB}$, sika-C singu-${eC}$. Isamba esiphakeme kakhulu singamaphuzu angu-${ans}$.

cul_bordaTotal.prompt: Lokhu ukuvota kwe-Borda kokukhetha oyedwa kubaqokiwe u-A, B, C. Indawo yokuqala inikwa amaphuzu angu-$2$, eyesibili iphuzu elingu-$1$, neyesithathu angu-$0$. Uma amashidi okuhleleka eyi-'A>B>C' ${n1}$ abantu, 'B>C>A' ${n2}$ abantu, 'C>A>B' ${n3}$ abantu, liyini isamba sika-A? (Bhala inombolo kuphela.)
hints: Qala ngokuthola ukuthi u-A uyisikhundla sesingakanani eshidini ngalinye.
Hlanganisa konke (inani labantu)×(amaphuzu esikhundla).
cul_bordaTotal.explanation: U-A eshidini lokuqala uyokuqala (amaphuzu angu-2), eshidini lesibili uyesithathu (angu-0), eshidini lesithathu uyesibili (iphuzu elingu-1), ngakho ${n1}\times2+{n2}\times0+{n3}\times1={ans}$ amaphuzu.

cul_brailleAtMost.prompt: Iseli elilodwa le-Braille linezindawo ezingu-${d}$ lapho amachashazi engabekwa khona, futhi indawo ngayinye iyaphakama noma ayiphakami. Zingaki izimo ezihlukene eselini elilodwa ezinamachashazi aphakanyisiwe ayi-1 kuya ku-${k}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela.)
hints: Inani lezimo ezinamachashazi aphakanyisiwe angu-$j$ kanye linganombolo yezindlela zokukhetha izindawo ezingu-$j$ kuzo ezingu-${d}$.
Thola ngayinye kusukela ku-$j=1$ kuya ku-$j={k}$ bese uzihlanganisa.
cul_brailleAtMost.explanation: Izimo ezinamachashazi aphakanyisiwe angu-$j$ zingu-$_{{d}}\mathrm{C}_{j}$, ngakho ${terms}={ans}$ izimo.

cul_pitchFifth.prompt: Imvamisa yenothi yesisekelo yi-${f}$ Hz. Kusuka kule nothi, khuphula nge-octave ezingu-${k}$, bese uphinda ukhuphule nge-perfect fifth (isilinganiso semvamisa $3:2$). Imvamisa yenothi ephumela ingaki ngama-Hz? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Inothi elingu-octave ngaphezulu linemvamisa ephindwe kabili.
I-perfect fifth ngaphezulu iphindaphindwa ngo-$\frac{3}{2}$ emvamisweni.
cul_pitchFifth.explanation: Ama-octave angu-${k}$ ngaphezulu: ${f}\times 2^{{k}}={mid}$ Hz, i-perfect fifth ngaphezulu: ${mid}\times\frac{3}{2}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_stringLength.prompt: Intambo yesixhumi iba nemvamisa ephakeme uma ifushane, futhi uma ubukhulu bentambo nokuqina kufana, imvamisa iyahambelana ngokuphambene nobude bentambo. Uma intambo ende ngama-cm angu-${L}$ ikhipha inothi le-${f}$ Hz, imvamisa yenothi ingaki ngama-Hz uma uyicindezela intambo efanayo ukuze ingxenye ebhomayo ibe ngama-cm angu-${L2}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Inani le-(imvamisa)×(ubude) alishintshi.
Hlukanisa inani le-${f}\times{L}$ ngobude obusha ${L2}$ cm.

cul_voteGuarantee.prompt: Abazongenela A, B no-C bancintisana ekhetho lapho owodwa onamavoti amaningi ewina. Imiphumela yesikhashana yokubalwa yi-A ${a}$ amavoti, B ${b}$ amavoti, C ${c}$ amavoti, futhi kusele amavoti angu-${m}$ angakabalwa. Ukuze u-C aqinisekise ukuba wokuqala yedwa kungakhathaliseki ukuthi amavoti asele ahlukaniswa kanjani phakathi kuka-A no-B, u-C kufanele athole okungenani amavoti amangaki kumavoti asele angu-${m}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma u-C ethola amavoti angu-$x$ kumavoti asele, amavoti asele ${m}$−$x$ aya kwabanye abazongenela. Isimo esingesihle kakhulu ukuthi wonke aya kozongenela ohamba phambili manje.
Amavoti ka-C kumele abe amaningi kunamavoti ozongenela ohamba phambili (hhayi alinganayo). Setha i-inequality uthole inombolo encane kakhulu ye-integer $x$.
cul_voteGuarantee.explanation: Inani eliphezulu lamavoti okwamanje liyi-${M}$. Uma u-C ethola amavoti angu-$x$ kumavoti asele futhi amavoti asele ${m}-x$ wonke aya kozongenela onamavoti angu-${M}$, kufanele ${c}+x>{M}+({m}-x)$. Ngokuyisonga, $x>{half}$, ngakho inombolo encane kakhulu ye-integer yi-${ans}$.

econ_annuityPV.prompt: Kunenzuzo yonyaka ethola i-${A}$ won ekupheleni konyaka ngamunye iminyaka engu-${n}$ (inkokhelo yokuqala emva konyaka owodwa, eyokugcina emva kweminyaka engu-${n}$). Uma inzalo ngonyaka iyi-${r}$% futhi i-compounding yenziwa unyaka ngamunye, inani lamanje lale nzuzo lingaki ngama-won? (Phonsa ngaphansi kwe-won. Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Landa inkokhelo ngayinye ibuyele enanini lamanje ngokuya ngesikhathi sokukhokha, bese uqoqa konke.
Uma inzalo iyi-$i=\frac{{r}}{100}$, inani lamanje liyi-$A\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}$.
econ_annuityPV.explanation: Njengoba $i={r}/100$, inani lamanje liyi-${A}\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}\approx{ex}$ won, futhi uma uphonsa ngaphansi kwe-won, liyi-${ans}$ won.

econ_compoundFV.prompt: Faka i-${P}$ won iminyaka engu-${n}$ ku-akhawunti ene-compound interest lapho inzalo yonyaka iyi-${r}$% futhi inzalo yengezwa kumali yokuqala izikhathi ezingu-${m}$ ngonyaka. Izinga lesikhathi ngasinye liyi-(izinga lonyaka)$\div{m}$, futhi awukhiphi imali phakathi. Inani eliphelele emva kweminyaka engu-${n}$ lingaki ngama-won? (Phonsa ngaphansi kwe-won. Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Inani lezikhathi zokubala inzalo liyi-(izikhathi ngonyaka)×(iminyaka).
Sebenzisa izinga lesikhathi esisodwa ${rp}$%: inani eliphelele liyimali yokuqala ephindaphindwe ngo-$(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})$ ngenani lezikhathi zokubala.
econ_compoundFV.explanation: Inani lezikhathi zokubala liyi-${m}\times{n}={k}$, izinga lesikhathi esisodwa liyi-${rp}$%, ngakho inani eliphelele liyi-${P}\times(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})^{{k}}\approx{ex}$ won, futhi uma uphonsa ngaphansi kwe-won, liyi-${ans}$ won.

econ_elasticityPoint.prompt: Umsebenzi wesidingo uyi-$q={D}$ ($p$ yintengo, $q$ yinani elidingwayo). Uma intengo iyi-$p={p0}$, yini inani le-price elasticity yesidingo $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$? (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthole i-$q'(p)$ bese ubala inani layo lapho $p={p0}$.
Thola nenani elidingwayo $q$ lapho $p={p0}$ bese ulifaka ku-$e$.
econ_elasticityPoint.explanation: Inani le-$q'(p)$ lapho $p={p0}$ liyi-${dqv}$, inani elidingwayo liyi-$q={qv}$, ngakho $e=\frac{{adq}\times{p0}}{{qv}}={fr}$.

econ_elasticityUnit.prompt: Emsebenzini wesidingo $q={D}$, yiyiphi intengo $p$ lapho i-price elasticity $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$ iba ngu-1? (Cabanga ebangeni lapho $p>0$ nenani lesidingo $q>0$.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Thola u-$q'(p)$ bese ubhala $\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|=1$ njengesibalo sika-$p$.
Ebangeni lapho $q>0$, $q'(p)<0$, ngakho ngemva kokususa inani eliphelele, $-q'(p)\times p=q$.
econ_elasticityUnit.explanation: Ngoba $q'(p)={dq}$, ku-$-q'(p)\times p=q$ kutholakala ${eqn}$, futhi isixazululo esinga-$p>0$ ngu-$p={ans}$.

econ_equilibriumTable.prompt: Inani lesidingo somkhiqizo othile lingu-${qd1}$ uma intengo ingu-${p1}$ won futhi ${qd2}$ uma ingu-${p2}$ won, futhi inani lokuphakelwa lingu-${qs1}$ uma intengo ingu-${p3}$ won futhi ${qs2}$ uma ingu-${p4}$ won. Uma inani lesidingo nelokuphakelwa kokubili kungemisebenzi yomugqa yentengo, iyini intengo yokulinganisela lapho inani lesidingo nelokuphakelwa kulingana, ngo-won? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ngomthambeka womugqa odlula emaphoyinti amabili, thola ukuthi inani lesidingo nelokuphakelwa lishintsha kangakanani ngenxa yentengo.
Beka inani lesidingo njengo-$Q_d$, elokuphakelwa njengo-$Q_s$, bese uthola intengo lapho $Q_d=Q_s$.
econ_equilibriumTable.explanation: Izinga lokushintsha kwesidingo ngu-$\frac{{qd2}-{qd1}}{{p2}-{p1}}={md}$, ngakho $Q_d={qd1}{md}(p-{p1})$, futhi izinga lokushintsha kokuphakelwa ngu-${ns}$, ngakho $Q_s={qs1}+{ns}(p-{p3})$. Uma $Q_d=Q_s$ ixazululwa, $p={ans}$ won.

econ_exchangeCross.prompt: Izinga lokushintshaniswa kwemali ngu-1 dola $={d}$ won, 1 euro $={e}$ won. Uma ushintsha ama-euro angu-${n}$ abe ngamadola ngaphandle kwenkokhelo, kungamadola amangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uthole ukuthi ama-euro angu-${n}$ angu-won emangaki.
Hlukanisa leyo mali ye-won ngenani likadola elilodwa elingu-${d}$ won.
econ_exchangeCross.explanation: Ama-euro angu-${n}$ angu-${n}\times{e}={won}$ won, futhi ${won}\div{d}={ans}$ amadola.

econ_inverseEntry.prompt: Isilinganiso sesakhiwo se-matrix ephambene $A^{-1}$ ye-matrix $A={M}$ ku-$({i}, {j})$ siyini? (Isakhi $(i, j)$ yisakhi somugqa $i$ nekholomu $j$.) (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: I-determinant ye-matrix ${G}$ ngu-$ad-bc$. Uma ingeyona u-0, kunayo i-matrix ephambene.
I-matrix ephambene ngu-${H}$.
econ_inverseEntry.explanation: I-determinant ngu-${ap}\times{dp}-{bp}\times{cp}={det}$, futhi isakhi esingu-$({i}, {j})$ se-$A^{-1}$ ngu-$\frac{{num}}{{det}}$, okungukuthi ${fr}$.

econ_leontief.prompt: I-matrix yama-coefficient okufakwayo yezimboni ezimbili 1, 2 ingu-$A={M}$ (isakhi $(i, j)$ se-$A$ yinani lomkhiqizo wemboni $i$ odingekayo lapho imboni $j$ ikhiqiza iyunithi eyodwa). Uma ukukhiqizwa okuphelele kwezimboni zombili kungu-$x_1$, $x_2$ (iyunithi: 100 million won), nesidingo sokugcina ngu-$d_1={d1}$, $d_2={d2}$, kuyiqiniso ukuthi ${XV}=A{XV}+{DV}$. Liyini inani lika-$x_1$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Shintsha isibalo sibe ngu-$(I-A){XV}={DV}$.
Thola i-matrix ephambene ye-$I-A$ bese uyiphindaphinda ngo-${DV}$. I-matrix ephambene ye-$2\times2$ itholakala ngokuphindaphinda i-matrix enezakhi ezihlelwe kabusha ngo-$\frac{1}{ad-bc}$.

econ_marginalRevenue.prompt: Igophe lesidingo somkhiqizo othile lingu-$p={a}-{b}q$ ($p$ yintengo (won), $q$ inani elithengisiwe (ama-unit)). Inzuzo ephelele ngu-$R(q)=pq$, futhi inzuzo ephawulekayo yi-$R'(q)$, i-derivative ye-$R(q)$ ngokuya ngo-$q$. Inani elithengisiwe $q$ lingu-mangaki lapho inzuzo ephawulekayo ingu-${m}$ won? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Faka $p={a}-{b}q$ ku-$R(q)=pq$ ukuze uveze u-$R(q)$ njengesisho sika-$q$.
Thola u-$q$ lapho inani lesisho esiphikisiwe se-$R(q)$ lingu-${m}$ won.

econ_presentValue.prompt: Inzalo ye-compound ibalwa unyaka ngamunye ngesilinganiso sonyaka esingu-${r}$%. Inani lamanje lika-${F}$ won ozolithola ngemuva kweminyaka engu-${n}$ lingu-won bangaki? (Okungaphansi kuka-1 won kuyalahlwa. Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Inani lamanje $P$ yinani lapho u-$P$ ekhula nge-compound iminyaka engu-${n}$ ibe ngu-${F}$ won.
econ_presentValue.explanation: $P={F}\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}\approx{ex}$ won, futhi ngokulahla okungaphansi kuka-1 won, kungu-${ans}$ won.

econ_profitCubic.prompt: Izindleko zesamba zokukhiqiza izingcezu ezingu-$q$ zomkhiqizo othile zingu-$C(q)=q^3-{b}q^2+{c}q+{f}$ (won), futhi intengo yokuthengisa ingu-${p}$ won ngengcezu eyodwa njalo. Uma yonke into ekhiqiziwe ithengiswa, inani elikhulu kunawo wonke lenzuzo (imali engenayo ngaphandle kwezindleko zesamba) lingu-won bangaki? ($q$ yinombolo yangempela engaphansi kuka-0 noma ilingana no-0 kuphela.) (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Inzuzo ngu-$\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$. Yenza i-derivative uthole u-$q$ lapho $\pi'(q)=0$.
Empandeni enhle ye-$\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=0$, uphawu lwe-$\pi'(q)$ lushintsha kusuka ku-+ luye ku--.
econ_profitCubic.explanation: Njengoba $\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$, $\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=-3(q-{q0})(q+{s})$. Ku-$q\ge0$, u-$\pi'$ unaphawu oluhle ngaphambi kuka-$q={q0}$ futhi olubi ngemuva kwalo, ngakho okukhulu kunakho konke kungu-$q={q0}$ futhi $\pi({q0})={ans}$ won.

econ_regionLP.prompt: Kunefekthri ekhiqiza izingcezu ezingu-$x$ zomkhiqizo A nezingu-$y$ zomkhiqizo B ($x$, $y$ izinombolo ezigcwele ezingaphansi kuka-0 noma ezilingana no-0 kuphela). Impahla nesikhathi sokusebenza ngengcezu eyodwa yomkhiqizo A kungu-${a1}$ kg ne-${t1}$ amahora, nomkhiqizo B ngu-${b1}$ kg ne-${t2}$ amahora. Impahla engasetshenziswa ngosuku ingu-${M}$ kg noma ngaphansi, isamba sesikhathi sokusebenza sabasebenzi bonke singu-${T}$ amahora noma ngaphansi, futhi inzuzo ingu-${pa}$ ama-10000 won ngengcezu eyodwa yomkhiqizo A nokungu-${pb}$ ama-10000 won ngengcezu eyodwa yomkhiqizo B. Inzuzo enkulu kunazo zonke ngosuku ingu-ama-10000 won amangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bhala izimo njengokungalingani, bese ubonisa indawo kuplani yokuhlanganisa ne-$x\ge0$, $y\ge0$.
Inzuzo ${pa}x+{pb}y$ ibe nkulu kakhulu kwelinye lamakhoneni endawo. Hlola iphoyinti lokuhlangana kwemigqa emibili yomngcele kuqala.
econ_regionLP.explanation: Ukungalingani kungu-${a1}x+{b1}y\le{M}$, ${t1}x+{t2}y\le{T}$, $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$. Ikhoneni lenzuzo enkulu kunazo zonke liphoyinti lokuhlangana kwemigqa emibili yomngcele $({x0}, {y0})$, futhi njengoba leli phoyinti linezinombolo ezigcwele, inzuzo enkulu ngu-${pa}\times{x0}+{pb}\times{y0}={ans}$ ama-10000 won.

econ_taxBracket.prompt: Entekenikeni yezwe elithile, intela yemali engenayo yehlukaniswa ngezigaba zesisekelo senhlawulo, futhi isigaba ngasinye sinesilinganiso sentela esihlukile. Esigabeni esingu-${b1}$ ama-10000 won noma ngaphansi sisebenza u-${r1}$%, esigabeni esingaphezu kuka-${b1}$ kodwa esingu-${b2}$ ama-10000 won noma ngaphansi u-${r2}$%, nasesigabeni esidlula u-${b2}$ ama-10000 won u-${r3}$%. Uma isisekelo senhlawulo singu-${x1}$ ama-10000 won, intela okufanele ikhokhwe ingu-ama-10000 won amangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Isilinganiso sentela sisebenza kuphela enanini elisesigabeni salo. Qala uthole inani elisesigabeni ngasinye.
Engeza konke (inani lesigaba)×(isilinganiso sentela).
econ_taxBracket.explanation: Amanani ezigaba angu-${s1}$, ${s2}$, ${s3}$ ama-10000 won, ngakho intela ngu-${s1}\times\frac{{r1}}{100}+{s2}\times\frac{{r2}}{100}+{s3}\times\frac{{r3}}{100}={ans}$ ama-10000 won.

econ_taxEquilibrium.prompt: Ijika lesidingo somkhiqizo othile lingu-$p={a}-{b}q$ futhi ijika lokuhlinzeka lingu-$p={c}+{d}q$. Lapha $p$ yintengo (won) no-$q$ yinani (izingcezu). Uma uhulumeni ufaka intela engu-${t}$ won kumhlinzeki ngokuthengisa ngokukodwa, umhlinzeki uthola intengo ekhokhwe umthengi ngaphandle kwentela. Ekulinganisweni ngemuva kokufaka intela, intengo ekhokhwa umthengi ingu-won bangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Intengo umhlinzeki ayithola ngempela ngu-$p-{t}$.
Faka u-$p-{t}$ esikhundleni sika-$p$ ejikeni lokuhlinzeka, bese ufaka ijika lesidingo $p={a}-{b}q$ uthole u-$q$.
econ_taxEquilibrium.explanation: Intengo yomhlinzeki ngu-$p-{t}$, ngakho $({a}-{b}q)-{t}={c}+{d}q$. Ngokuxazulula, $q={qn}$, futhi intengo ekhokhwa umthengi ngu-$p={a}-{b}\times{qn}={ans}$ won.

econ_utilityBundle.prompt: Impahla ye-x ingu-${a}$ won ngayinye, impahla ye-y ingu-${b}$ won ngayinye. Uhlela ukusebenzisa lonke isabelomali esingu-${I}$ won ngaphandle kokusala, ukuthenga izinto ze-x ezingu-$x$ nezinto ze-y ezingu-$y$ ($x$, $y$ izinombolo ezigcwele ezilingana no-0 noma ezinkulu kuno-0). Uma inzuzo inikezwa ngu-$U={U}$, liyini inani eliphezulu lika-$U$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Thola wonke ama-$(x, y)$ azizinombolo ezigcwele ezilingana no-0 noma ezinkulu kuno-0 agcwalisa isibalo sesabelomali ${a}x+{b}y={I}$.
Bala inani lika-$U$ kuma-$(x, y)$ ngamunye otholakele bese uliqhathanisa.
econ_utilityBundle.explanation: Ama-$(x, y)$ agcwalisa isibalo sesabelomali angu-${pairs}$. Phakathi kwawo, ibhangqa elinenani elikhulu kakhulu lika-$U$ ngu-$(x, y)=({bx}, {by})$ (uma kunamabhangqa amaningi anenani elikhulu kakhulu, elilodwa lawo), futhi lapho $U={ans}$.

geo_conicGeneral.prompt: Phakathi kwezindawo zokugxila ze-conic ${eq}$, uma leyo enesixhumanisi se-$x$ esikhulu kakhulu (uma kunendawo eyodwa kuphela, leyo phoyinti) iyi-$(a,\ b)$, liyini inani lika-$a+b$? (Bhala njengenombolo yonke. Uma iyinegethivu, engeza u--)
hints: Shintsha u-$x$ no-$y$ ngamunye abe yizikwele eziphelele ukuze uthole uhlobo lwejwayelekile.
Funda maphakathi (noma i-vertex) kuhlobo lwejwayelekile, bese uhambisa ngo-$c$ (ku-parabola ngo-$p$) uye ohlangothini lapho kukhona indawo yokugxila.
geo_conicGeneral.explanation: Uma kushintshwa kube yizikwele eziphelele, kutholakala ${std}$. Indawo yokugxila iyi-${foc}$, ngakho $a+b={ans}$.

geo_conicParam.prompt: Uma ibanga phakathi kwezindawo zokugxila ezimbili zomcibisholo ${eq}$ lingu-${fd}$ futhi ${cond}$, liyini inani lika-$k$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma ibanga phakathi kwezindawo zokugxila ezimbili lithi $2c$, ungaqala uthole inani lika-$c$. Nquma nokuthi isihlukanisi esiyiphi singu-$a^2$.
I-ellipse: $c^2=a^2-b^2$, i-hyperbola: $c^2=a^2+b^2$. Thola u-$k$ kulesi sibalo.
geo_conicParam.explanation: Ngoba ibanga phakathi kwezindawo zokugxila ezimbili lingu-$2c={fd}$, $c={c}$, $c^2={c2}$. Ngoba ${work}$, $k={ans}$.

geo_conicTangentLine.prompt: Emgqeni ${ln}$ othinta umcibisholo ${eq}$, liyini inani eliyiphozithivu lika-$k$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Faka isibalo somugqa ku-equation yomcibisholo ukwenza i-equation ye-quadratic ka-$x$; uma uthinta, i-discriminant ingu-$0$.
Thola isibalo sika-$k$ ku-discriminant $D=0$.
geo_conicTangentLine.explanation: Uma isibalo somugqa sifakwa ku-equation yomcibisholo, kutholakala i-equation ye-quadratic ka-$x$, ${quad}$, futhi ngoba uthinta, i-discriminant $D=0$. Ngoba ${work}$, inani eliyiphozithivu lika-$k$ ngu-${ans}$.

geo_divPoint.prompt: Kumaphoyinti amabili emkhathini wezixhumanisi $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$, iphoyinti P liseqenjini AB futhi $AP:PB={m}:{n}$. Siyini isamba sezixhumanisi ezintathu zephoyinti P? (Bhala njengenombolo yonke. Uma iyinegethivu, engeza u--)
hints: Izixhumanisi zephoyinti elihlukanisa ingxenye AB ngaphakathi ngo-$m:n$ ziyi-$\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n},\ \frac{mz_2+nz_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Bala isixhumanisi ngasinye ngokwehlukana.

geo_divRatioPlane.prompt: Kumaphoyinti amabili emkhathini wezixhumanisi $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$, ake sithi iphoyinti lapho ingxenye AB ihlangana khona nepulani ${pl}$ ngu-P. Uma $AP:PB=m:n$ ($m$, $n$ zizinombolo zemvelo ezingenayo isihlukanisi esivamile), liyini inani lika-$m+n$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Iphoyinti epulani ${pl}$ linesixhumanisi esisodwa esingu-$0$.
Veza lesi sixhumanisi sephoyinti elihlukanisa ingxenye AB ngaphakathi ngo-$s:t$ ngo-$s$, $t$ bese usilinganisa no-$0$.
geo_divRatioPlane.explanation: Uma $AP:PB=s:t$, isixhumanisi esihambisanayo sephoyinti P kumele sibe $\frac{t\cdot({za})+s\cdot({zb})}{s+t}=0$, ngakho $s:t=|{za}|:|{zb}|={ua}:{ub}$. Uma kwenziwa lula kube izinombolo ezingenayo isihlukanisi esivamile, ${m}:{n}$, ngakho $m+n={ans}$.

geo_dotAngle.prompt: Uma usayizi we-engeli eyakhiwe ama-vector amabili $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ ungu-$\theta$ ($0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$), liyini inani le-$\theta$? (Loba izinombolo kuphela ngamadigri)
hints: I-cosine ye-engeli eyakhiwe ama-vector amabili ngu-$\cos\theta=\frac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|}$.
Thola i-dot product nosayizi bama-vector womabili.

geo_dotNormExpand.prompt: Ngama-vector amabili $\vec a$, $\vec b$, uma $|\vec a|={na}$, $|\vec b|={nb}$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, liyini inani le-$|{ex}|^2$? (Loba izinombolo kuphela)
hints: Ngoba $|\vec x|^2=\vec x\cdot\vec x$, nweba i-dot product ye-${ex}$ nayo ngokwayo.
Yivezé ngo-$|\vec a|^2$, $|\vec b|^2$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ bese ufaka amanani.

geo_ellipseExtSum.prompt: Ake i-ellipse ${eq}$ ibe nephoyinti eliyi-focus elilodwa $F({fx},\ {fy})$, futhi iphoyinti eliphakathi kwe-ellipse libe ne-coordinates $A({xa},\ {ya})$. Lapho iphoyinti P le-ellipse lihamba, yini umkhiqizo wenani elikhulu kakhulu nelincane kakhulu le-$PA+PF$? (Loba izinombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma i-focus enye ibizwa ngokuthi F', $PF=2a-PF'$. Ngakho $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$.
Ku-triangle inequality, $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, futhi ngoba A ingaphakathi kwe-ellipse, zombili izimo zokulingana ziyenzeka.
geo_ellipseExtSum.explanation: Uma i-focus enye ingu-F', $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$ no-$a={a}$, $AF'={dd}$. Ngoba $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, inani elikhulu kakhulu ngu-$2a+AF'={mx}$, elincane kakhulu ngu-$2a-AF'={mn}$, futhi umkhiqizo ngu-${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFocal.prompt: Ake ama-focus amabili e-ellipse ${eq}$ abe ngu-F, F'. Uma iphoyinti P le-ellipse ${cond}$, liyini inani le-${ask}$? (Loba izinombolo kuphela)
hints: Isamba samabanga asuka endaweni e-ellipse aya kuma-focus womabili sihlala singashintshi, futhi inani laso lingubude be-major axis.
Uma ubude be-major axis bungu-$2a$ nebanga phakathi kuma-focus lingu-$2c$, $a={a}$, $c={c}$. Zama ukusebenzisa $PF+PF'=2a$.
geo_ellipseFocal.explanation: Ubude be-major axis $2a={tw}$, ibanga phakathi kuma-focus $2c={tc}$, ngakho $PF+PF'={tw}$, $FF'={tc}$. Ngoba ${work}$, inani elidingekayo ngu-${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFromEq.prompt: Liyini ibanga phakathi kuma-focus amabili e-ellipse ${eq}$? (Loba izinombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma wenza isibalo se-ellipse sibe yisimo se-$\frac{x^2}{\square}+\frac{y^2}{\square}=1$ ohlangothini lwesokudla olungu-$1$, esikhulu phakathi kwezihlukanisi ezimbili ngu-$a^2$.
Izihlukanisi ezimbili ngu-${a2}$ no-${b2}$, futhi $c^2=a^2-b^2$.
geo_ellipseFromEq.explanation: Uma kuvezwa ngesimo se-${std}$, $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, ngakho $c^2=a^2-b^2={c2}$, $c={c}$. Ibanga phakathi kuma-focus amabili ngu-$2c={ans}$.

geo_ellipseRightTri.prompt: Ake ama-focus amabili e-ellipse ${eq}$ abe ngu-F, F'. Uma iphoyinti P le-ellipse lenelisa $\angle FPF'=90^\circ$, yini indawo kanxantathu PFF'? (Loba izinombolo kuphela)
hints: Kuchaza kwe-ellipse, $PF+PF'=2a$, futhi ngoba unxantathu ulungile, $PF^2+PF'^2=(FF')^2$.
Sebenzisa $(PF+PF')^2=PF^2+PF'^2+2\,PF\cdot PF'$ ukuthola $PF\cdot PF'$.
geo_ellipseRightTri.explanation: $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, $c^2={c2}$, ngakho $PF+PF'=2a={tw}$, $FF'=2c={tc}$. $PF^2+PF'^2={tc2}$, ngakho $2\,PF\cdot PF'=({tw})^2-{tc2}$, okungukuthi $PF\cdot PF'={pr}$. Indawo ngu-$\frac{1}{2}\times PF\times PF'={ans}$.

geo_hyperAsym.prompt: Phakathi kwama-asymptote amabili e-hyperbola ${eq}$, uyini umthambeka womugqa onomthambeka oyiphozithivu? (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Ama-asymptote e-hyperbola $\frac{x^2}{a^2}-\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ ayi-$y=\pm\frac{b}{a}x$, e-$\frac{y^2}{a^2}-\frac{x^2}{b^2}=1$ ayi-$y=\pm\frac{a}{b}x$.
Uma uhlangothi lwesokudla lwesibalo lungeyona $1$, qala ulenze libe ngu-$1$, bese ufunda u-$a^2$, $b^2$ ezihlukanisini zika-$x^2$, $y^2$.
geo_hyperAsym.explanation: Ngoba ingaphansi kwesimo ${std}$, ama-asymptote ayi-${asy}$. Umthambeka we-asymptote enomthambeka oyiphozithivu ngu-${ansf}$.

geo_hyperFocal.prompt: Ake sithi izindawo zokugxila ezimbili ze-hyperbola ${eq}$ ziyi-F, F'. Uma iphoyinti P kuyi-hyperbola linalo ${cond}$, liyini inani lika-${ask}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ephoyintini elisehlathini le-hyperbola, inani eliphelele lomehluko wamabanga amabili ayizindawo zokugxila lilingana nobude be-eksisi enkulu $2a$.
Ngoba $a={a}$, $c={c}$, $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, futhi ibanga elisuka ephoyintini le-hyperbola liye endaweni ngayinye yokugxila lingu-$c-a={ca}$ noma ngaphezulu.
geo_hyperFocal.explanation: $a={a}$, $b={b}$, $c={c}$ futhi $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$. Lapho ${work}$, ngakho P likusebe eliseduze no-F futhi $PF'>PF$. (Uma $PF'=PF-2a$, ${alt}$ kuncane kuno-$c-a$, ngakho akunakwenzeka.) Ngakho ${work2}$, futhi inani elifunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

geo_hyperFocalRel.prompt: Ake sithi izindawo zokugxila ezimbili ze-hyperbola ${eq}$ ziyi-F, F'. Uma iphoyinti P kuyi-hyperbola linalo ${cond}$, liyini inani lika-${ask}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ephoyintini elisehlathini le-hyperbola, inani eliphelele lomehluko wamabanga amabili ayizindawo zokugxila lilingana nobude be-eksisi enkulu $2a$.
Ngoba $a={a}$, $c={c}$, $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, futhi ibanga elisuka ephoyintini le-hyperbola liye endaweni ngayinye yokugxila lingu-$c-a={ca}$ noma ngaphezulu.

geo_lineIntersectParam.prompt: Emkhathini, uma imigqa emibili ${l1}$, ${l2}$ ihlangana ephoyintini elilodwa, liyini inani lesingeniso $k$? (Bhala njengenombolo yonke. Uma iyinegethivu, engeza u--)
hints: Beka inani elifanayo lomugqa ngamunye njengo-$s$, $t$ bese uveza izixhumanisi zamaphoyinti emgqeni ngo-$s$, $t$.
Thola u-$s$, $t$ esibalweni sokuthi izixhumanisi ze-$x$, $y$ ziyalingana, bese uqhathanisa izixhumanisi ze-$z$.
geo_lineIntersectParam.explanation: Uma inani elifanayo lomugqa wokuqala lingu-$s$ nelomugqa wesibili lingu-$t$, izixhumanisi ze-$x$, $y$ kumele zilingane, ngakho ${xy}$, futhi ngokuxazulula $s={ss}$, $t={tt}$. Izixhumanisi ze-$z$ kumele zilingane, ngakho ${eq3}$ futhi $k={ans}$.

geo_lineSpacePoint.prompt: Phakathi kwamaphoyinti emgqeni ${ln}$, kunephoyinti elinalo ${cond}$. Siyini isamba sezixhumanisi ezimbili ezisele zalelo phoyinti? (Bhala njengenombolo yonke. Uma iyinegethivu, engeza u--)
hints: Uma inani elifanayo lezingxenyana ezintathu lingu-$s$, u-$x$, $y$, $z$ bonke bangavezwa ngo-$s$.
Qala uthole u-$s$ ngesimo esinikeziwe ${cond}$.
geo_lineSpacePoint.explanation: Uma inani elifanayo lingu-$s$, $(x,\ y,\ z)=({par})$. Ku-${cond}$, $s={ss}$, ngakho leli phoyinti ngu-${pt}$, futhi isamba sezixhumanisi ezimbili ezisele ngu-${ans}$.

geo_parFocusDir.prompt: Kuphoyinti $P(x,\ y)$ le-parabola enendawo yokugxila $F({fx},\ {fy})$ ne-directrix ${dirEq}$, uma ${cond}$, liyini inani eliphezulu lika-${un}$? (Bhala njengenombolo yonke. Uma iyinegethivu, engeza u--)
hints: Iphoyinti le-parabola linebanga elilinganayo eliye endaweni yokugxila nasemgqeni we-directrix.
Maphakathi kwendawo yokugxila ne-directrix kuyi-vertex. Qala ubhale i-equation ye-parabola ene-vertex $({vx},\ {vy})$ no-$p={pp}$.
geo_parFocusDir.explanation: Ngoba i-vertex ingu-$({vx},\ {vy})$ no-$p={pp}$, i-equation ye-parabola ingu-${eqn}$. Uma ${cond}$, ${un}={sol}$, ngakho inani eliphezulu lika-${un}$ ngu-${ans}$.

geo_parMinSum.prompt: Make i-focus ye-parabola ${eq}$ ibe ngu-F, futhi ukuxhumanisa kwephoyinti A kube ngu-$({xa},\ {ya})$. Lapho iphoyinti P elisebangeni lihamba, inani elincane kakhulu le-$PA+PF$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ibanga elisuka ephoyintini P elisebangeni liye ku-focus $PF$ lilingana nebanga elisuka ku-P liye ku-directrix.
Uma isendlalelo esiqonde ngqo esisuka ku-P siye ku-directrix siphela ku-H, i-$PA+PH$ incane kakhulu lapho u-A, P no-H beku-umugqa oqondile owodwa.
geo_parMinSum.explanation: I-directrix ngu-${dir}$. Njengoba iphoyinti A lingaphakathi kwe-parabola (${chk}$), uma isendlalelo esiqonde ngqo esisuka ku-P siye ku-directrix siphela ku-H, inani elincane kakhulu le-$PA+PF=PA+PH$ lilingana nebanga elisuka ku-A liye ku-directrix, elingu-${ans}$.

geo_planeNormal.prompt: Mayelana nephoyinti $A{pa}$, ipulani elidlula ku-A futhi eliqonde ngqo ku-vector $\vec n=({vn})$ lihlangana ne-eksisi ye-${ax}$ ephoyintini elinokuxhumanisa kwe-${ax}$ okuyini? (Ungabhala ngedesimali noma ngengxenyana efana no-3/4)
hints: Uma i-position vector yanoma yiliphi iphoyinti P elipulani ingu-$\vec p$, khona-ke $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$.
Qala ngokuthola ukulinganisa kwepulani $ax+by+cz=d$, bese usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi iphoyinti elise-eksisi ye-${ax}$ linokuxhumanisa okunye okubili okungu-$0$.
geo_planeNormal.explanation: Kuyo yonke iphoyinti P elipulani, $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$, ngakho ukulinganisa kwepulani ngu-${plane}$. Iphoyinti elise-eksisi ye-${ax}$ linokuxhumanisa okunye okubili okungu-$0$, ngakho ku-${solve}$ ukuxhumanisa kwe-${ax}$ ngu-${ans}$.

geo_projEllipse.prompt: Epulani $\alpha$ kunendingilizi enerediyasi engu-${rr}$. Uma le ndingilizi ifakwa ngokuqonda epulani $\beta$, kwakheka i-ellipse. Uma ukukhulu kwengelo eyakhiwa amapulani amabili $\alpha$ no-$\beta$ kungu-$\theta$ futhi $\cos\theta={cs}$, ibanga phakathi kwamafoki amabili e-ellipse liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ububanzi bendingilizi obuhambisana nomugqa wokuhlangana kwamapulani amabili abushintshi ubude, kodwa obuqonde ngqo buncipha ngo-$\cos\theta$.
Thola ubude be-major axis $2a$ nobe-minor axis $2b$ ye-ellipse efakiwe, bese ubala $c=\sqrt{a^2-b^2}$.
geo_projEllipse.explanation: Ubude be-major axis ye-ellipse efakiwe bungu-$2a=2\times {rr}$, nobe-minor axis bungu-$2b=2\times {rr}\cos\theta=2\times {bb}$, ngakho $a={rr}$, $b={bb}$. Ngenxa yokuthi $c=\sqrt{{rr}^2-{bb}^2}={cc}$, ibanga phakathi kwamafoki amabili ngu-$2c={ans}$.

geo_projPlaneArea.prompt: Indawo yesimo esingu-${ar}$ endaweni esepulani ${pl}$, uma sifakwa ngokuqonda epulani ${cp}$, iyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma ingelo eyakhiwa yipulani lesimo nepulani ${cp}$ ingu-$\theta$, indawo efakiwe ingu-(indawo yesimo)$\times\cos\theta$.

Ingelo $\theta$ phakathi kwamapulani amabili ithathwa ngu-$0^\circ\le\theta\le90^\circ$, ngakho $\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec n_1\cdot\vec n_2|}{|\vec n_1||\vec n_2|}$ (inani eliphelele le-dot product yama-normal vector amabili lihlukaniswe ngomphumela wobukhulu bawo).
geo_projPlaneArea.explanation: I-normal vector yepulani ${pl}$ ingu-$({nv})$ futhi ubukhulu bayo bungu-${nn}$. I-normal vector yepulani ${cp}$ ingu-$({cn})$, ngakho $\cos\theta=\frac{|{ns}|}{{nn}}=\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}$, futhi indawo efakiwe ngu-${ar}\times\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}={ans}$.

geo_spaceDist.prompt: Ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili $A{pa}$ no-$B{pb}$ esikhaleni sokuxhumanisa liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili $(x_1,\ y_1,\ z_1)$ no-$(x_2,\ y_2,\ z_2)$ esikhaleni sokuxhumanisa ngu-$\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2+(z_2-z_1)^2}$.
Qala ngokuthola umehluko wokuxhumanisa okuthathu.

geo_sphereExpand.prompt: Uma isibalo ${eq}$ simelela umkhakha onobude be-radius obungu-${rad}$, inani le-constant $s$ liyini? (Bhala i-integer. Uma ingaphansi kuka-0, faka u- -)
hints: Guqula i-$x$, $y$, $z$ ngayinye ibe yisikwele esiphelele ukuze uthole ifomu elingu-$(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2+(z-c)^2=r^2$.
Uhlangothi lwesokudla kumele lube yi-$r^2={rad2}$.
geo_sphereExpand.explanation: Ngokuguqula kube izikwele ezigcwele, ${std}$. Isikwele se-radius ngu-${s4}-s={rad2}$, ngakho $s={s4}-{rad2}={ans}$.

geo_sphereSection.prompt: Ingxenye yokusika yomkhakha ${eq}$ ngendiza ${pl}$ iyindilinga. Uma indawo yale ndilinga iyi-$m\pi$, inani lenombolo yemvelo $m$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Funda isikhungo nesikwele se-radius somkhakha esibalweni.
Uma uthola ibanga $d$ elisuka esikhungweni liye endizeni, i-radius $r$ yengxenye yokusika ihlangabezana ne-$r^2=R^2-d^2$.
geo_sphereSection.explanation: Isikhungo somkhakha singu-${cc}$, isikwele se-radius singu-$R^2={rr2}$. Ibanga elisuka esikhungweni liye endizeni ${pl}$ ngu-$d={dd}$, ngakho isikwele se-radius yendilinga yengxenye yokusika ngu-${rr2}-{dd}^2={ans}$ futhi indawo iyi-${ans}\pi$.

geo_sphereTangentPlane.prompt: Mayelana nendiza ${pl}$ ethinta umkhakha onesikhungo $C{cc}$ ne-radius engu-${rad}$, phakathi kwamanani e-constant $k$, elikhulu liyini? (Bhala i-integer. Uma ingaphansi kuka-0, faka u- -)
hints: Uma kuthinta, ibanga elisuka esikhungweni somkhakha liye endizeni lilingana ne-radius.
Ibanga eliphakathi kwephoyinti $(x_0,\ y_0,\ z_0)$ nendiza $ax+by+cz=k$ lingu-$\frac{|ax_0+by_0+cz_0-k|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}$.
geo_sphereTangentPlane.explanation: Ubude be-normal vector $({nv})$ bungu-${nn}$ futhi uma ufaka isikhungo esibalweni sendiza, ${dc}$. Ku-$\frac{|{dc}-k|}{{nn}}={rad}$, $|{dc}-k|={rl}$, ngakho $k={dc}\pm{rl}$, futhi inani elikhulu ngu-${ans}$.

geo_tangentAt.prompt: Indawo kanxantathu ezungezwe yi-tangent epoyinteni $P({x0},\ {y0})$ egophweni ${eq}$, nge-$x$-axis ne-$y$-axis, ingakanani? (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: I-tangent epoyinteni $(x_1,\ y_1)$ egophweni ingatholakala ngokushintsha $x^2\to x_1x$, $y^2\to y_1y$ (kwe-parabola, $y^2\to y_1y$, $x\to\frac{x+x_1}{2}$).
Thola i-$x$-intercept ne-$y$-intercept esibalweni se-tangent bese ubala $\frac{1}{2}\times|x\text{-intercept}|\times|y\text{-intercept}|$.
geo_tangentAt.explanation: Isibalo se-tangent ngu-${tan}$, i-$x$-intercept ngu-${xi}$, i-$y$-intercept ngu-${yi}$. Ngakho indawo ngu-$\frac{1}{2}\times|{xi}|\times|{yi}|={ansf}$.

geo_tangentsFromPoint.prompt: Isiphumo se-slope ze-tangent ezimbili ezidwetshwe zisuka epoyinteni $({x1},\ {y1})$ ziye egophweni ${eq}$ siyini? (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Vumela i-slope ye-tangent ibe yi-$m$ bese ufaka umugqa ${lnp}$ odlula epoyinteni $({x1},\ {y1})$ esibalweni segophe.
Esimweni sokuthinta (i-discriminant $=0$) kuvela isibalo se-quadratic ku-$m$, futhi ama-slope amabili ayizimpande ezimbili zalesi sibalo.
geo_tangentsFromPoint.explanation: Ngokufaka umugqa ${lnp}$ esibalweni segophe, i-discriminant yesibalo se-quadratic ku-$x$ kumele ibe yi-$0$, ngakho i-slope $m$ yezimpande ezimbili zesibalo ${quad}=0$. Ngobudlelwano bezimpande nama-coefficient, isiphumo se-slope ezimbili ngu-${prod}$.

geo_threePerp.prompt: Epoyinteni P engaphandle kwendiza $\alpha$, vumela unyawo lwe-perpendicular oluya ku-$\alpha$ luthiwe ngu-H, unyawo lwe-perpendicular esuka ku-H iya kumugqa $\ell$ ku-$\alpha$ luthiwe ngu-K, futhi ukhethe iphoyinti A ku-$\ell$ elihlukile ku-K. Vumela ibanga elisuka ku-P liye kumugqa $\ell$ libe yi-$d$. Uma ${giv}$, inani le-${ask}$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Njengoba $PH\perp\alpha$, $HK\perp\ell$, ngethiyori yama-perpendicular amathathu $PK\perp\ell$.
Sebenzisa ithiyori kaPythagoras ngokulandelana onxantathu abakhulunywe ngaphandle kwethiyori yama-perpendicular amathathu.
geo_threePerp.explanation: Njengoba $PH\perp\alpha$, $HK\perp\ell$, ngethiyori yama-perpendicular amathathu $PK\perp\ell$. ${work}$, ngakho inani elifunwayo ngu-${ans}$.

geo_vecCircleEq.prompt: Cabanga ngama-position vector wamaphoyinti $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ ngokulandelana njengo-$\vec a$, $\vec b$, futhi i-position vector yephoyinti P njengo-$\vec p$. Ubude be-radius yesiyingi esenziwa yawo wonke amaphoyinti P ayanelisa $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ bungakanani? (Ungabhala njengedesimali noma njengengxenyana efana no-3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ kusho ukuthi ama-vector amabili $\vec p-\vec a$, $\vec p-\vec b$ ama-perpendicular.
Liyini inani le-engeli elibuka isigaba u-AB ukusuka ephoyintini P?
geo_vecCircleEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ kusho ukuthi P isesiyingini elinesigaba u-AB njengobubanzi balo. Ngoba $AB={ab}$, ubude be-radius bungu-$\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

geo_vecSphereEq.prompt: Cabanga ngama-position vector wamaphoyinti $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ ngokulandelana njengo-$\vec a$, $\vec b$, futhi i-position vector yephoyinti P njengo-$\vec p$. Ubude be-radius yesigaba esenziwa yawo wonke amaphoyinti P ayanelisa $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ bungakanani? (Ungabhala njengedesimali noma njengengxenyana efana no-3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ kusho ukuthi ama-vector amabili $\vec p-\vec a$, $\vec p-\vec b$ ama-perpendicular.
Ingubo lingakanani i-engeli elibuka isigaba u-AB ukusuka ephoyintini P?
geo_vecSphereEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ kusho ukuthi P iku-sphere elinesigaba u-AB njengobubanzi balo. Ngoba $AB={ab}$, ubude be-radius bungu-$\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

geo_vecDecompose.prompt: Uma $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, $\vec c={vc}$, inani le-${ask}$ liyini kwezinombolo ezingempela $m$, $n$ ezenza $\vec c=m\vec a+n\vec b$? (Ungabhala njengedesimali noma njengengxenyana efana no-3/4)
hints: Bonisa izingxenye ze-$m\vec a+n\vec b$ ngo-$m$, $n$ bese uzibeka zilingane nezingxenye ze-$\vec c$.
Xazulula uhlelo lwezibalo ngo-$m$, $n$ olutholakala ezingxenyeni zombili.

geo_vecDotParam.prompt: Uma ama-vector amabili $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ anga-$\vec a\cdot\vec b={dd}$, ngubani omkhulu kunawo wonke amanani engempela $t$? (Bhala njengenombolo ephelele. Uma ingaphansi kwezero, engeza -)
hints: Phindaphinda izingxenye bese uzengeza ukubonisa u-$\vec a\cdot\vec b$ njengesisho ngo-$t$.
Xazulula i-equation etholakele ukuze uthole wonke amanani ka-$t$, bese ukhetha elikhulu kunawo wonke.
geo_vecDotParam.explanation: Ngoba $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, izixazululo ze-equation ${dexp}={dd}$ zingu-${sol}$. Inani elikhulu kunawo wonke kulawa ngu-${ans}$.

geo_vecLinComb.prompt: Uma $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, inani le-$|{ex}|$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Isamba nokuphindaphindwa ngenombolo engempela kwama-vector kubalwa ngezingxenye.
Qala uthole izingxenye ze-${ex}$, bese uthola impande yesikwele ephozithivu yesamba samasikwele ezingxenye.

geo_vecOrthoParam.prompt: Uma ama-vector amabili $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ ma-perpendicular, inani le-$t$ elingempela liyini? (Bhala njengenombolo ephelele. Uma ingaphansi kwezero, engeza -)
hints: I-dot product yama-vector amabili ama-perpendicular ngu-$0$.
Phindaphinda izingxenye bese uzengeza ukubonisa u-$\vec a\cdot\vec b$ njengesisho ngo-$t$.
geo_vecOrthoParam.explanation: Ngoba ama-vector ama-perpendicular, $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$. Ngoba $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, uma uxazulula i-equation ${dexp}=0$ uthola ${sol}$.

job_boxTunnel.prompt: Kublokhi lokhuni elinomumo wegobolondo olunobubanzi ${a}$ cm, ubude ${b}$ cm nokuphakama ${c}$ cm, kubhowe umgodi onjengegobolondo olunobubanzi ${p}$ cm nobude ${q}$ cm, uqonde kusuka maphakathi nendawo engenhla uze ufike endaweni engezansi (umgodi awuthinti izinhlangothi zebhlokhi). Uma kubalwa nendawo yangaphakathi yomgodi endaweni engaphezulu, indawo engaphezulu yebhlokhi enomgodi ingu-cm² ongakanani? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma kubhowa umgodi, indawo engenhla neyangaphansi inciphisa ngokufana nesigaba somgodi.
Esikhundleni salokho, kwakheka izinhlangothi ezine zangaphakathi zomgodi.
job_boxTunnel.explanation: Indawo engaphezulu ngaphambi kokubhoba ngu-$2({a}\times{b}+{b}\times{c}+{c}\times{a})={s0}$ cm². Susa ${p}\times{q}$ kabili endaweni engenhla neyangaphansi, wengeze izinhlangothi zangaphakathi $2({p}+{q})\times{c}$, kuba ${s0}-{pq2}+{inn}={ans}$ cm².

job_boxesCeil.prompt: Izingxenye ezingu-${n}$ zipakishwa ngezingu-${k}$ ebhokisini linye, bese amabhokisi ethwalwa ngezingu-${m}$ epaletini linye. Noma kusele izingxenye, zifakwa ebhokisini linye, futhi noma kusele amabhokisi, afakwa epaletini linye. Kudingeka amapaleti amangaki okungenani? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma kungahlukaniseki ngokuphelele, kudingeka ibhokisi (ipaleti) elilodwa elengeziwe lokuthwala okusele.
Qala ngokuthola inani lamabhokisi adingekayo, bese uthola inani lamapaleti ngendlela efanayo.
job_boxesCeil.explanation: Amabhokisi adingekayo angu-${bx}$, okuyinani elijikelezwe phezulu le-${n}\div{k}$, namapaleti adingekayo angu-${ans}$, okuyinani elijikelezwe phezulu le-${bx}\div{m}$.

job_chanceDraw.prompt: Ebhokisini kunezingxenye ezingu-${n}$, okuyizingu-${d}$ ezonakele. Uma kukhishwa izingxenye ezi-2 ngokungahleliwe ngasikhathi sinye, yini ithuba lokuthi okungenani ezi-1 zonakele? (Bhala ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njalo. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Inani lawo wonke amathuba ukukhipha liyinani lezindlela zokukhetha ezi-2 kwezingu-${n}$.
Okuphambene ne-'okungenani ezi-1 zonakele' ukuthi 'zombili zilungile'.
job_chanceDraw.explanation: Wonke amathuba angu-$_{{n}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={tot}$, kanti amathuba lapho zombili zilungile angu-$_{{g}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={good}$. Ithuba elifunwayo ngu-$1-\frac{{good}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

job_floorPlan.prompt: Igumbi elimise okwexande linobubanzi obungu-${a}$ m nobude obungu-${b}$ m. Ohlangothini olulodwa lodonga olubanzi, maphakathi, kunendawo emise okwexande enobubanzi obungu-${d}$ m nokujula okungu-${c}$ m ebhekise ngaphandle (${d}<{a}$ futhi ayithinti amakona egumbi). Kunamathiselwa i-skirting ngaphakathi kuwo wonke amawa egumbi, kodwa hhayi lapho kuyisango elinobubanzi obungu-${w}$ m. Ubude be-skirting edingekayo bungu-m bokungakanani? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Cabanga ngokudweba ukuthi indilinga yesimo esinendawo enamathiselwe yehlukile kanjani kweyexande.
Uhlangothi olulodwa olunobubanzi obungu-${d}$ m luyanyamamba, kodwa kwakheka izinhlangothi ezimbili ezijulile ${c}$ m nolunye olunobubanzi obungu-${d}$ m.
job_floorPlan.explanation: Indilinga iyonke yegumbi ingu-$2({a}+{b})+2\times{c}={per}$ m (ngoba uhlangothi olunobubanzi obungu-${d}$ m lushintshwa izinhlangothi ezimbili ezingu-${c}$ m nolunye olungu-${d}$ m, ngakho inyuka ngezinhlangothi ezimbili ezingu-${c}$ m). Uma kususwa isango elingu-${w}$ m, kuba ${per}-{w}={ans}$ m.

job_flowUnits.prompt: Ku-nozzle yomshini wamanzi kuphuma amanzi angu-${r}$ mL ngomzuzu ngokungaguquki. Uma le nozzle ishiywa ivuliwe amahora angu-${h}$ nemizuzu engu-${m}$, kuphuma amanzi angu-L amangaki sekukonke? (1 L = 1000 mL, bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Guqula isikhathi sonke sibe yimizuzu ukuze uthole isikhathi ekuvulwe ngaso.
Thola ama-mL nge-(inani ngomzuzu)×(imizuzu), bese wehlukanisa ngo-1000 ukuze uthole ama-L.
job_flowUnits.explanation: Isikhathi sokuvuleka singu-${h}\times60+{m}={tot}$ imizuzu, namanzi aphumile angu-${r}\times{tot}={ml}$ mL. ${ml}\div1000={ans}$ L.

job_markupProfit.prompt: Esitolo, into engulu yenani lokuthenga elingu-${c}$ yenziwa inani lokuthengisa ngokufaka inzuzo engu-${u}$% yenani lokuthenga, bese kunikezwa isaphulelo esingu-${d}$% senani lokuthengisa, kwathengiswa zonke izingu-${n}$. Inzuzo iyonke ngokuphathelene nenani lokuthenga ingu-won engakanani? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Inani lokuthengisa lingu-$(100+{u})$% lenani lokuthenga.
Inani lokuthengisa ngokweqiniso lingu-$(100-{d})$% lenani lokuthengisa, futhi inzuzo yento eyodwa ngu-(inani lokuthengisa)−(inani lokuthenga).
job_markupProfit.explanation: Inani lokuthengisa lingu-${c}\times\frac{{100+u}}{100}={lp}$ won, inani lokuthengisa ngokweqiniso lingu-${lp}\times\frac{{100-d}}{100}={sp}$ won. Inzuzo eyodwa ingu-${sp}-{c}={g}$ won, ngakho inzuzo yezingu-${n}$ ingu-${g}\times{n}={ans}$ won.

job_outfitCount.prompt: Kunezigcawu zengubo yomsebenzi eziyi-${s}$ nezingubo zangaphansi eziyi-${p}$, futhi kunamakepisi ayi-${h}$. Kukhethwa isigcawu esisodwa nesingubo sangaphansi esisodwa, futhi ikepisi lingakhethwa elilodwa kwayi-${h}$ noma kungagqokwa lutho. Uma kunamabhangqa (isigcawu, isingubo sangaphansi) angu-${f}$ okungavunyelwe ukuthi agqokwe ndawonye ngenxa yemithetho yezokuphepha, zingaba zingaki izingubo ezihlukene ezingagqokwa? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala ngokuthola inani lamabhangqa (isigcawu, isingubo sangaphansi) angagqokwa.
Bala ukuthi zingaki izindlela zokukhetha ikepisi elilodwa kwayi-${h}$ noma ukungagqoki, bese uyaphindaphinda.
job_outfitCount.explanation: Amabhangqa (isigcawu, isingubo sangaphansi) angu-${s}\times{p}-{f}={ok}$, futhi izindlela zekepisi, kubalwa nokungagqoki, ziyi-${h}+1={hh}$. Ngomthetho wokuphindaphinda, ${ok}\times{hh}={ans}$.

job_planCompare.prompt: Uhlelo A lunentela eyisisekelo yenyanga engu-${f1}$ won kanye no-${p1}$ won ngokusetshenziswa ngakunye, kanti uhlelo B lunentela eyisisekelo yenyanga engu-${f2}$ won kanye no-${p2}$ won ngokusetshenziswa ngakunye. Uma inani lokusetshenziswa enyangeni kungu-$x$ ($x$ iyinombolo yemvelo), yiliphi inani elincane kakhulu lika-$x$ lapho inkokhelo yenyanga yohlelo B iba ngaphansi kweyohlelo A? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Veza inkokhelo yenyanga yohlelo ngalunye njengesisho sika-$x$.
Xazulula ukungalingani (inkokhelo ka-B)<(inkokhelo ka-A) ukuze uthole ibanga lika-$x$.
job_planCompare.explanation: Inkokhelo ka-A ngu-${f1}+{p1}x$, kanti eka-B ngu-${f2}+{p2}x$. Ku-${f2}+{p2}x<{f1}+{p1}x$ sithola ${dl}x>{df}$, okungukuthi $x>\frac{{df}}{{dl}}$. Inombolo yemvelo encane kakhulu egcwalisa lokhu ngu-${ans}$.

job_ratioChain.prompt: Isilinganiso sokukhiqizwa kwansuku zonke kwezigaba ezintathu A, B, C ngu-A : B $={a}:{b}$, B : C $={c}:{d}$. Uma ingqikithi yokukhiqizwa kwansuku zonke kwezigaba ezintathu ingu-${T}$, kukhiqizwa zingaki nsuku zonke esigabeni C? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Xhuma izilinganiso ezimbili usebenzisa u-B njengesisekelo ukuze wenze u-A : B : C.
Hlukanisa ingqikithi engu-${T}$ ngesamba sika-A : B : C ukuze uthole usayizi wengxenye eyodwa.
job_ratioChain.explanation: Ngemva kokulinganisa inani lika-B, A : B : C $={pa}:{pb}:{pc}$. Isamba sesilinganiso ngu-${S}$, ngakho ingxenye eyodwa ingu-${T}\div{S}={u}$, futhi u-C ungu-${pc}\times{u}={ans}$.

job_scaleDrawing.prompt: Kudrowingi onesikali esingu-$1:{k}$, igumbi elimise okunxande lidwetshwe linobubanzi obungu-${w}$ cm nobude obungu-${h}$ cm. Yiyiphi indawo yangempela yegumbi ngama-m²? (1 m = 100 cm, futhi bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma isikali singu-$1:{k}$, phindaphinda ubude bedrowingi ngo-${k}$ ukuze uthole ubude bangempela.
Thola ububanzi nobude bangempela nge-cm, bese ubuguqulela ku-m bese uyaphindaphinda.
job_scaleDrawing.explanation: Ububanzi bangempela ngu-${w}\times{k}={rw}$ cm$={rwm}$ m, nobude bangempela ngu-${h}\times{k}={rh}$ cm$={rhm}$ m, ngakho indawo ngu-${rwm}\times{rhm}={ans}$ m².

job_tableRule.prompt: Leli ithebula lezindleko zokuqasha impahla. Njalo ihora lilodwa elengeziwe, inkokhelo yenyuka ngenani elilinganayo. Amahora angu-${x1}$ ngu-${y1}$ won, amahora angu-${x2}$ ngu-${y2}$ won, namahora angu-${x3}$ ngu-${y3}$ won. Iyini inkokhelo yokuqasha amahora angu-${N}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ethebulani, thola ukuthi inkokhelo inyuka ngobungakanani obungakanani lapho kwengezwa ihora elilodwa.
Veza inkokhelo ngendlela ethi (inani elinyuka ihora ngalinye)×(amahora)+(inani eliyisisekelo) ukuze uthole inani eliyisisekelo.
job_tableRule.explanation: Ngoba inyuka ngo-${k}$ won ihora ngalinye, inkokhelo ithatha uhlobo $y={k}x+{b}$ (inani eliyisisekelo elingu-${b}$ won lithola ngokuthi amahora angu-${x1}$ abe ngu-${y1}$ won). Amahora angu-${N}$ ngu-${k}\times{N}+{b}={ans}$ won.

job_workTogether.prompt: Isisebenzi A senza imikhiqizo engu-${a}$ ngehora ngesivinini esilinganayo, kanti isisebenzi B senza engu-${b}$ ngehora. U-A uqala umsebenzi kuqala, futhi u-B ujoyina emva kwamahora angu-${h}$. Kuze kube yilapho inani eliphelele lemikhiqizo eyenziwe yibo bobabili lifinyelela ngqo ku-${N}$, u-A usebenze amahora amangaki ngesamba? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma u-A esebenze amahora angu-$t$, u-B usebenze amahora angu-$t-{h}$.
Misa ukulingana komugqa othi (inani elenziwe ngu-A)+(inani elenziwe ngu-B)$={N}$.
job_workTogether.explanation: Uma u-A esebenza amahora angu-$t$, u-B usebenza amahora angu-$t-{h}$, ngakho ${a}t+{b}(t-{h})={N}$. Ngokuhlela, ${ab}t={tot}$, ngakho $t={ans}$ amahora.

pst_atLeast.prompt: Uma kukhishwa amabhola angu-${k}$ ngasikhathi sinye esikhwameni esinamabhola amhlophe angu-${w}$ namabhola amnyama angu-${bk}$, thola ukuthi ithuba lokuthi kuphume amabhola amhlophe angu-${r}$ noma ngaphezulu liyini. (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Isehlakalo esiphikisayo se-'${r}$ noma ngaphezulu' yilapho inani lamabhola amhlophe lingu-${zs}$.
Inani eliphelele lezindlela zokukhipha ngu-$\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$.
pst_atLeast.explanation: Isehlakalo esiphikisayo yilapho inani lamabhola amhlophe lingu-${zs}$ futhi inani lezindlela zalo ngu-${bx}={bad}$. Inani eliphelele ngu-$\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$, ngakho ithuba elifunwayo ngu-$1-\frac{{bad}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

pst_bayes.prompt: Idayisi elinobulungisa liphonswa kanye; uma kuphuma amachashaza angu-${t}$ noma ngaphansi, ibhola elilodwa likhishwa ebhokisini A, uma kungenjalo, ebhokisini B. Ibhokisi A linamabhola amhlophe angu-${w1}$ namabhola amnyama angu-${b1}$, ibhokisi B linamabhola amhlophe angu-${w2}$ namabhola amnyama angu-${b2}$. Uma ibhola elikhishiwe liyibhola elimhlophe, thola ithuba lokuthi lisuka ebhokisini A. (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: $P(A\mid \text{ibhola elimhlophe})=\frac{P(A\cap \text{ibhola elimhlophe})}{P(\text{ibhola elimhlophe})}$.
Isihlukanisi yisamba sethuba lokuthi libe yibhola elimhlophe lisuka ku-A nethuba lokuthi libe yibhola elimhlophe lisuka ku-B.
pst_bayes.explanation: Ithuba lokuthi libe yibhola elimhlophe lisuka ku-A ngu-${tA}$, nelokuthi libe yibhola elimhlophe lisuka ku-B ngu-${tB}$, ngakho ithuba elifunwayo ngu-$\frac{{tA}}{{tA}+{tB}}={fr}$.

pst_bestOf.prompt: Amaqembu amabili A, B adlala imidlalo, futhi iqembu elinqoba kuqala imidlalo engu-${w}$ liyawina. Kumdlalo ngamunye ithuba lokuthi iqembu A linqobe ngu-${fp}$, imidlalo ayiboshelene, futhi ayikho into enjengokulingana. Thola ithuba lokuthi iqembu A liwine. (Bhala njengengxenyana engaguquki. Uma iyi-integer, bhala i-integer. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Cabanga ngokwehlukanisa ngokuthi ukunqoba kwesi-${w}$ kweqembu A kwenzeka emdlalweni wesingaki.
Ukuze liwine emdlalweni wesi-${w}+j$, kumele ngaphambi kwalokho kube nokunqoba okungu-${wm1}$ nokwehlulwa okungu-$j$ emidlalweni engu-${wm1}+j$.
pst_bestOf.explanation: Ithuba lokuthi iqembu A liwine emdlalweni wesi-${w}+j$ ($j={jr}$) ngu-$\binom{{wm1}+j}{j}\left({fp}\right)^{{w}}\left(1-{fp}\right)^{j}$. Lamanani ngokulandelana angu-${tm}$, ngakho isamba sawo sonke ngu-${fr}$.

pst_binomCoef2.prompt: Thola i-coefficient ye-$x^{{k}}$ ekunwetshweni kwe-$({ax}{bs})^{{n}}$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Igama elijwayelekile le-binomial theorem linefomu elingu-$\binom{N}{j}A^{N-j}B^{j}$.
Thola igama lapho i-$x$ iphindaphindwa izikhathi ezingu-${k}$.
pst_binomCoef2.explanation: Njengoba kuyigama lapho i-$x$ ikhethwa izikhathi ezingu-${k}$ futhi igama elingaguquki likhethwa izikhathi ezingu-${nk}$, i-coefficient ngu-$\binom{{n}}{{k}}\cdot{a}^{{k}}\cdot({b})^{{nk}}={ans}$.

pst_binomFindN.prompt: Uma okuguquguqukayo okungahleliwe $X$ kulandela i-binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$ futhi $E(X)={mu}$, $V(X)={vr}$, thola inani le-$n$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma uhlukanisa i-$V(X)$ nge-$E(X)$ uthola i-$1-p$.

pst_binomNormal.prompt: Okuguquguqukayo okungahleliwe $X$ kulandela i-binomial distribution $B({n},\ {pf})$. Ngokulinganisa i-$X$ nge-normal distribution (ungenzi ukulungiswa kokuqhubeka), thola inani le-$P({ev})$. Kokuguquguqukayo okungahleliwe $Z$ okulandela i-standard normal distribution, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Bhala kuze kube yindawo yesine yedesimali)
hints: I-binomial distribution $B(n,\ p)$ ingalinganiswa nge-$N(np,\ np(1-p))$ uma i-$n$ inkulu.
Yenza i-standardization ngo-(isilinganiso, i-standard deviation)=$({mu},\ {sg})$.
pst_binomNormal.explanation: $E(X)={mu}$, $\sigma(X)=\sqrt{{vr}}={sg}$, ngakho i-$X$ ilandela cishe i-$N({mu},\ {sg}^{2})$. Uma yenza i-standardization nge-$Z=\frac{X-{mu}}{{sg}}$, ${zs}$, ngakho $P({ev})\approx P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_binomPmfEq.prompt: Uma ishintshane engahleliwe $X$ ilandela ukusatshalaliswa kwe-binomial $B({n},\ p)$ futhi $P(X={r})=P(X={r1})$, thola inani lika-$p$. (Lapho $0<p<1$) (Libhale njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, libhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isib.: 3/4)
hints: Bhala amathuba amabili ngendlela $\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ bese uhlukanisa amaceleni womabili ngesici esivamile.
Uma wenza lula, uthola inani lika-$\frac{p}{1-p}$.
Ku-binomial theorem $(1+x)^{N}=\sum_{k=0}^{N}\binom{N}{k}x^{k}$, faka inombolo efanele esikhundleni sika-$x$.
Nquma inani lika-$x$ ukuze $(1+x)^{N}$ lilingane nesamba.

pst_binomTail.prompt: Uma ishintshane engahleliwe $X$ ilandela ukusatshalaliswa kwe-binomial $B({n},\ {pf})$, thola inani lika-$P(X{rel}{t})$. (Libhale njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, libhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isib.: 3/4)
hints: $P(X=j)=\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ ($N$ inani lezimzamo). Uma kunamatemu amaningi okwengeza, cabanga ngesehlakalo esiphambene.
Hlanganisa amatemu lapho $j=$ ${js}$.
pst_binomTail.explanation: $P(X=j)=\binom{{n}}{j}\left({pf}\right)^{j}\left(1-{pf}\right)^{{n}-j}$, futhi ithuba elifunwayo isamba samanani wonke lapho $j={js}$, okungu-$\frac{{tm}}{{D}}=\frac{{num}}{{D}}={fe}$.

pst_binomUnknown.prompt: Ekunweneni kwe-$(x+a)^{{n}}$, uma i-coefficient ka-$x^{{k}}$ ingu-${V}$, thola inani lika-$a$ elihle. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Veza i-coefficient ka-$x^{{k}}$ usebenzisa u-$a$.
Njengoba $\binom{{n}}{{k}}={C}$, qala uthole inani lika-$a^{{nk}}$.

pst_ciBounds.prompt: Isampula yobukhulu ${n}$ ikhethwe ngokungahleliwe kubantu abalandela ukusatshalaliswa okujwayelekile okune-standard deviation yabantu engu-${s}$, futhi isilinganiso sesampula sasingu-${xb}$. Uma isikhawu sokuzethemba sokulinganisa isilinganiso sabantu $m$ ngezinga lokuzethemba elingu-${cl}\%$ singu-$a\le m\le b$, thola inani lika-$b$. (Inani elihambisana nezinga lokuzethemba elingu-${cl}\%$ ngu-$z={z}$.) (Libhale njengedesimali)
hints: Isikhawu sokuzethemba singu-$\overline{x}-z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\le m\le \overline{x}+z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.
Njengoba $\sqrt{{n}}={rt}$, qala uthole $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.

pst_ciSampleSize.prompt: Isampula ikhethwa ngokungahleliwe kubantu abalandela ukusabalalisa okujwayelekile onokuphambuka okujwayelekile kwabantu okungu-${s}$. Uma kulinganiselwa isilinganiso sabantu ngezinga lokuthembela elingu-${cl}\%$, thola inani elincane kakhulu lobungako besampula $n$ ukuze ubude besikhathi sokuzethemba bube ${L}$ noma ngaphansi. (Inani elihambisana nezinga lokuthembela elingu-${cl}\%$ ngu-$z={z}$, futhi $n$ iyinombolo yemvelo.) (Loba izinombolo kuphela)
hints: Ubude besikhathi sokuzethemba bungu-$2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Xazulula lokhu kungalingani ku-$\sqrt{n}$ bese ufaka isikwele ezinhlangothini zombili. $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$
pst_ciSampleSize.explanation: Ubude besikhathi sokuzethemba bungu-$2\times{z}\times\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$, ngakho-ke $\sqrt{n}\ge\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}$, okungukuthi $n\ge\left(\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}\right)^{2}{eq}{nq}$. Inombolo yemvelo encane kakhulu eneliseka yile ${ans}$.

pst_condDice.prompt: Ake sijikijele amadayisi amabili alungile futhi ahlukene ngesikhathi esisodwa, bese siqamba izinombolo eziphumile ngokulandelana ngokuthi $a,\ b$. Uma umcimbi $A$ ungu-'$a+b{rel}{t}$' futhi umcimbi $B$ ungu-'$a{relb}b$', thola amathuba anemibandela $P(B\mid A)$. (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala ngokuthola zonke izimo ezikumcimbi $A$.
$P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$.
pst_condDice.explanation: Inani lezimo zomcimbi $A$ yi-${nA}$, futhi inani lezimo ze-$A\cap B$ yi-${nAB}$. Ngakho $P(B\mid A)={fe}$.

pst_condTable.prompt: Kubafundi abangu-${N}$ eqenjini elithile, abafana bangu-${m}$, abafake izibuko bangu-${g}$, futhi abafana abafake izibuko bangu-${x}$. Uma kukhethwa umuntu oyedwa ngokungahleliwe eqenjini futhi engafakanga izibuko, thola amathuba okuthi lowo mfundi ube yintombazane. (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Enza ithebula ugcwalise amaseli amane: abafana/amantombazane, abafake izibuko/abangafakanga.
Ku-$P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$, $A$ ukuthi 'akafakanga izibuko'.
pst_condTable.explanation: Amantombazane angu-${f}$ futhi amantombazane afake izibuko angu-${g}-{x}={gy}$, ngakho amantombazane angafakanga izibuko angu-${f}-{gy}={fn}$. Abafundi abangafakanga izibuko bangu-${N}-{g}={ng}$, ngakho amathuba angu-${fe}$.

pst_deMorgan.prompt: Ngemicimbi emibili $A,\ B$, uma ${gv}$, thola inani le-$P({ev})$. (Loba njengedesimali)
hints: Dweba umdwebo kaVenn uhlukanise ube yizifunda ezine: $A\cap B$, $A\cap B^{c}$, $A^{c}\cap B$, $A^{c}\cap B^{c}$.
$P(A\cap B^{c})=P(A)-P(A\cap B)$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)=P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Ungasebenzisa nomthetho kaDe Morgan $(A\cup B)^{c}=A^{c}\cap B^{c}$, $(A\cap B)^{c}=A^{c}\cup B^{c}$ kanye no-$P(E^{c})=1-P(E)$.
