pst_deMorgan.explanation: $P(A\cap B)$ ngu-${der}$. Amathuba ezifunda ezine angu-$P(A\cap B)={pab}$, $P(A\cap B^{c})={ao}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)={bo}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B^{c})={ne}$, futhi isamba singu-$1$. $P({ev})$ yisamba sezifunda ezifanele, ngakho ngu-${sumx}$.

pst_diceQuad.prompt: Idayisi elungile elinamachashazi ku-$1$ kuya ku-${s}$ lijikijelwa kabili, izinombolo eziphumile ngokulandelana zingu-$a,\ b$. Thola amathuba okuthi isibalo se-quadratic $x^{2}-{pa}x+{qb}=0$ sibe nezimpande ezimbili zangempela ezihlukene. (Loba ngengxenyana engenakwehliswa. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, yiloba njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Umbandela wokuba nezimpande ezimbili zangempela ezihlukene ngukuthi i-discriminant $D>0$.
$D={d1}-4\times{qb}$, bese ukhetha $a$ ngamunye uthi ubale ama-$b$ afanelekile.
pst_diceQuad.explanation: Imibhangqo $(a,\ b)$ eneliseka i-discriminant $D={d1}-4\times{qb}>0$ ingu-${cnt}$ kuyonke ${tot}$, ngakho amathuba angu-${fe}$.

pst_diceSum.prompt: Amadayisi amabili alungile, ngalinye linamehlo kusukela ku-$1$ kuya ku-${s}$, ajikijelwa ngesikhathi esisodwa, futhi izinombolo zamehlo ziyi-$a,\ b$. Thola ithuba lokuthi $a+b{rel}{t}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Uma amadayisi amabili ehlukaniswa, inani lazo zonke izimo ngu-${s}\times{s}$.
Shintsha u-$a$ kusukela ku-$1$ kuya ku-${s}$, ubale inani lika-$b$ ogcwalisa isimo, bese uzengeza.
pst_diceSum.explanation: Zonke izimo zingu-${tot}$ futhi ama-$(a,\ b)$ agcwalisa isimo angu-${cnt}$. Ngakho ithuba lingu-${fe}$.

pst_expectTable.prompt: Okuguquguqukayo okungahleliwe $X$ kungathatha amanani $1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$ futhi $P(X=x)=k(x+{c})$ ($x=1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$). Thola inani lesilinganiso $E(X)$ sika-$X$. (Lapho $k$ iyisingeniso.) (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthole u-$k$ ngesimo sokuthi isamba samathuba sonke singu-$1$.
$E(X)=\sum x\,P(X=x)$.
pst_expectTable.explanation: Ngoba isamba samathuba sonke singu-$1$, $k({t1})={S1}k=1$, okungukuthi $k=\frac{1}{{S1}}$. $E(X)=\frac{1}{{S1}}({t2})=\frac{1}{{S1}}\times{S2}={fe}$.

pst_indepFindN.prompt: Emakhadini angu-$n$ abhalwe izinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-$1$ kuya ku-$n$ ngayinye, uma kudonswa ikhadi elilodwa ngokungahleliwe, ake sithi isigameko $A$ ngu-'inombolo yekhadi iyisiphindaphindo sika-${p}$' nesigameko $B$ ngu-'inombolo yekhadi iyisiphindaphindo sika-${q}$'. Phakathi kwezinombolo zemvelo $n$ lapho $2\le n\le {M}$, thola inani elikhulu kakhulu lika-$n$ elenza izigameko $A,\ B$ zizimele. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma zizimele, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, futhi $A\cap B$ iyisiphindaphindo sika-${l}$. Uma kuneziphindaphindo ezingu-$a$ zika-${p}$, ezingu-$b$ zika-${q}$, nezingu-$c$ zika-${l}$, isimo sokuzimela singu-$ab=cn$.
Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma u-$n$ eyisiphindaphindo sika-${l}$.
pst_indepFindN.explanation: Uma $n={l}t$ ($t$ iyinombolo yemvelo), $P(A)=\frac{1}{{p}}$, $P(B)=\frac{1}{{q}}$, $P(A\cap B)=\frac{1}{{l}}$, ngakho zizimele. Esiphindaphindweni sika-${l}$ esingedluli ku-${M}$, esikhulu kakhulu singu-${ans}$. Ku-$n$ omkhulu kunaleli, uma kuneziphindaphindo ezingu-$a$ zika-${p}$, ezingu-$b$ zika-${q}$, nezingu-$c$ zika-${l}$, hlola ukuthi isimo sokuzimela $\frac{c}{n}=\frac{a}{n}\cdot\frac{b}{n}$, okungukuthi $ab=cn$, siyagcwaliseka yini. Ngoba ${chk}$, azizimele. Ngakho ngu-${ans}$.

pst_indepUnknown.prompt: Izigameko ezimbili $A,\ B$ zizimele futhi $P(A)={fa}$, $P(A\cup B)={fu}$. Thola inani lika-$P(B)$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Uma zizimele, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$.
Hlela ithiyori yokungeza $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$ ibe yisibalo sika-$P(B)$.
pst_indepUnknown.explanation: Ngoba zizimele, $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$, okungukuthi $P(B)\{1-P(A)\}=P(A\cup B)-P(A)$. Ngoba $1-{fa}={d1}$, ${fu}-{fa}={d2}$, $P(B)={d2}\div{d1}={fr}$.

pst_latticePath.prompt: Emapulaneni okuxhumanisa, ezindleleni ezimfushane kusukela ephoyintini $(0,\ 0)$ kuya ephoyintini $({m},\ {n})$ ezihamba isinyathelo esisodwa kuphela kwesokudla noma phezulu, zingaki izindlela ezingedluli ephoyintini $\mathrm{P}({p},\ {q})$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Bala inani lezindlela zonke usebenzisa ukuhlela okunezinto ezifanayo. Ezingedluli = zonke - ezidlulayo.
Izindlela ezidlula ephoyintini $\mathrm{P}$ zibalwa njenge-(kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ku-$\mathrm{P}$)×(kusuka ku-$\mathrm{P}$ kuya ekugcineni).
pst_latticePath.explanation: Izindlela zonke zingu-${tot}$. Kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ku-$\mathrm{P}$ ziyi-${via1}$, kusukela ku-$\mathrm{P}$ kuya ekugcineni ziyi-${via2}$, ngakho ezidlula ku-$\mathrm{P}$ ziyi-${via1}\times{via2}={via}$. Ngakho ${tot}-{via}={ans}$.

pst_linTransform.prompt: Uma isilinganiso se-random variable $X$ singu-${m}$ futhi i-standard deviation ingu-${s}$, thola inani le-$E(Y^{2})$ lapho i-random variable $Y={ya}$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Sebenzisa $E(Y)=aE(X)+b$ no-$V(Y)=a^{2}V(X)$.

pst_lineUp.prompt: Uma abafana abangu-${m}$ namantombazane angu-${w}$ bemi emgqeni owodwa, thola ithuba lokuthi awekho amantombazane amabili ame eduze komunye nomunye. (Bhala ngengxenyana encishisiwe. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isib.: 3/4)
hints: Ithuba liyafana noma ucabanga ngokuhleleka kobulili kuphela, ungawahlukanisi abobulili obufanayo. Qala ngokuma abafana, bese ucabanga ngezindawo phakathi kwabo nasemaphethelweni lapho amantombazane angama khona.
Izindawo lapho amantombazane angama khona zingu-${m1}$.
pst_lineUp.explanation: Inani eliphelele lokuhleleka kobulili ngu-$\binom{{nn}}{{w}}={tot}$. Uma kukhethwa izindawo ezingu-${w}$ kwezingu-${m1}$ phakathi kwabafana nasemaphethelweni ukuze kume amantombazane, awaseduze komunye nomunye, ngakho kunezindlela ezingu-$\binom{{m1}}{{w}}={good}$. Ithuba ngu-${fe}$.

pst_monotoneSeq.prompt: Mayelana nezakhi $a,\ b,\ c,\ d$ zesethi $\{1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}\}$, thola inani lamapheya ahleliwe $(a,\ b,\ c,\ d)$ afeza $a{r1}b{r2}c{r3}d$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Lapho uphawu lungu-$<$, izinombolo ezimbili kumele zihluke. Nciphisa ububanzi bezinombolo ongazikhetha ngokuvumelana naloko.
Uma kunophawu lwe-$\le$ kuphela, ukukhetha izinombolo ezine kuyafana ne-combination enokuphindaphinda.
pst_monotoneSeq.explanation: $a<b$ kuyafana no-$a+1\le b$, ngakho uma kususwa u-$1$ enombolweni elandelayo ngokuphawu ngalunye lwe-$<$, lolo phawu luba ngu-$\le$. Kule nkinga kunezimpawu ezingu-$<$ ezingu-${s}$, ngakho zonke izimpawu ziba ngu-$\le$ futhi ububanzi bezinombolo buya ku-$1$ kuya ku-${ms}$. Inani lezindlela zokukhetha izinombolo ezi-$4$ kulobu bubanzi zivunyelwe ukuphindwa ngu-${}_{{ms}}\mathrm{H}_{4}=\binom{{top}}{4}={ans}$.

pst_multiplesUnion.prompt: Kwamakhadi angu-${N}$ ngalinye elinenombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-$1$ kuya ku-${N}$, uma kukhethwa ikhadi elilodwa ngokungahleliwe, thola ithuba lokuthi inombolo ekhadini iphindwe ngo-${p}$ noma ngo-${q}$. (Bhala ngengxenyana encishisiwe. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isib.: 3/4)
hints: Qala ngokuthola inani lamaphindwe e-${p}$ nelamaphindwe e-${q}$. Amaphindwe womabili angamaphindwe e-least common multiple yezinombolo ezimbili.
Inani lezakhi ze-union = (isamba) - (intersection).
pst_multiplesUnion.explanation: Kunamaphindwe angu-${np}$ e-${p}$, amaphindwe angu-${nq}$ e-${q}$, namaphindwe angu-${nl}$ e-least common multiple ${l}$. Ngakho ${np}+{nq}-{nl}={cnt}$ futhi ithuba ngu-${fe}$.

pst_normalBetween.prompt: Uma i-random variable $X$ ilandela normal distribution $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$, thola inani le-$P({a}\le X\le {b})$. Kwi-random variable $Z$ elandela standard normal distribution, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Bhala ngezindawo ezine zedesimali)
hints: Enza i-standardization nge-$Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$ ushintshele esimweni se-$P(z_1\le Z\le z_2)$.
Igrafu ye-standard normal distribution iyalingana nga-$Z=0$.
pst_normalBetween.explanation: Uma kwenziwa i-standardization nge-$Z=\frac{X-{m}}{{s}}$, $\frac{{a}-{m}}{{s}}={z1}$ futhi $\frac{{b}-{m}}{{s}}={z2}$, ngakho $P({z1}\le Z\le {z2})={expr}$.

pst_normalFindParam.prompt: Uma i-random variable $X$ ilandela normal distribution $N(m,\ {s}^{2})$ futhi $P(X\ge {c})={pv}$, thola inani le-constant $m$. Kwi-random variable $Z$ elandela standard normal distribution, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Shintsha u-$P(X\ge {c})$ ube yithuba elihlobene no-$Z$ bese uliqhathanisa no-$0.5$.
Ethebuleni, thola u-$z_0$ ohambisana nenani le-$P(0\le Z\le z_0)$.
pst_normalFindParam.explanation: $P(X\ge {c})=P\left(Z\ge \frac{{c}-m}{{s}}\right)={pv}$. Ethebuleni, $P(0\le Z\le |z_0|)=|{pv}-0.5|={tv}$, ngakho $|z_0|={az}$. Njengoba ${cmp}$, ${zsg}$ futhi $\frac{{c}-m}{{s}}={zz}$. Ngakho $m={ans}$.

pst_normalSymmetric.prompt: Uma i-random variable $X$ ilandela normal distribution $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$ futhi $P(X\le {L})=P(X\ge {R})$, thola inani le-constant $k$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ijika le-normal distribution liyalingana nge-mean $m$.
Amanani amabili anebanga elifanayo kusuka ku-mean ohlangothini oluphambene. Isamba salawo amanani amabili singu-$2m$.
pst_normalSymmetric.explanation: Njengoba ijika le-normal distribution lilingana nga-$x={m}$, $({L})+({R})=2\times{m}$. Uma kuhlelwa, ${A}k+({BD})={m2}$, ngakho $k={ans}$.

pst_repCombEq.prompt: Mayelana nama-integer angekho-negative $x,\ y,\ z,\ w$, thola inani lamapheya ahleliwe $(x,\ y,\ z,\ w)$ lapho $x+y+z+w={n}$ futhi ${cond}$. (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ezintweni eziguquguqukayo ezinomkhawulo ophansi omkhulu kuno-$0$, khipha umkhawulo ophansi ukuze zibe ngu-$0$ noma ngaphezulu.
Isibalo esishintshiwe sinesimo se-$x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$.
pst_repCombEq.explanation: Chaza izinto ezintsha eziguquguqukayo kanje. ${subs}$. (Uma kukhona into eguquguqukayo enomkhawulo ophansi o-$0$, ithathwa njengo-$x'=x$.) Ngakho $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$ futhi into ngayinye iyi-integer engu-$0$ noma ngaphezulu. I-combination enokuphindaphinda ${}_{4}\mathrm{H}_{{m2}}=\binom{{m3}}{{m2}}={ans}$.

pst_repPermCond.prompt: Kuzinombolo $0,\ 1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}$, kuvunyelwe ukuphindaphinda, ezinombolweni zemvelo ezinezibalo ezingu-${k}$ (isibalo sokuqala asisona u-$0$), zingaki izinombolo lapho inombolo ${t}$ isetshenziswe kanye noma ngaphezulu? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ku-'kusetshenziswe kanye noma ngaphezulu', kulula ukusebenzisa i-complement ('akusetshenziswanga nakanye'). Isibalo sokuqala asikwazi ukuba ngu-0.
Inani lonke lezinombolo zemvelo ezinezibalo ezingu-${k}$ ngu-${tot}$.
pst_repPermCond.explanation: Inani lonke lezinombolo zemvelo ezinezibalo ezingu-${k}$ ngu-${tot}$, futhi izinombolo lapho inombolo ${t}$ ingasetshenziswanga nakanye zingu-${noExpr}={no}$. Ngakho ${tot}-{no}={ans}$.

pst_sampleMeanDist.prompt: Esikhwameni kunamabhola ama-3, futhi izinombolo ezibhalwe kuwo zingu-${lst}$. Ikhishwa ibhola elilodwa esikhwameni, kubhekwe inombolo, bese liyabuyiselwa, kuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-${nt}$. Uma isilinganiso sezinombolo ezingu-${nt}$ ezibonwe singu-$\overline{X}$, thola $P(\overline{X}\ge {t})$. (Bhala ngengxenyana encishisiwe. Uma kuyinombolo ephelele, yibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isib.: 3/4)
hints: Njengoba kunokubuyisela, wonke amapheya ahleliwe angaphuma anethuba elilinganayo.
Bala wonke amapheya ahleliwe anesilinganiso esingu-${t}$ noma ngaphezulu.
pst_sampleMeanDist.explanation: Inani lamacala lapho ukuhleleka kubalwa lingu-${tot}$ ngokuphelele, futhi amacala anesilinganiso esingu-${t}$ noma ngaphezulu angu-${cnt}$. Ngakho ithuba ngu-${fe}$.

pst_sampleMeanNormal.prompt: Kusampula elinosayizi ${n}$ elikhethwe ngokungahleliwe esibalweni sabantu esilandela ukusabalalisa okujwayelekile onesilinganiso sesibalo ${m}$ ne-standard deviation yesibalo ${s}$, uma isilinganiso sesampula sithi $\overline{X}$, thola inani lika-$P({ev})$. Ku-$Z$ okuguquguqukayo okungahleliwe okulandela ukusabalalisa okujwayelekile okujwayelekile, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Bhala kuze kube yindawo yesine yedesimali)
hints: Isilinganiso sesampula $\overline{X}$ silandela ukusabalalisa okujwayelekile $N\left(m,\ \left(\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\right)^{2}\right)$.
I-standard deviation yokujwayelanisa itholakala kanje. $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$
pst_sampleMeanNormal.explanation: $\overline{X}$ ilandela ukusabalalisa okujwayelekile $N({m},\ {h}^{2})$ ($\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$). Uma kujwayelaniswa nge-$Z=\frac{\overline{X}-{m}}{{h}}$, ${zs}$, ngakho $P({ev})=P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_sampleSd.prompt: Kusampula elinosayizi ${n}$ elikhethwe ngokungahleliwe esibalweni sabantu esinesilinganiso sesibalo ${m}$ ne-variance yesibalo ${v}$, uma isilinganiso sesampula sithi $\overline{X}$, thola inani lika-$E(\overline{X}^{2})$. (Bhala njengedesimali)
hints: Isilinganiso sesilinganiso sesampula ngu-$E(\overline{X})=m$, ne-variance ngu-$V(\overline{X})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{{n}}$.
$E(\overline{X}^{2})=V(\overline{X})+\{E(\overline{X})\}^{2}$.

pst_stratified.prompt: Abantu bendawo ethile bahlukaniswe ngamaqembu amathathu A, B, C anabantu abangu-${na}$, ${nb}$, ${nc}$ ngokulandelana. Ngokukhetha okuhlukaniswe ngezendlalelo okulinganayo, lapho usayizi wesampula unqunywa ngokulingana nenani labantu belinye ilinye iqembu, kwakhethwa abantu abangu-${sa}$ eqenjini A. Bangaki abantu abakhethwe eqenjini C? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Ngokwabiwa okulinganayo, isilinganiso sabakhethiwe (inani lesampula ÷ inani labantu beqembu) siyafana kuwo wonke amaqembu.
Qala uthole isilinganiso seqembu A.
pst_stratified.explanation: Isilinganiso sabakhethwe eqenjini A singu-$\frac{{sa}}{{na}}$. Ngoba lesi silinganiso siyafana kuwo wonke amaqembu, eqenjini C kungu-${nc}\times\frac{{sa}}{{na}}={ans}$ abantu.

pst_totalProb.prompt: Uma kujikijelwa idayisi elilungile kanye futhi kuvela ihlo elingaphezulu ku-${t}$ noma elilingana nalo, kudonswa ibhola elilodwa ebhokisini A, kungenjalo ebhokisini B. Ebhokisini A kunamabhola amhlophe angu-${w1}$ namnyama angu-${b1}$, ebhokisini B kunamabhola amhlophe angu-${w2}$ namnyama angu-${b2}$. Thola ithuba lokuthi ibhola elidonswe libe mhlophe. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Izimo lapho ibhola elidonswe libe mhlophe zihlukaniswa ngokuthi 'mhlophe ku-A' noma 'mhlophe ku-B'.
Ngasinye sibalwe ngo-(ithuba lokukhetha ibhokisi)×(ithuba lokuthi ibe mhlophe kuleli bhokisi).
pst_totalProb.explanation: Mhlophe ku-A: $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}={tA}$, mhlophe ku-B: $\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={tB}$ (lapha $\frac{{t6c}}{6}$ lingithuba lokukhetha u-B). Uma amanani amabili ezengezwa, $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}+\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={fr}$.

pst_urnChain.prompt: Esikhwameni esinamabhola amhlophe angu-${w}$ namnyama angu-${bk}$, kudonswa ibhola ngalinye ngokulandelana futhi elidonsiwe alibuyiselwa. Thola ithuba lokuthi kuvele amhlophe ngokulandelana ku-${r}$ okokuqala futhi kuvele elimnyama ku-${r1}$. (Bhala njengengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo yonke, bhala inombolo yonke. Isb.: 3/4)
hints: Umthetho wokuphindaphinda wamathuba: inani lamabhola asele lishintsha esinyathelweni ngasinye.
Ithuba lokuthi okokuqala libe mhlophe ngu-$\frac{{w}}{{nn}}$.

pst_varTable.prompt: Ukusatshalaliswa kwamathuba okuguquguqukayo okungahleliwe $X$ ngu-$P(X={x1})=\frac{{a1}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x2})=\frac{{a2}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x3})=\frac{{a3}}{{d}}$. Thola inani le-variance $V(X)$. (Bhala ngengxenyana elula kakhulu. Uma iyinombolo ephelele, ibhale njengenombolo ephelele. Isibonelo: 3/4)
hints: Qala uthole u-$E(X)$ no-$E(X^{2})$.

stat_ciMean.prompt: Kukhethwe ngokungahleliwe {cnt} kubantu abalandela i-normal distribution. Isilinganiso sesampula singu-$\bar{x}={xbar}$ futhi i-standard deviation yabantu ingu-$\sigma={sig}$. I-confidence interval enezinga lokuthembeka elingu-${cl}\%$ yesilinganiso sabantu ngu-$\bar{x}-z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$, futhi inani lika-$z$ lapha lingu-${z}$. Inani eliphezulu (umkhawulo ongaphezulu) walesi sikhathi se-confidence liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uthole i-standard error $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$. Ihlukaniseka ngokuphelele ngoba u-$n$ uyisikwele.
I-margin of error ngu-$z\times$(i-standard error), futhi umkhawulo ongaphezulu uyinani lokwengeza lokhu ku-$\bar{x}$.
stat_ciMean.explanation: I-standard error ngu-$\frac{{sig}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, i-margin of error ngu-${z}\times{se}={moe}$, ngakho umkhawulo ongaphezulu ngu-${xbar}+{moe}={ans}$.

stat_ciProp.prompt: Ngemuva kokukhetha ngokungahleliwe abantu abangu-{cnt} ukuhlola inqubomgomo ethile, abangu-{ag} bavumile. Uma isilinganiso sesampula singu-$\hat{p}$, i-confidence interval enezinga lokuthembeka elingu-${cl}\%$ yesilinganiso sabantu ngu-$\hat{p}-z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}\le p\le\hat{p}+z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$, futhi inani lika-$z$ lapha lingu-${z}$. Umkhawulo ongaphezulu walesi sikhathi se-confidence, njengenombolo ngamaphesenti (%), uyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uthole isilinganiso sesampula $\hat{p}=\dfrac{{ag}}{{cnt}}$.
$\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$ iyinombolo ephelele ye-rational. Kulula ukubala uma uyiguqulela kumaphesenti.
stat_ciProp.explanation: $\hat{p}={ph}\%$, $\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{{cnt}}}={sdp}\%$, ngakho i-margin of error ngu-${z}\times{sdp}={moe}$(%), futhi umkhawulo ongaphezulu ngu-${ph}+{moe}={ans}$(%).

stat_linReverse.prompt: Kwenziwe okuguquguqukayo okusha $y$ kokuguquguqukayo $x$ ($y={eq}$). Isilinganiso sika-$y$ besingu-${my}$ futhi i-standard deviation ibingu-${sy}$. I-standard deviation ka-$x$ iyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma $y=ax+b$, i-standard deviation iphindaphindwa ngo-$|a|$.
I-constant $b$ elengezwayo nesilinganiso akuhlangene ne-standard deviation. Hlukanisa i-standard deviation ka-$y$ ngo-$|a|$.
stat_linReverse.explanation: Inani eliphelele lekhoefishenti ka-$x$ ngu-${aa}$, ngakho i-standard deviation ka-$y$ ingu-${aa}$ izikhathi i-standard deviation ka-$x$. Ngakho i-standard deviation ka-$x$ ngu-${sy}\div{aa}={ans}$.

stat_linTransform.prompt: Isilinganiso sokuguquguqukayo $x$ ngu-${m}$ futhi i-variance ngu-${vx}$. Uma okuguquguqukayo okusha $y$ kungu-$y={eq}$, i-variance ka-$y$ iyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Uma $y=ax+b$, i-variance iphindaphindwa ngo-$a^2$.
I-constant $b$ elengezwayo ayishintshi ukusabalala, ngakho ayithinti i-variance.
stat_linTransform.explanation: Ku-$y={eq}$ ikhoefishenti ka-$x$ ngu-${ap}$, ngakho i-variance ngu-${vx}\times{ap}^{2}={vx}\times{a2}={ans}$ (i-constant term nesilinganiso akuthinti i-variance).

stat_quartileIqr.prompt: Ngemuva kokuhlela idatha {data} ngokulandelana kobukhulu, i-median yengxenye engezansi ngokuya nge-median ithathwa njenge-first quartile $Q_1$, futhi i-median yengxenye engaphezulu ithathwa njenge-third quartile $Q_3$. (Uma inani ledatha liyisilinganiso esingaphelele, i-median uqobo ayifakwa kunoma iyiphi ingxenye.) Inani le-interquartile range $Q_3-Q_1$ liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uphinde ubhale idatha ngokulandelana kobukhulu kusukela encane.
Hlukanisa idatha ibe ingxenye engezansi nengaphezulu nge-median yonke, bese uthola i-median yengxenye ngayinye.

stat_rejectN.prompt: Kuhlolwa lezi zinkolelo. $H_0: m={mu0}$, $H_1: m>{mu0}$. I-standard deviation yabantu ingu-$\sigma={sig}$ futhi isilinganiso sesampula sicatshangwa ukuthi singu-$\bar{x}={xbar}$. Uma i-test statistic $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ inkulu kuno-${crit}$, i-null hypothesis iyenqatshwa. Uma isilinganiso sesampula esifanayo sitholakala, linini usayizi omncane kakhulu wesampula $n$ lapho i-null hypothesis ingenqatshwa? (Inombolo yemvelo, bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Shintsha ukungalingani okulandelayo kube yisisho se-$\sqrt{n}$. $Z>{crit}$
Yenza isikwele izinhlangothi zombili uthole ububanzi buka-$n$, bese uthola inombolo yemvelo encane kakhulu eyanelisa isimo. Ukulingana akuyona ukwenqaba.
stat_rejectN.explanation: Ku-$Z=\dfrac{{xbar}-{mu0}}{{sig}}\sqrt{n}>{crit}$, $\sqrt{n}>{rt}$, okungukuthi $n>{lim}$ (inani elinikezwe ngezikhundla ezimbili zedesimali). Inombolo yemvelo encane kakhulu eyanelisa lokhu ngu-${ans}$.

stat_sdFreq.prompt: Kunethebula lokusabalalisa kwamaza lapho amanani okuguquguqukayo $x$ angu-{xs} namaza ezindaba ngokulandelana angu-{fs}. Uma le datha ithathwa njengabantu bonke (i-denominator ye-variance isamba samaza), i-standard deviation iyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uthole isamba samaza $N$ nesilinganiso $m=\dfrac{\sum f x}{N}$.
I-variance $=\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}-m^2$, futhi i-standard deviation yimpande yesikwele ephozithivu yayo.
stat_sdFreq.explanation: $N={tot}$, isilinganiso $m={mean}$, $\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}={msq}$, ngakho i-variance ingu-${var}$, futhi i-standard deviation ngu-${ans}$.

stat_stratified.prompt: Ezigabeni zonyaka ezintathu ezinabafundi abangu-{n1}, {n2}, {n3} ngokulandelana, kuzokhethwa abafundi abangu-{ns} sezonke nge-stratified sampling. Uma kwabiwa ngokulinganisa isilinganiso sonyaka ngamunye (isigaba) esesamba sabafundi, abafundi abangakhethwa ezigabeni zonyaka wesi-{i} bangaki? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala uthole isamba sabafundi $N$.
Inani elikhethwa konyaka wesi-{i} ngu-(isamba sabafundi abakhethwayo)$\times\dfrac{{ni}}{N}$.

stat_tCiLower.prompt: Kukhethwe ngokungahleliwe {cnt} kubantu abalandela i-normal distribution. Isilinganiso sesampula singu-$\bar{x}={xbar}$ futhi i-sample standard deviation ingu-$s={sd}$. Njengoba i-standard deviation yabantu ingaziwa, kusetshenziswa i-$t$ distribution, futhi ethebuleni le-$t$ distribution elinamazinga enkululeko angu-${df}$, $P(T\le {t0})=0.975$. Inani eliphansi (umkhawulo ongaphansi) we-confidence interval enezinga lokuthembeka elingu-$95\%$ yesilinganiso sabantu $m$, $\bar{x}-t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$ ($t_0={t0}$), liyini? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Amazinga enkululeko ngu-$n-1$, futhi i-standard error ngu-$\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Umkhawulo ongaphansi ngu-$\bar{x}-t_0\times$(i-standard error).
stat_tCiLower.explanation: I-standard error ngu-$\frac{{sd}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, i-margin of error ngu-${t0}\times{se}={moe}$, ngakho umkhawulo ongaphansi ngu-${xbar}-{moe}={ans}$.

stat_zStat.prompt: Kuyaziwa ukuthi isikhathi sempilo esijwayelekile somkhiqizo othile singamahora angu-${mu0}$. Ngemuva kokukhetha ngokungahleliwe imikhiqizo engu-{cnt} yenqubo entsha, isilinganiso sesikhathi sempilo sibe ngamahora angu-$\bar{x}={xbar}$. Uma isikhathi sempilo silandela i-normal distribution futhi i-standard deviation yabantu $\sigma={sig}$ amahora ayishintshanga, linini inani le-test statistic $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ ye-null hypothesis $H_0: m={mu0}$? (Bhala inombolo kuphela)
hints: Qala ubale $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Hlukanisa umehluko phakathi kwesilinganiso sesampula no-${mu0}$ ngalelo nani. Ungaba ngaphansi kuka-0.
